name: Run Script Translator
title: Run Script Translator
text:
Run Script Translator
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    The Run Script translator supports the complex parameter value conversion capability implemented using scripts and supports all field types. For details about the syntax and examples of Run Script, see Service JavaScript Syntax and API Reference.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Access a created project and module, and choose Service.

     On the editing page of Service, click the blank area on the canvas, the service configuration is displayed on the right. Click  on the right to expand the service configuration area.

     In the row that contains the parameter node for which a translator is to be configured, click  on the right of the Translator box and configure the value translation mode.

     In the displayed dialog box, select an existing script or add a script. The script engine is compatible with historical engines. The engine versions are as follows:
      

      
       Latest: indicates the latest version, which is also the default version. The latest version is used by the current product and document by default.

       1.6: Not displayed by default and displayed only when the tenant system parameter support-engine-js-v16 is set to true. Version 1.6 is a transition version. It is used to be compatible with existing assets, instead of developing new assets. For details about the differences between versions 1.6 and the latest version, see Comparison Among Multi-Version APIs. The engine of version 1.6 can be replaced by the latest version. After the replacement, the rolled back is not supported.

       1.5: Not displayed by default and displayed only when a historical version of 1.5 has been imported and displayed. It is used only to be compatible with existing assets. There are great differences between versions 1.5 and the latest version. Obtain the documents of these two versions, respectively. The engine of version 1.5 can be replaced by the latest version. After the replacement, the rolled back is not supported.

      

      

     Edit the script in the script editing window.
      

      
       Figure 1 Run Script
       
      

      

     Click Save and set the script name.

     (Optional) Run or debug the script. After a script is saved and deployed, you can run and debug the script step by step. For details, see 8.

     Click OK to save the translator configuration.

     Click OK to save the node property configuration.

     Save settings of the service on the canvas.

name: Attachment Translator
title: Attachment Translator
text:
Attachment Translator
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    For parameters of Object type, you can use the attachment translator to translate and convert parameters.

    For example, the attachment field attachment exists in the model. When querying the model data, you need to extract the attachment name, content, and size from the attachment field. If you need to add the attachment field to the output parameter in the corresponding query service or query list service, set the type to Object, add the required output parameters name, data, and size, and configure them in the attachment translator.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Access a created project and module, and choose Service.

     On the editing page of Service, click the blank area on the canvas, the service configuration is displayed on the right. Click  on the right to expand the service configuration area.

     Configure the attachment translator conversion parameters. Change the type of the attachment field, click  in the Translator drop-down list on the row of the attachment field, and configure the value translation mode.
      

      

      

      
        
       
        Type of the attachment field. The options are as follows:

        
         Object: If there is only one attachment, select Object. For example, if the field type in the model is File, only one attachment is allowed. In this case, this field can be set to Object.

         Array->Object: If there are multiple attachments, set this field to Array->Object. For example, if the field type in the model is File List, multiple attachments may exist. In this case, you need to set this field to Array->Object to obtain multiple attachments. If only one attachment needs to be translated, you can use the ID field in the translator to specify the number of the attachment to be translated.

        

       

      

      

     In the displayed window, configure the translator. The name, data, and size fields must be selected from the sub-parameters of the current parameter.
      

      
       Figure 1 Attachment translator
       
      

      
       
        
         Table 1 Parameter description
        
        
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Name

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           Translator Name

          
           Attachment content conversion mode. This parameter determines whether the attachment content output by the data field is Base64 or text.

           
            attachment.to.base64: The attachment content is converted into a 64-bit binary data stream.

            attachment.to.text: The attachment content is converted into text.

            base64.to.attachment: The 64-bit binary data stream is converted into an attachment file.

           

         

         
          
           Name

          
           Parameter for writing the attachment name

         

         
          
           Data

          
           Parameter for writing the attachment content

         

         
          
           Size

          
           Parameter for writing the attachment size

         

         
          
           ID

          
           Sequence number of the attachment to be translated when there are multiple attachments. In actual configuration, if only one attachment exists, you do not need to set this parameter.

         

        
       
      

      

     Click OK to save the translator configuration.

     Click OK to save the node property configuration.

text:
Managing Common Functions of the Service
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    In the scenario where there is a large number of script codes, the common capabilities are used as common functions. In this case, the common functions can be called in the script to improve the script maintenance efficiency.

    For details about the syntax and examples of RunScript, see Service JavaScript Syntax and API Reference.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Service > Orchestration Resources > Common Function.

     Click Create.

     Configure the function information and edit the function script.
      

      

      

      
       The script is only an example. Compile the script based on site requirements. You are advised to write comments using JSDoc during function script editing.
       /**
* Value summarization function
* @param {string} param1 - Input parameter description of the function
* @param {string} param2 - Input parameter description of the function
* @results {number} Return value of the function
 */
exports.sum = function (a,b) {
    return a + b
}

Managing Service Script Templates

    When editing a script, you can click Insert Script to quickly obtain the script code snippet.

    In addition, you can view the script template to learn about the script sample and template information provided by the system. Script templates preset in the system are read-only and cannot be edited or modified.

    In addition, users can create custom script templates for use in projects.

name: Management Service Script
title: Management Service Script
text:
Management Service Script
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    When a RunScript script is created during service orchestration, each script is stored independently. You can create and select scripts on the Run Script node, validator, and translator of a service.

    To facilitate script management, the system provides the Service > Orchestration Resources > Script Management page. On this page, you can edit scripts and view association relationships between scripts.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project to be operated.

     Access the target module. If there is only one module, it will be accessed by default. If there are multiple modules, manually select one.

     Choose Service > Orchestration Resources > Script Management.

     On the Script Management page, view the scripts in the current application.
      

      

      

      
       Script Type: displays the script type, such as running script, validator, and translator.

       Version: displays the script version.

      

      

     Perform operations on the script as required. The management operations supported by the script are described as follows:
      

      
       Edit: allows you to edit scripts.

       Copy: allows you to copy the script whose version is Latest. You can copy a script to the current project or module or to another project or module. Only the projects and modules on which the current user has permissions can be selected as the target projects and modules for copying scripts.
        

        

       Association: displays the service that references the current script and allows you to quickly switch to the corresponding service.
        

        

       Deletion: Associated scripts cannot be deleted. Only scripts that are not associated can be deleted. For example, if a script is no longer used, you can delete it.
        
          
         
          Deleted scripts cannot be restored. Perform this operation when absolutely necessary.

name: Running Services
title: Running Services
text:
Running Services
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Prerequisites

    
     The service has been configured.

     The current project has been deployed in the runtime-state environment.

    

   

   
    Context

    Before testing a service in the develop state, you need to release the project to the runtime-state environment.

    If the service is changed, you need to deploy the service again and then perform the test.

    If a model or service has been deleted, you need to uninstall it in the runtime state and then deploy it.

    Operations such as data creation, modification, and deletion performed by the test service are real data operations performed in the runtime-state environment.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Package and deploy the current project as an app.

     On the Service page, click Run at the bottom to expand the debugging area.
      

      

      

      

     In the Input requirements area, set debugging parameters and click Run.
      

      

      

      

     The system calls the service deployed in the runtime-state environment to perform service operations and returns the result. Developers can check whether the result meets the expectation.

     To learn details about the execution process, click the Logs tab to view the execution logs.

     To locate the faults, use full-link logs if the full-link log function is enabled. In scenarios such as interface calling and other event calling, full-link logs can display the execution status of each phase. On the Logs tab page, click  to view full-link logs.
      

      

      

      When the service is executed for multiple times, after you click the icon, the log information displayed on the full-link log page is updated. Each time debugging is performed, a call chain ID is generated. Developers can view historical full-link logs based on the call chain ID. Full-link logs are stored for only 30 minutes and cannot be viewed after 30 minutes. Each user can view only the full-link logs generated during debugging performed by the user.

      
        
       
        If icon  is not displayed or no information is displayed in the full-link log displayed after you click the icon, the full-link log function of the current system is unavailable. To use the function, apply to the administrator for enabling it.

        
         The administrator needs to set the system parameters as shown in Table 1 on the Products and Services > ADC System Management > Component Management > System Parameter Configuration page as the master tenant.

         The full-link log function depends on the LogAnalysis service, so the full-link log function is available only when this service has been deployed in the system.

        

       

      

      
       
       
        
         Table 1 System parameters
        
        
         
         
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Category

          
           Parameter Name

          
           Encrypt Data

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           debug

          
           logstack

          
           No

          
           Whether to enable the full-link log function.

           
            If this parameter is set to true, the full-link log function is enabled and the  icon is displayed.

            If this parameter is set to false, the full-link log function is disabled and the  icon is not displayed.

           

         

        
       
      

      

     If the service contains a script, you can view the resource usage of the script on the Resource Occupancy tab page. If the script execution takes a long time or consumes a large number of resources, you can optimize the script.
      

      If the service does not contain a script, only the service execution duration is displayed.

name: Step Debugging Service
title: Step Debugging Service
text:
Step Debugging Service
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Prerequisites

    
     The service has been configured.

     The current project has been deployed in the runtime state.

    

   

   
    Context

    The difference between the step debugging service and debugging service is that you can set breakpoints during the debugging and view the detailed information such as the changes of variables on the nodes of the service in real time. This facilitates the fault locating of complex services.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Package and deploy the current project as an app.

     On the Service page, click  in the tool bar in the upper part of the canvas.

     Set breakpoints between service nodes.
      

      
       Click the connection lines between nodes to set breakpoints.
        
         Figure 1 Setting a breakpoint
         
        

       Click Execute to start the debugging. When the execution reaches the breakpoint, the execution is paused. You can click Step Into(F5) to continue.

name: Registering a Service with the API Catalog
title: Registering a Service with the API Catalog
text:
Registering a Service with the API Catalog
 
 
  
  

  
   Developers can register services with the API catalog to use services in other scenarios.

   
    Context

    The API catalog is the API document menu. For developers, the API catalog is the entry for all available APIs and documents.

    If an app developer defines its service as public and registers the service with the API catalog, the service can be used as an API for other developers.

   

   
    Procedure

    Register a service with the API catalog. You can perform this operation when creating or modifying the service.

    
     Choose Service.

     Create a service or open an existing service, and click  in the Service area on the right. The configuration page is displayed.

     Configuring the service
      

      

      
       
        
         Table 1 Parameter description
        
        
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Name

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           Open Level

          
           Open level of the service

           
            Module: A service can be accessed only within a module.

            Project: When multiple modules exist in a project, a service can be called across modules.

            Public: Access is allowed within a tenant. The API can be registered with the API catalog only when this parameter is set to Public.

           

         

         
          
           Register with the API directory

          
           This field is displayed when the service open level is set to Public.

           After being registered with the API catalog, the APIs can be used as API assets by external systems through API Fabric or called by other projects as APIs.

         

         
          
           API Catalog

          
           When this is enabled, set the location for registering with the API catalog.

           The directory must have at least three levels.

           You can view and manage API catalogs on Asset Management > Asset Library.

           
            Figure 1 Catalog management
            
           

         

         
          
           Scope

          
           
            If the project to which the API belongs is at the personal level, set this parameter to Personal or Public.

            If the project to which the API belongs is at the team level, set this parameter to Team or Public.

            When the project to which the API belongs is changed, the registered API sharing scope needs to be changed manually.

           

         

        
       
      

      

     Click OK to save the settings.

     Click  to save the service.

    

   

   
    Follow-up Procedure

    View the registered API by choosing API Catalog in the runtime-state environment.

name: Configuring a Customized Authentication Service
title: Configuring a Customized Authentication Service
text:
Configuring a Customized Authentication Service
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    Different authentication modes can be defined for each service. In addition to authorization configuration based on permission items, the system also allows users to define flexible authentication modes based on a customized service.

    Developers need to understand basic operations in Creating a Service (Blank Template) and Configuring the Node for Executing a Script. This topic uses a simple customized service as an example to describe how to configure the customized authentication service.

    Assume that you have configured the info_category_create service by referring to the preceding topics. The service can be accessed after login by default. This topic describes how to enable the service to be called only by specific users whose user names start with demo.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Create a script service for authentication.
      

      
       Create a service based on a blank template.

       Drag RunScript from the left pane to the canvas.

       Select the run_script node and click Edit on the right.

       In the RunScript text box, enter the script. If the first four digits of the user name are demo, the script example is as follows:
        var userName = _runtime.userName
if (userName.substring(0,4) == 'demo')
    { 
    return {"result":true}  
    }
else
    {
    return {"result":false}
    }

       Save the script and service.

      

      

     Configure the permission control mode for the service created for authentication.
      

      
       Open the created info_category_create service.

       Click the blank area. In the property configuration area on the right, click  to zoom in on the property configuration area.

       Set Authentication Type to Customized Service and set Customized Service Name to the service added in 1.
        
         Figure 1 Permission control mode
         
        

       (Optional) If input parameters need to be provided for a customized service, expand Input Parameter to configure the service input parameters.
        
         If the input parameters of the customized service are directly obtained from the context through a script, you do not need to configure the input parameters again.

         If the input parameters of the customized service are not obtained from the context but are the same as those of the current service, you do not need to configure the input parameters again.

         If the input parameters of the customized service are not obtained from the context and are different from the input parameter of the current service, you can configure service input parameters following $. in the path. Such service input parameters can be obtained from the specified input parameters of the current service.

        

       Save the service.

      

      

    

   

   
    Follow-up Procedure

    For the customized permission control service, effects cannot be directly displayed. Debug the service directly. Debug the permission effect by checking whether you can access the service on the page.

    
     If a user has the permission, the service can be directly called.

     If a user does not have the permission, an error message is displayed when the service is called.
      
       Figure 2 Debugging effect when a user does not have the permission

name: Creating a Model Flow
title: Creating a Model Flow
text:
Creating a Model Flow
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Prerequisites

    You have created a data model. For details, see Model Configuration.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project to be operated.

     Choose Model Flow.

     Click . In the displayed Create Model Flow dialog box, set the flow name and scheduling method.
      

      The following two scheduling methods are supported. The scheduling method also can be modified after a model flow is created.

      
       Repeat: used to configure a model flow that is repeatedly executed at a fixed interval (for example, 01:00 every Friday). The unit of Scheduling Cycle can be Minute, Hour, Day, Week, or Month.
        

        

       Cron: used to configure a model flow with complex time rules. For example, 0 0 12 * *? indicates that the flow is executed at 12:00 every day. For details about how to write a Cron expression, see Configuring a Cron Timer.
        

        

      

      

     Click Confirm. The model flow designer is displayed.

     Click the blank area in the canvas and configure the model flow information on the right.
      

      
       
        
         Table 1 Parameter description
        
        
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Parameter

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           Model Flow Access Address

          
           The value is automatically generated based on the project, module, and flow name. You can call the flow in other locations using the access address.

         

         
          
           Task Type

          
           
            Repeat: used to configure a model flow that is repeatedly executed at a fixed interval (for example, 01:00 every Friday). The unit of Scheduling Cycle can be Minute, Hour, Day, Week, or Month.

            Cron: used to configure a model flow with complex time rules. For example, 0 0 12 * *? indicates that the flow is executed at 12:00 every day.

           

         

         
          
           Scheduling Cycle

          
           This parameter needs to be set when Task Type is Repeat.

           The value is a positive integer and the unit can be Minute, Hour, Day, Week, or Month.

           When the unit is Day, Week, or Month, you also need to specify the execution time.

         

         
          
           Cron Expression

          
           This parameter needs to be configured when Task Type is Cron.

           For details about how to write a Cron expression, see Configuring a Cron Timer.

         

         
          
           Timezone ID

          
           This parameter needs to be configured when Task Type is Cron.

           The value is the time zone defined by the Cron expression. The default value is UTC.

         

         
          
           Callback Address

          
           This parameter can be configured if you need to call other APIs after a flow is executed. The CSE API address in the format of "cse://xxxx/xxxx" is supported.

         

         
          
           Callback Method

          
           Method of the callback interface. The options are PUT, GET, DELETE, and POST.

         

        
       
      

      

     Drag a node from the left pane to the canvas, select the node, click  in the property bar on the right, and configure the data node information.
      

      Multiple nodes need to be connected in lines.

            Description

            TQL Filter

            TQL statements for data filtering

          

          
           
            API Output

            Services, built-in model services, SOAP, REST, outbound APIs, and common APIs can be called.

          

          
           
            Run Script

            Select a created script from the drop-down list or click Edit to create a script. For details about the script syntax, see Service JavaScript Syntax and API Reference.

          

          
           
            All

           
            Exception Processing

           
            Processing mode when the node processing fails. The options are as follows:

            
             Fast Fail

             Ignore Exception

             Retry

            

          

          
           
            Model Input

            Model Output

           
            Operation Type

           
            Data processing operation. The options are as follows:

            
             Create

             Update

             Upsert

             Delete

            

          

          
           
            Run Script

           
            Processing Mode

           
            The following processing modes are supported:

            
             Batch Operation

             Single Operation

            TQL Input

            Run Script

            TQL Filter

           
            Input Parameter

           
            Node input parameters

name: Configuring a Trigger
title: Configuring a Trigger
text:
Configuring a Trigger
 
 
  
  

  
   In the data model, events of specified types, service calling, and data operations can be triggered based on data changes.

   
    Prerequisites

    
     You have created a data model.

     The event, service, or target data model to be triggered has been created.

    

   

   
    Context

    By configuring a trigger, you can call data operations of other models and send events or call other services before or after data creation, deletion, or update in the data model.

    
     Figure 1 Trigger diagram
     
    

    For example, in the data model, other services can be called synchronously during data creation.

    When configuring a trigger, prevent infinite loops. The system can check whether an infinite loop exists. If the check result indicates that the trigger causes an infinite loop, the system will not allow the trigger to be created. Take the following cases as an example:

    
     Configure a trigger. After the Update operation is performed on model A, assign a value to the model. If the value assignment operation also updates model A, the trigger will not be configured.

     Configure a trigger. If model B is updated when the Update operation is performed on model A and the data of model A is updated when model B is updated according to other rules, the trigger will not be configured.

    

    In addition, the system preconfigures the proxy models /System/sms/sms_send, /System/sms/sms_receive_log, /System/email/email_send, and /System/email/email_receive_log in the preconfigured System project to record SMS messages and email sending and receiving logs. Therefore, developers can monitor the four models, triggers the corresponding event or service to record SMS messages and email sending and receiving logs.

    
      
     
      In the model archiving scenario, the model archiving capability provided by the system deletes source data. If Dump Elastic Model is selected on the Archiving Configuration tab page, data is created in the elastic model. In this scenario, the data deletion event of the source data and the data creation event of the elastic model cannot trigger other activities based on triggers. If the trigger capability needs to be supported in the preceding two events, you can manually create a service to delete and create the corresponding data.

     

    

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Trigger.

     Click Create.

     Configure trigger properties.
      

      
       Figure 2 Configuring trigger properties
       
      

      

     Configure the trigger condition.
      

      
       Figure 3 Configuring the trigger condition
       
      

      

     Configure the trigger activity Operation Model Data.
      

      
       Configure the trigger activity Operation Model Data, and specify the target model and the corresponding operation.
        
         Figure 4 Configuring the trigger activity
         
        

       Configure target model field mapping.
        
         Figure 5 Selecting a model field
         
        

        
         Figure 6 Configuring field mapping
         
        

      

      

     Configure the trigger activity Send Event.
      

      
       Configure the trigger activity Send Event, and select the corresponding event.
        
         Figure 7 Configuring the trigger activity Send Event
         
        

       Select the event parameter. Configure the mapping between the current model field and the event parameter. That is, use the property value of the model field as the parameter property value for parameter transfer.
        
         Figure 8 Selecting the event parameter
         
        

       Configure field mapping.
        
         Figure 9 Configuring field mapping
         
        

      

      

     Configure the trigger activity Call Service.
      

      
       Configure the trigger activity Call Service, and select the corresponding API.
        
         Figure 10 Calling services
         
        

        
          
         
          
           When the Synchronize button is toggled on, that is, the trigger calls the service synchronously, you can set whether to enable the result writeback function. After this function is enabled, the parameters returned by the service are merged into the model instance of the context. If Timing of a trigger is set to Before, subsequent data operations are performed based on the merged model instance. If Timing of a trigger is set to After, the model data is updated based on the merged model instance.
            When the Synchronize button is toggled off, that is, the service is called asynchronously by default, the result cannot be written back.

           When a trigger calls a service, the _old_base_instance parameter of the Object type is transferred by default to represent the model instance data before the change. If the service needs to obtain both the data before and after the change, the data after the change is obtained based on the model field, and the data before the change is obtained from this parameter, that is, in the called service, set the input parameter to _old_base_instance and field type to Object, and process the data.

          

         

        

       Click Add and select parameters from the service. When calling a service, you need to set the input parameters of the service. Therefore, you need to add the input parameters of the service.
        
         Figure 11 Selecting service parameters
         
        

       Set service parameters. For service input parameters, you can use values of fields in the current model or set the parameters to fixed values.
        
         Figure 12 Configuring service parameters
         
        

      

      

     Save the trigger configuration.

    

   

   
    Follow-up Procedure

    After develop-state configuration is complete, click  in the upper right corner and select One-Click Deployment for the app to take effect immediately. If Enable Hot Deployment has been enabled in the Deployment Configuration dialog box, the system automatically deploys the service after identifying configuration changes.

    A trigger is triggered by a model data addition, deletion, or modification operation, which in turn is implemented by a service call. Therefore, if a trigger needs to be debugged, you need to run the corresponding service to trigger the corresponding event. Developers can view logs of the debugged service or check whether the configured triggering action is triggered to determine whether the corresponding event is executed.

text:
Configuring an Email Receiving Event Listener
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    Email receiving event is preset in the system and used together with the Notice service provided by GDE. After receiving an email, the Notice service triggers an orchestration event. Based on the listener configuration of this orchestration event, ADC triggers the corresponding service.

    Table 1 describes the parameters of the email receiving event (/System/mail/email_received).

    
     
     
      
       Table 1 Event parameters
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Parameter

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         attachment

        
         Email attachment. It is of the file list type.

       

       
        
         title

        
         Email title, which is of the text type

       

       
        
         content

        
         Email content, which is of the text type

       

       
        
         email_from

        
         Email sender, which is of the text type

       

       
        
         email_to

        
         Email recipient, which is of the text type

       

       
        
         email_cc

        
         CC recipient of an email, which is of the text type

       

       
        
         email_bcc

        
         BCC recipient of an email, which is of the text type

       

       
        
         read_status

        
         Email receiving status, which can be an integer

         
          0: Unread

          1: Read

         

       

       
        
         send_time

        
         Email sending time

       

       
        
         msg_id

        
         Email message ID

       

       
        
         server_id

        
         Email server ID

       

      
     
    

    For example, if email receiving logs need to be recorded in a service, perform listening on the email receiving event. When this event is triggered, the service for creating logs is triggered to record logs.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Configure a model and service.
      

      
       According to the service planning, if a service needs to be triggered through event listening, configure the service first. You can configure a model and click Auto Generate to make the system automatically generate a service.
       
        Configure a model.
         For example, to create a data model main_message for recording email receiving logs, you need to create a property type based on the stored event properties.

         

         

       

       
         
        
         The attachment field is used to store email attachments. The file type and file size need to be defined.

         
          The file size cannot exceed 10 MB.

          The file type can be customized based on service requirements.

         

        

       

       
        Enable the automatic service generation function. The automatically generated data service main_message_create is used to trigger an event listening service. The input parameters of this service are the properties of the preceding model. For details about how to enable the automatic service generation function, see Configuring Models to Automatically Generate Services and Pages.

       

      

      

     Configure an event listener.
      

      
       Configure an associated event.
        

       Configure conditions. Click Add. In the displayed dialog box, configure condition expressions based on site requirements.
        If the corresponding service is triggered when the event listening is triggered under any condition, this can be represented by the identity 1 = 1.

        

        

       Configure the service. Select the main_message_create service.

       Add mappings to map event parameters to service input parameters.
        
         Figure 1 Configuring the parameter mapping
         
        

       Save the event listener.

      

      

    

   

   
    Follow-up Procedure

    After the develop-state configuration is complete, click  in the upper right corner and select One-Click Deployment for the app to take effect immediately. If Enable Hot Deployment has been enabled in the Deployment Configuration dialog box, the system automatically deploys the service after identifying configuration changes.

    To debug the email receiving event listener, you need to trigger the email sending and receiving actions in the runtime state, and then check the model instance data.

Configuring an SMS Message Receiving Event Listener
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    SMS message receiving event is preset in the system and used together with the Notice service provided by GDE. After receiving an SMS message, the Notice service triggers an orchestration event. Based on the listener configuration of this orchestration event, ADC triggers the corresponding service.

    Table 1 describes the parameters of the SMS message receiving event (/System/sms/sms_received).

    
     
     
      
       Table 1 Event parameters
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Parameter

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         receive_log_id

        
         ID of the received log, which is of the text type

       

       
        
         sms_gateway_id

        
         ID of the SMS gateway, which is of the text format

       

       
        
         receive_time

        
         Receiving time, which is of the integer format

       

       
        
         dest_address

        
         Target number, which is of the text format

       

       
        
         src_address

        
         Source number, which is of the text format

       

       
        
         sms_content

        
         SMS message content, which is of the text format

       

      
     
    

    For example, if SMS message receiving logs need to be recorded in a service, perform listening on the SMS message receiving event. When this event is triggered, the service for creating logs is triggered to record logs.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Configure a model and service.
      

      
       According to the service planning, if a service needs to be triggered through event listening, configure the service first. You can configure a model and click Auto Generate to make the system automatically generate a service.
       
        Choose Model.

        Configure a model.
         For example, to create a data model sms_message_log for recording SMS message receiving logs, you need to create a property type based on the stored event properties.

         

         
           
          
           
            The value of receive_time must be an integer.

            Adjust the length limit of the sms_content field as required.

           

          

         

       

       
        Enable the automatic service generation function. The automatically generated data creation service sms_message_log_create is used to trigger an event listening service. The input parameters of this service are the properties of the preceding model. For details about how to enable the automatic service generation function, see Configuring Models to Automatically Generate Services and Pages.

       

      

      

     Configure an event listener.
      

      
       Choose Event Listener and click Create to create an event listener.
        

        

       Configure conditions. Click Add. In the displayed dialog box, configure condition expressions based on site requirements.
        If the corresponding service is triggered when the event listening is triggered under any condition, this can be represented by the identity 1 = 1.

        

       Configure the service. In the Service column, select sms_message_log_create.

       Add mappings to map event parameters to service input parameters. Click OK.
        

        

        The following figure shows the configuration effect.

text:
Configuring the CSV Data Import Service
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Prerequisites

    Services have been configured. For details, see Configuring Services.

   

   
    Context

    When you create data on the frontend, if a large amount of data needs to be added in batches, create data in batches by importing data.

    Therefore, data import is supported during app development. The overall data import capability is implemented through configuring the data import service, associating the configured service used for creating data, and using the import button for page development.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the required project.

     Select the required module.

     Choose Data Import.

     Click Create.

     Configure an import service with Import being CSV.
      

      The following table describes the configuration parameters of a CSV import template.

      
       
        
         Table 1 Parameters of the CSV import template
        
        
         
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Parameter Type

          
           Parameter

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           Basic settings

          
           Name

          
           Name of an import template.

         

         
          
           Service

          
           Service (such as the create and update services) that corresponds to data in an Excel file.

         

         
          
           Service Method

          
           The system orchestration service supports only POST requests.

         

         
          
           Open Level

          
           Open level of the imported service

           
            Module Level: Only the orchestration elements in the current module can call this service.

            Project Level: In the current project, orchestration elements in different modules can call this service.

            Public: Orchestration elements of all projects can call this service.

           

         

         
          
           File format

          
           File Type

          
           Type of the template file to be imported. The value can be csv or tsv.

         

         
          
           Record Separator

          
           Record separator used in the import template. The options are as follows:

           
            
             \r \n

            
             \r

            
             \n

           

         

         
          
           Null Mark

          
           Empty character string used in the import template.

           Value: a string of a maximum of 16 characters.

         

         
          
           File Code

          
           The encoding format of the CSV file to be imported can be specified. If this parameter is not set, the UTF-8 encoding format is used by default.

           
            UTF-8

            GBK

            ASCII

            ISO-8859-1

            GB18030

           

         

         
          
           Match File Name

          
           Specifies whether to enable file name matching. This function is disabled by default.

         

         
          
           (This parameter is displayed when Match File Name is enabled.)

           File Name Match Rule

          
           The value can be letters, digits, and the following special characters: *_-@#.

           Value: a string of a maximum of 64 characters.

           
             NOTE: 
            
             Only the wildcard (*) can be used to match any character string.

            

           

           This parameter is displayed only when Match File Name is enabled.

         

         
          
           (This parameter is displayed when Match File Name is enabled.)

           Import File Template Name

          
           If File Name Match Rule is set to the wildcard (*), the value of this parameter must be the same as the value of Name in the import template. Otherwise, the value of this parameter must be the same as the value of File Name Match Rule.

           Value: a string of a maximum of 128 characters.

           This parameter is displayed only when Match File Name is enabled.

         

         
          
           Support Internationalized Template

          
           When this function is enabled, the template column names can be internationalized.

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Support Internationalized Template is enabled)

           Select Bundle

          
           Click  and select an internationalization bundle resource. For details about how to create an internationalization bundle resource, see Configuring the Internationalization Information.

         

         
          
           Import settings

          
           Start Row Number

          
           Row in a CSV file from which data is imported.

           The default value is 2.

           The value ranges from 2 to 127.

         

         
          
           Batch Import

          
           Specifies whether to perform batch import.

           
            yes: The corresponding service must be configured as a batch service.

            no: The corresponding service must be configured as a non-batch service.

           

         

         
          
           Parameter Node

           (This parameter is displayed only when Batch Import is set to yes.)

          
           Parameter node of the batch import service.

         

         
          
           Parallel Import

          
           You can customize the value of this parameter when Batch Import is set to no.

           If Batch Import is set to yes, parallel import is not supported and the import sequence is strictly clarified.

         

         
          
           Match Label

          
           Mode of verifying and matching the column names and column numbers in the CSV file uploaded during data import.

           
            Matches Only Header: Check whether the column names in the uploaded attachment are the same as the defined ones.

            Matches The Header And Column: Check whether the column names and numbers in the uploaded attachment are the same as the defined ones.

            Not Match: The system does not perform matching verification.
             When Matches Only Header or Matches The Header And Column is selected, if the matching fails and the inconsistent parameter is mandatory, the import fails. If the inconsistent parameter is optional, the import is successful, but the data is not correctly created.

           

         

         
          
           Mandatory verify excel headers

          
           When this function is enabled, the header of the imported file must be the same as the fields in the template.

         

         
          
           Advanced settings

          
           Front Access

          
           Whether the front end is allowed to call the service.

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Front Access is enabled) Permission

          
           When Front Access is enabled, you need to configure the front-end access permissions. For example, if permission item A is configured, only users with permission item A can access the service. For details about how to configure permission items, see Configuring Permissions.

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Front Access is enabled) Frontend Access Callback Policy

          
           When the frontend page calls the Excel template through the Excel import component, the callback service can be configured.

           
            Arbitrary callback – insecure: There is no restriction on the callback service. This scenario has security risks and is not recommended.

            Restricted callback: Only services in the callback service list supported by the frontend can be called back. You are advised to use this policy.

           

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Front Access is enabled) Front-end Supported Callback Service

          
           Select services that can be called back.

         

         
          
           Check Download User

          
           When this function is enabled, only the user who creates the task can download error logs.

         

         
          
           Clear Model

          
           Whether to delete existing data in the model before data import. This parameter must be used together with the Clear Model property in the Excel Import Panel component.

           Only data models can be cleared. Other types of models, such as elastic models, cannot be cleared.

         

         
          
           Model Name (displayed when Clear Model is enabled)

          
           Select the model whose data needs to be cleared.

         

         
          
           Excel field mapping

           
             NOTE: 
            
             In the Fields area, you can click Load from Template to upload a template file for quick configuration of field mappings.

            

           

          
           Message Element

          
           Input parameter of the corresponding service.

             NOTE:

           Header

          
           When Support Internationalized Template is enabled, the column name can be configured as an internationalization property.

           For example, if the internationalization bundle i18n_member_info is selected and the member_id and member_name properties are contained, the property name entered in the column name does not need to contain the prefix. When the service is called on the page, the template available for the user can be adapted based on the selected language.

         

         
          
           Description

          
           Field description.

name: Configuring the Excel Data Import Service
title: Configuring the Excel Data Import Service
text:
Configuring the Excel Data Import Service
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Prerequisites

    
     A project and a module have been configured.

     Models and services have been configured.

    

   

   
    Context

    Excel data import is a method provided by developers for end users to easily upload data. It is not designed for developers to carry or import data.

    When you create data on the front end, you need to import the data that needs to be added in batches to create the data in batches.

    Therefore, data import is supported during app development. The overall data import capability is implemented through configuring the data import service, associating the configured service used for creating data, and using the import button for page development.

    When you create a model, the corresponding service and page are automatically generated, and the basic data import capability is also generated.

    
     Figure 1 Importing the automatically generated data
     
    

    When importing the Excel file data, developers can determine whether to import data in a batch. Batch import is used to process data at a time, which improves the data processing efficiency. If batch import is not used, the data is imported line by line, and the data processing efficiency is not high.

    During Excel data import, the following two types of services need to be called to process data:

    
     On ADC, batch_create, batch_upsert, and script services customized by RunScript are automatically generated or created using a service template.
      The type of the input parameter node must be Array->Object. The node name can be customized and configured in the parameter node.

      The name of the output parameter node must be results, and the type must be Array->Object.

      
       Figure 2 Service input and output parameter examples
       
      

     By default, the system batch imports APIs developed by the service side through microservices. The service side needs to ensure that the input parameter type is in array format and the output parameter is results.
      The following is an example of the input parameter format. The node name _values can be customized and configured in the parameter node.

      {
"_values": [{ "column1" : "xxx" } , { "column2" : "xxx" }]
}
      Output parameter format example:

      1. Full failure scenario
{ 
	"code": "Xxx", // 2.0 cse interface, if the key exists, all data in the current batch fails to be processed. If the data is successfully processed, the key is not contained.
	"message": "xxx" //Optional
} 
2. Some failure scenarios
{ 
	//If the value of results does not exist, the current batch is considered as a full failure.
	"results": 
		[{ 
			"code": "xxx", //If the key is contained, the data in the row fails to be imported.
			"message": "xxx", //This parameter is optional. When the code is displayed, the error information is recorded together with the code.
			"xxx":"xxx", //Any key that does not contain code is considered successful.
		}, // Each row of data corresponds to a JSON object.
		{ }] 
} 

    

    
      
     
      Currently, Excel import and export do not support character strings starting with a space and a single quotation mark (') which are followed by a special character (=+-@), or character strings starting with a special character (=-+@), for example, '=123+456.

     

    

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project to be operated.

     Select the module to be operated.

     Choose Data Import.

     Click Create.

     Configure an import service with Import being Excel.
      

      
       
        
         Table 1 Parameters of the Excel import template
        
        
         
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Parameter Type

          
           Parameter

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           Basic Settings

          
           Name

          
           Name of an import template.

         

         
          
           Service

          
           Service (such as the batch created and updated services) that corresponds to data in an Excel file.

         

         
          
           Service Method

          
           The system orchestration service supports only POST requests.

         

         
          
           Open Level

          
           Open level of the imported service

           
            Module Level: Only the orchestration elements in the current module can call this service.

            Project Level: In the current project, orchestration elements in different modules can call this service.

            Public: Orchestration elements of all projects can call this service.

           

         

         
          
           Template Settings

          
           Excel Template

          
           Template file provided for users.

           
            If a template file has been uploaded, data is presented to users in the same format as the template.

            If no template file has been uploaded, the system automatically generates an Excel file based on the configuration of Fields.

           

           When Support Internationalized Template is enabled, templates in different languages can be uploaded.

           When you enable Support Internationalized Template and set Template Locale, the original Excel Template component is changed to Excel Template (Chinese) and Excel Template (English). Uploaded attachments in each component are not displayed during component switchover, but they are included during the submission.

         

         
          
           Sheet

          
           Name of the sheet in the uploaded Excel file, which is associated with associates with Service. If an Excel template is uploaded, you can select a sheet in the Excel template. If no template is uploaded, you can customize the sheet name.

           When you import data, the system checks whether the name of the uploaded Excel file matches the worksheet name specified by this parameter. By default, data can be imported only when they match with each other.

         

         
          
           Worksheet Name Auto-fit

          
           
            Enable: If the name of the worksheet in the uploaded Excel file does not match the name defined by the Sheet parameter, but the uploaded Excel file contains only one worksheet and the column names match successfully, the system automatically matches the worksheet data and imports it.

            Disable: By default, this function is disabled. Data can be imported only when the name of the worksheet in the uploaded Excel file matches the name defined by the Sheet parameter.

           

         

         
          
           Support Internationalized Template

          
           When this function is enabled, the sheet name and column name of the worksheet can be internationalized.

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Support Internationalized Template is enabled)

           Template Locale

          
           Set the language of the template to be uploaded.

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Support Internationalized Template is enabled)

           Select Bundle

          
           Click  and select an internationalization bundle resource. For details about how to create an internationalization bundle resource, see Configuring the Internationalization Information.

         

         
          
           Import Settings

          
           Start Row Number

          
           Row in an Excel file from which data is imported. The first row is Column. Therefore, data is imported starting from the second row.

           The default value is 2. The value ranges from 2 to 127.

         

         
          
           Batch Import

          
           Whether data is imported in batches. During batch import, data in the Excel sheet is placed in request.body.rawDatas at a time. The configured service processes the data at a time and records logs.

         

         
          
           Parameter Node

          
           This parameter is displayed only when Batch Import is set to yes. Set this parameter to the input parameter of the service that performs the batch operation.

           For example, if the service that executes the batch operation is the automatically generated service modulea_modela_batch_upsert and the input parameter is _values, set this parameter to _values.

         

         
          
           Parallel Import

          
           Whether data is imported concurrently.

         

         
          
           Match Label

          
           Mode of verifying and matching the column names and column numbers in the Excel file uploaded during data import.

           
            Matches Only Header: Check whether the column names in the uploaded attachment are the same as the defined ones.

            Matches The Header And Column: Check whether the column names and numbers in the uploaded attachment are the same as the defined ones.

            Not Match: The system does not perform matching verification.
             When Matches Only Header or Matches The Header And Column is selected, if the matching fails and the inconsistent parameter is mandatory, the import fails. If the inconsistent parameter is optional, the import is successful, but the data is not correctly created.

           

         

         
          
           Mandatory Verify Excel Headers

          
           When this function is enabled, the header of the imported file must be the same as the fields in the template.

         

         
          
           Advanced Settings

          
           Front Access

          
           Whether the front end is allowed to call the service.

         

         
          
           Check Download User

          
           When this function is enabled, only the user who creates the task can download error logs.

         

         
          
           Clear Model

          
           Whether to delete existing data in the model before data import. This function is disabled by default. When this function is enabled, you need to set the name of the model whose data needs to be cleared.

           When you import data on the GUI, this parameter must be used together with the Clear Model property in the Excel Import Panel component to clear data.

         

         
          
           Model Name (displayed when Clear Model is enabled)

          
           Select the model whose data needs to be cleared.

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Front Access is enabled) Frontend Access Callback Policy

          
           When the frontend page calls the Excel template through the Excel import component, the callback service can be configured.

           
            Arbitrary callback – insecure: There is no restriction on the callback service. This scenario has security risks and is not recommended.

            Restricted callback: Only services in the callback service list supported by the frontend can be called back. You are advised to use this policy.

           

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Front Access is enabled) Front-end Supported Callback Service

          
           Select services that can be called back.

         

         
          
           (Displayed when Front Access is enabled) Permission

          
           When Front Access is enabled, you need to configure the front-end access permissions. For example, if permission item A is configured, only users with permission item A can access the service. For details about how to configure permission items, see Configuring Permissions.

         

         
          
           Fields

           
             NOTE: 
            
             In the Fields area, you can click Load from Template to upload a template file for quick configuration of field mappings.

            

           

          
           Message Element

          
           Name of the input parameter in a service.

         

         
          
           Column

          
           Column No. in the Excel file, for example, A, B, and C.

           
             NOTE: 
            
             In the Fields area, when you move a field up or down, the column No. is automatically updated. Click Column Refresh to update the column No. sequence.

            

           

         

         
          
           Header

          
           Column name, which corresponds to the table header in the Excel file.

           When Support Internationalized Template is enabled, the column name can be configured as an internationalization property. For example, if the internationalization bundle i18n_member_info is selected and the bundle contains member_id and member_name, the property name in the column name (for example, the part except the prefix in the Property Name column in the following figure) does not need to contain the prefix. When the service is called on the page, the template obtained by the user can be adapted to the language environment selected by the user.

         

         
          
           Reference Model

          
           Associated model.

         

         
          
           Description

          
           Field description.

         

        
       
      

      

     Click Submit.

    

   

   
    Follow-up Procedure

    Data import is a service that needs to be used with pages. Add an Excel import panel on the page and set the service to the configured Excel data import service.

    After develop-state configuration is complete, click  in the upper right corner and select One-Click Deployment for the app to take effect immediately. If Enable Hot Deployment has been enabled in the Deployment Configuration dialog box, the system automatically deploys the service after identifying configuration changes.

   

   
    Others

    
     At the preceding steps, the Excel template customized by users is not uploaded, but is automatically generated by the system based on service configurations. You can upload a customized template to the system. On the Excel Import Panel page, you can download the customized template.
      Customized template:

      

      Reconfigure the import template and update the Excel import service.

     When Excel data is imported, the calculation result data can be imported if the imported data is an Excel formula, such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. For example, in the Excel file, the formula is =B2*C2, and the calculation result 5622000 is imported based on the Excel calculation capability. If the formula result is incorrect, set the value to null.
      
       Figure 3 Supporting formula import

text:
Configuring the Customized Data Import Service
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    To import data in formats other than CSV and Excel, you can customize the services or scripts to configure the data import service.

    For example, you can develop a CSE service or JavaScript script to define the import of a ZIP package.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project and module to be operated.

     Configure the JavaScript script for data import.
      

      
       Choose Service.

       Create a service and drag the RunScript component to the service.

       Edit the script.
        

       Develop scripts based on the actual service scenario. This example is for reference only.
        console.info("_message is ", JSON.stringify(_message));
var fileToken = getTemplateId();
var param = {
  "fileToken": fileToken,
  "type": "customized",
  "serviceMethod": "POST",
  "serviceUri": "/adc-service/rest/v1/services/quxw/common/common_data_import",
  "parameters": {
    "name": "dadada"
  }
}
var response = ServiceInvoker.post("/adc-batch/rest/v1/import-tasks/actions/create", param);
console.warn(JSON.stringify(response))
var result = {}
result.taskId = response.taskId
return result
function getTemplateId() {
  var request = {};
  request.name = "Customized_Template";
  var templateRes = ServiceInvoker.post("/adc-service/rest/v1/services/quxw/quxw_legacy/quxw_legacy_model_get", request);
  if (templateRes.result && templateRes.result.file) {
    return templateRes.result.file + "";
  } else {
    throw new ScriptError("not found template: Customized_Template");
  }
}

       Save the script and service configuration as prompted.

      

      

     Configure the data import service.
      

      
       Choose Data Import.

       Click Create.

       Configure service information. 
        
         
          
           
           
          
          
           
            
             Parameter

            
             Description

           

          
          
           
            
             Import

            
             When configuring the customized data import, set this parameter to Customized.

           

           
            
             Name

            
             Name of an import template.

           

           
            
             Service

            
             Service called for customized data import. You can select a service configured in 3 or the CSE service.

             Input format of the CSE service: "cse://xxxx/xxxx"

           

           
            
             Service Method

            
             The system orchestration service supports only POST requests.

           

           
            
             Open Level

            
             Open level of the imported service.

             
              Module Level: Only the orchestration elements in the current module can call this service.

              Project Level: In the current project, orchestration elements in different modules can call this service.

              Public: Orchestration elements of all projects can call this service.

             

           

           
            
             Front Access

            
             Whether frontend access is allowed, that is, whether the data can be called on a front-end page.

           

           
            
             (Displayed when Front Access is enabled) Front-end Supported Callback Service

            
             Select services that can be called back.

           

           
            
             (Displayed when Front Access is enabled) Permission

            
             When Front Access is enabled, you need to configure the front-end access permissions. For example, if permission item A is configured, only users with permission item A can access the service. For details about how to configure permission items, see Configuring Permissions.

           

          
         
        

       Click Submit.

      

      

     Configure the page for importing data. For details, see Configuring the Page for Data Importing. For customized data import, you need to define the types of files that can be imported in the File Type Extensions field at the frontend.
