name: Importing and Using a Customized Plugin
title: Importing and Using a Customized Plugin
text:
Importing and Using a Customized Plugin
 
 
  
  

  
   After a customized plugin is packaged, import the customized plugin project file to Studio for use.

   
    Prerequisites

    You have packaged the customized plugin and obtained the corresponding customized plugin project package.

   

   
    Background

    Studio allows you to share developed customized plugins. Based on the Studio status, the following two methods are available:

    
     When Studio is in Offline state:
      After a customized plugin is imported to StudioA, choose Extension Management > Extension Center > Installed, select the customized plugin, and click Publish to release it to the local disk. Other Studios can obtain the corresponding file from the local disk and import the customized plugin after choosing Extension Management > Extension Market > Local to orchestrate or execute the RPA business process of the plugin.

     When Studio is in Online state:
      After a customized plugin is imported to StudioA, choose Extension Management > Extension Center > Installed, select the customized plugin, and click Publish to release it to the RPA management center. Other Studios need to connect to the corresponding robot management center. On the Extension Management page, choose Extension Market > Management Center, find the customized plugin, and install it. Then, you can orchestrate, use, or run the RPA business process of the plugin.

    

    If you need to execute the RPA business process of the customized plugin on Assistant, either of the following conditions must be met:

    
     Install Studio on the computer where Assistant is installed, and import the customized plugin to Studio.

     Manually upload the customized plugin to the robot management center, or release it to the robot management center through Studio.

    

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Import a customized plugin to Studio.
      

      
       Start Studio.

       In the navigation pane, choose .

       Choose Extension Market > Local, and click + on the right of Local.

       In the displayed dialog box, click  on the right of Plug-in File Path and select the plugin package to be uploaded.
        

       (Optional) If the verification certificate of the plugin file does not exist in the trust certificate store, check the security of the certificate. In the displayed dialog box, click Trust the certificate.

       After the file is parsed, set Description as required.

       Click Import.

      

      

     (Optional) Release the customized plugin in Studio for other Studios or Assistants to use.
      

      
       Click the Installed tab and click the customized plugin in the list.

       In the customized plugin details area on the right, click Publish.

       In the displayed dialog box, configure the release information.
        

        
         
          
           Table 1 Parameter description
          
          
           
           
          
          
           
            
             Name

            
             Description

           

          
          
           
            
             Custom Extension Name

            
             Name of a customized plugin

           

           
            
             Version

            
             Version of a customized plugin

           

           
            
             Publish To

            
             Destination of a customized plugin to be released

             
              Local Disk:Release customized plugins to a local disk.

              Management Center: Release customized plugins to the connected robot management center.

             

           

           
            
             Local Directory

            
             Local directory for releasing a customized plugin

             Click  on the right and select a path.

           

           
            
             Description

            
             Description of a customized plugin

           

          
         
        

       Click OK.

      

      

     Use a customized plugin in Studio.
      

      
       In the navigation pane, choose .

       In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

       Click the Controllers tab and click + before Custom plug-in.

       Under the corresponding customized plugin, drag the required control to the canvas and configure the control information.
        

        

       Connect the new control to other controls based on service scenario requirements.

       Click Save.

    Prerequisites

    
     PyCharm of a version from 2019.2.6 to 2020.2.5 (professional or community edition) has been installed.

     Python 3.8.5 or later has been installed.

    

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Download a customized plugin template and control building plugin.
      

      
       Start Studio.

       In the navigation pane, click .

       Choose Extension Market > Local, and click + on the right of Local.

       Click Download Template and select a save path for storing the customized ext_template_1_0_1.zip.

       Decompress the customized plugin template to the current directory.

       Go back to the Extension Management page of Studio, click Download Control Building Plug-in, select the save path, and download the customized plugin template file WeAutomate Action Builder-1.3.0.zip to the specified directory.

      

      

     Install the control building plugin.
      

      
       Open PyCharm and choose File > Settings.

       In the navigation pane of the Settings page, choose Plugins.

       Click  on the right of Installed and select Install Plugin from Disk....

       In the displayed dialog box, select the directory where the control building plugin file is located.
        

       Click Restart IDE. In the displayed dialog box, click Restart to restart PyCharm.

      

      

     Create a project in PyCharm and open the directory where the customized plugin template is located.

text:
Developing and Packaging Customized Plugins
 
 
  
  

  
   You can use plugins to develop and package a customized plugin based on scenario requirements.

   
    Procedure

    
     Develop the customized plugin file action_ext.py to implement the corresponding function.
      

      
       In PyCharm, open the action_ext.py file for implementing the customized plugin function.

       Develop customized plugin functions based on site requirements and save the settings.
        During development, keep the following rules:

        
         The entry method must start with action_.

         During RPA built-in module import, only the com.huawei.antrobot.actions.base module can be imported.

         The instance properties provided by BaseAction can be inherited.

         The command entry receives defined parameter names. (By default, a parameter value of the character string type is obtained.) (For example, if the add command has the mandatory parameter target and default parameter value, the entry method uses the formal parameter to obtain the action_add(self, target, value="1" parameter.)

         If the Python interpreter provided by Studio has been configured, use the UT to debug and verify specific functions. The Context and ActionOutParam classes are required for input and output parameters. After instantiation, values are assigned to action.context and action.out_param.

         The following table lists the supported properties. 
          
           
            
             Table 1 Property list
            
            
             
             
             
            
            
             
              
               Property

              
               Type

              
               Description

             

            
            
             
              
               self.logger

              
               obj

              
               logger object used to record logs. The log levels include info, error, warning, and debug.

             

             
              
               self.console_logger

              
               obj

              
               console_logger object used to print logs to the console in real time. The log levels include info, error, warning, and debug.

             

             
              
               self.ret_value

              
               obj

              
               Returned value of a specified action property

             

             
              
               self.reference

              
               obj

              
               Name of the return object that references the previous action, which is used together with self.context.get_reference

             

             
              
               self.command

              
               str

              
               Command name, which must be defined based on the Python method name

             

             
              
               self.params

              
               dict

              
               Used to obtain the corresponding parameter value in the XML file

               For example, self.params.get("target", "").

               By default, the obtained parameters are of the string type. This parameter is not required when the formal parameter receiving function is used at the entry.

             

             
              
               self.out_param

              
               obj

              
               The out_param object has the following properties:

               
                out_param_name: corresponds to the return value of the action property.

                out_param_type: corresponds to the value of return_type.

                out_param_value: The ret_value value is assigned to this property through the save method based on return_type.)

               

             

             
              
               self.context

              
               obj

              
               
                Value of the project directory @{WORK_DIR} obtained using the get_project_path() method

                Object returned by the action obtained using the get_reference(self.reference) method

     Configure the basic information about the customized plugin and click Next.

       In the navigation pane, choose Extension.

       The customized plugin group information is displayed in the customized plugin list of Studio, including the Chinese name, English name, Chinese description, and English description.
        

       In the navigation pane, select a developed control.

       Click the Chinese Configuration tab and configure the basic information such as parameters, input, output, and instance information of a control.

             Type

            
             Type of a parameter in the control, which is display in Studio

             
              number: The value is displayed in a text box in Studio and can contain only digits.
               

              string: The value is displayed as a text box in Studio. There is no restriction on the input.

              password: The password is displayed in the password text box in Studio to mask the input information.
               

              list: This parameter is displayed in the drop-down list box in Studio. It is often used together with the Value Range parameter to check whether the input value is within the value range.
               

              file: The value is displayed as a file selection box in Studio.
               

              dir: The value is displayed as a folder selection box in Studio.
               

             

           

           
            
             Display Name

            
             Display name of a parameter

             You can view the display name of a parameter next to the parameter name only when Parameter Name Is Visible is enabled on the Settings page of Studio. The actual effect is as follows:

              min_len/max_len: Length range of the character string. The default maximum length is 65535. For example, min_len=4.

              host: Domain name, for example, host

              excludes: Special characters that cannot be contained. For example, excludes=*\/? *[]*

              file_suffix: Supported file name extension, for example, file_suffix=xlsx|xlsm|xls|xlsb

              int: Integer, for example, int

             It is used by Studio to display dependency parameters. For example, the pid parameter of killProcess is available only when option is set to pid. In this case, you need to set the dependency parameter option==...pid for pid.

       In the navigation pane, select other developed controls and repeat 5.d to 5.e to configure the basic information such as parameters, input, output, and instances of a control.

      

      

     Configure the dependency information of the customized plugin and click Save.
      

      
       Go to the directory where the pip.ini file is located.

       Modify trusted-host and index-url in the pip.ini file to specify the image source address for downloading dependent third-party components and save the settings.
        [global]
trusted-host=cmc-cd-mirror.rnd.huawei.com

    Studio allows you to share developed customized plugins. Based on the Studio status, the following two methods are available:

Other Studios can obtain the corresponding file from the local disk and import the customized plugin after choosing Extension Management > Extension Market > Local to orchestrate or execute the RPA business process of the plugin.

     When Studio is in Online state:
      After a customized plugin is imported to StudioA, choose Extension Management > Extension Center > Installed, select the customized plugin, and click Publish to release it to the RPA management center. Other Studios need to connect to the corresponding robot management center. On the Extension Management page, choose Extension Market > Management Center, find the customized plugin, and install it. Then, you can orchestrate, use, or run the RPA business process of the plugin.

    

    If you need to execute the RPA business process of the customized plugin on Assistant, either of the following conditions must be met:

    
     Install Studio on the computer where Assistant is installed, and import the customized plugin to Studio.

     Manually upload the customized plugin to the robot management center, or release it to the robot management center through Studio.

    

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Import a customized plugin to Studio.
      

      
       Start Studio.

       In the navigation pane, choose .

       Choose Extension Market > Local, and click + on the right of Local.

       In the displayed dialog box, click  on the right of Plug-in File Path and select the plugin package to be uploaded.
        

       (Optional) If the verification certificate of the plugin file does not exist in the trust certificate store, check the security of the certificate. In the displayed dialog box, click Trust the certificate.

       After the file is parsed, set Description as required.

       Click Import.

      

      

     (Optional) Release the customized plugin in Studio for other Studios or Assistants to use.
      

      
       Click the Installed tab and click the customized plugin in the list.

       In the customized plugin details area on the right, click Publish.

       In the displayed dialog box, configure the release information.
        

        
         
          
           Table 1 Parameter description

              Local Disk:Release customized plugins to a local disk.

              Management Center: Release customized plugins to the connected robot management center.

             

           

           
            
             Local Directory

            
             Local directory for releasing a customized plugin

             Click  on the right and select a path.

     Use a customized plugin in Studio.
      

      
       In the navigation pane, choose .

       In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

       Click the Controllers tab and click + before Custom plug-in.

       Under the corresponding customized plugin, drag the required control to the canvas and configure the control information.
        

        

       Connect the new control to other controls based on service scenario requirements.

title: Developing a Customized Recorder
text:
Developing a Customized Recorder
 
 
  
  

  
   Studio allows you to customize a recorder for a specified application based on service requirements.

  

  
   
    Preparing for the Development
      Before you develop a customized recorder, obtain the required third-party components of the WebSocket client and establish the communication between the customized recorder and Studio.

    Configuring a Customized Recorder
      Before you develop a customized recorder API, configure the information about the customized recorder in a specified file.

    Developing a Customized Recorder API
      After you configure a customized recorder, develop the recording and pickup APIs based on service requirements.

    Developing a Playback Plugin for the Customized Recorder
      After the customized recorder API is developed, develop the corresponding playback plugin based on service requirements.

   

   
    
     Parent topic: RPA Development Guide

name: Configuring a Customized Recorder
title: Configuring a Customized Recorder
text:
Configuring a Customized Recorder
 
 
  
  

  
   Before you develop a customized recorder API, configure the information about the customized recorder in a specified file.

   
    Context

    
     When Studio is started, it automatically reads the userMapping.json configuration file to check whether an available customized recorder exists.
      
       If parameters title, class_name, and process_name in the configuration file are empty, the customized recorder cannot be used because its configurations do not take effect.

       If at least one of the three parameters title, class_name, and process_name in the configuration file are set and the corresponding executable file is entered in recorder_file, Studio automatically starts the customized recorder.

      

     When a recording job is started in Studio, Studio first checks whether the recorded app meets all matching rules in the userMapping.json configuration file. If yes, Studio automatically forwards the recording-related message to the client specified by url. If no, the default forwarding rule is used.
      
       Check whether the value of title contains the name of the app that is being recorded.

       Check whether the values of class_name and process_name are the same as the class name and process name of the recorded app and are case sensitive.

      

    

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Go to the %Studio installation directory%\Robot\cfg directory.

     Modify the userMapping.json configuration file based on service requirements and save the modification.
      

      [{
        "title": "",
        "class_name": "",
        "process_name": "",
        "recorder_file":"startup.bat",
        "ext_name":"",
        "url": "/customizeUrl",
        "desc": "Customized recorder 1"
}]
      
       
        
         Table 1 Parameter description
        
        
         
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Name

          
           Mandatory

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           title

          
           No

          
           Name of a specific app corresponding to a customized recorder

         

         
          
           class_name

          
           No

          
           Name of a specific app class corresponding to a customized recorder

         

         
          
           process_name

          
           No

          
           Name of a specific app process corresponding to a customized recorder

         

         
          
           recorder_file

          
           No

          
           Executable file of a customized recorder, which can be stored only in the directory of the same level or lower level as the configuration file

           Format: Path of the executable file relative to the path of the configuration file, for example, test/test.bat

         

         
          
           ext_name

          
           Yes

          
           Playback file name extension of a customized recorder, which is used to play back the recording script after the recording script is executed

         

         
          
           url

          
           Yes

          
           WebSocket connection keyword used by a customized recorder

           The value format is /${Connection keyword}, in which ${Connection keyword} indicates the connection keyword set in 2.b. For example, if the connection address is ws://127.0.0.1:57889/Example, replace Example.

         

         
          
           desc

          
           No

          
           Description of a customized recorder

         

        
       
      

      

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Developing a Customized Recorder

name: Developing a Customized Recorder API
title: Developing a Customized Recorder API
text:
Developing a Customized Recorder API
 
 
  
  

  
   After you configure a customized recorder, develop the recording and pickup APIs based on service requirements.

   
    Procedure

    
     Develop the following public APIs based on service requirements:
      

      
       API for obtaining the area where an element is located based on the mouse position
        
         Request: {"command":"getRect","screenX":100,"screenY":200} 
          
           
            
             Table 1 Request parameters
            
            
             
             
            
            
             
              
               Name

              
               Description

             

            
            
             
              
               screenX

              
               Position of the cursor on the X axis relative to the upper left corner of the screen

             

             
              
               screenY

              
               Position of the cursor on the Y axis relative to the upper left corner of the screen

             

            
           
          

         Response: {"command":"getRect","x":100,"y":10,"width":100,"height":200}

        

       API for obtaining the element information based on the mouse position
        
         Request: {"command":"getElementInfo","screenX":100,"screenY":200} 
          
           
            
             Table 2 Request parameters
            
            
             
             
            
            
             
              
               Name

              
               Description

             

            
            
             
              
               screenX

              
               Position of the cursor on the X axis relative to the upper left corner of the screen

             

             
              
               screenY

              
               Position of the cursor on the Y axis relative to the upper left corner of the screen

             

            
           
          

         Response: {"command":"getElementInfo","target":"{}","editable":true,"selectTag":true,"selectItem":["1","2","3"]} 
          
           
            
             Table 3 Response parameters
            
            
             
             
            
            
             
              
               Name

              
               Description

             

            
            
             
              
               target

              
               
                Information about the obtained element. It is recommended that the information be returned in a JSON string. Command example:
                {
	"appName": "chrome.exe",
	"title": "Baidu, you know",
	"target": []
}
               

             

             
              
               editable

              
               Whether the obtained element is a text box

               Currently, the text box is displayed in Studio and is left blank on the app page.

               
                true: Yes

                false: No

               

             

             
              
               selectTag

              
               Whether the obtained element is a single-choice drop-down list box

               
                true: Yes

                false: No

               

             

             
              
               selectItem

              
               Options in the drop-down list box of the obtained element

               This parameter is valid only when selectTag is set to true.

             

            
           
          

        

      

      

     Develop the following APIs related to the recording function based on service requirements:
      

      
       API for starting recording
        
         Request: {"command":"START_RECORD"}

         Response: none

        

       API for stopping recording
        
         Request: {"command":"STOP_RECORD"}

         Response: none

        

       Enter the value API in the element.
        
         Request: {"command":"type","screenX":100,"screenY":200,"value":"Entered value","clear":true/false} 
          
           
            
             Table 4 Request parameters
            
            
             
             
            
            
             
              
               Name

              
               Description

             

            
            
             
              
               screenX

              
               Position of the cursor on the X axis relative to the upper left corner of the screen

             

             
              
               screenY

              
               Position of the cursor on the Y axis relative to the upper left corner of the screen

             

             
              
               value

              
               Value to be entered in the element

             

             
              
               clear

              
               Whether to clear the original value before entering a new value

               
                true: Yes

                false: No

               

             

            
           
          

         Response: none

        

       (Optional) API for selecting options from the drop-down list box
        
         Request {"command":"select","screenX":100,"screenY":200,"index":1} 
          
           
            
             Table 5 Request parameters
            
            
             
             
            
            
             
              
               Name

              
               Description

             

            
            
             
              
               screenX

              
               Position of the cursor on the X axis relative to the upper left corner of the screen

             

             
              
               screenY

              
               Position of the cursor on the Y axis relative to the upper left corner of the screen

             

             
              
               index

              
               Index of an option in the drop-down list box

             

            
           
          

         Response: none

        

      

      

     Develop the following APIs related to the pickup function based on service requirements:
      

      
       API for starting pickup
        
         Request: {"command":"startInspect","itemName":"Parameter name","actionName":"Command name","driver_type":"extension"} 
          
           
            
             Table 6 Request parameters
            
            
             
             
            
            
             
              
               Name

              
               Description

             

            
            
             
              
               itemName

              
               Parameter name of a command

               For example, the parameter name of the click command is target.

             

             
              
               actionName

              
               Command name, for example, click, rightclick, and doubleclick

             

             
              
               driver_type

              
               driver_type property of a command

               The default value of driver_type is extension.

             

            
           
          

         Response: none

        

       API for stopping pickup
        
          
         
          You can use the cleanup function in the API for stopping pickup based on service requirements.

         

        

        
         Request: {"command":"stopInspect"}

         Response: none

        

      

      

     After the development is complete, use the customized recorder to record scripts in Studio and verify that the recording function is available.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Developing a Customized Recorder

name: Developing a Playback Plugin for the Customized Recorder
title: Developing a Playback Plugin for the Customized Recorder
text:
Developing a Playback Plugin for the Customized Recorder
 
 
  
  

  
   After the customized recorder API is developed, develop the corresponding playback plugin based on service requirements.

   
    Context

    After a customized recorder is developed, the corresponding customized playback plugin must be available. Otherwise, the script recorded by the customized recorder may fail to be played back. The customized playback plugin must contain the commands listed in the following table.

    
     
      
       Table 1 Command list (Recording)
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Command

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         click

        
         Left-click the mouse.

       

       
        
         doubleClick

        
         Double-click the left mouse button.

       

       
        
         rightClick

        
         Right-click the mouse.

       

       
        
         moveToElement

        
         Move the cursor to a specified element and perform the recording using floating menus.

       

       
        
         type

        
         Enter the content in the element.

       

       
        
         getText

        
         Obtain the element text and record it using floating menus.

       

      
     
    

    
     
      
       Table 2 Command list (Pickup)
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Command

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Custom

        
         Customize the pickup command based on service requirements. In the help.json file corresponding to the command, inspector of a parameter must be set to true, indicating that the parameter can be picked up.

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Develop the playback plugin corresponding to the customized recorder. For details, see Customized Plugin Development.

     After the development is complete, use the customized recorder to record the script and play back it in Studio and verify that the playback function is available.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Developing a Customized Recorder

On the WPS tool bar, choose Development Tool > Macro Security. (1) Select Low for Security Level; (2) Select Trust for Access to Visual Basic Projects for Reliable Publishers;

name: Execute VBA Code Block
title: Execute VBA Code Block
text:
Execute VBA Code Block pptExecuteVBA Description: Execute VBA code block.Some VBA code can be successfully run only in visual conditions. If it fails to run in the background, open the document in the foreground visual mode.You need to select the access permission for VBProject: 1. Select Development Tools: File > Options > Custom Ribbon > Development Tools. 2. PPT: Development Tools > Macro Security > Macro Settings > Trust Access to VBA Project Object Model. 3. WPS: Development Tools > Macro Security > Reliable Publishers > Trust Access to Visual Basic Projects Input: name type help reference PPTObject Specify the PPT object to be operated Parameters: name type is_required default range help vba-code string True - - VBA code block. Such as: With ActivePresentation.Slides.Add(Index:=1, Layout:=ppLayoutTitle).Shapes .Title.TextFrame.TextRange = "This is the title text" .Placeholders(2).TextFrame.TextRange = "This is subtitle text" End With timeout number - - - Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded. delay number - - - Delay from the previous operation Output: none samples Run the vba code block:
With ActivePresentation.Slides.Add(Index:=1, Layout:=ppLayoutTitle).Shapes
.Title.TextFrame.TextRange = "This is the title text"
.Placeholders(2).TextFrame.TextRange = "This is subtitle text"
End With Param Value vba-code With ActivePresentation.Slides.Add(Index:=1, Layout:=ppLayoutTitle).Shapes
.Title.TextFrame.TextRange = "This is the title text"
.Placeholders(2).TextFrame.TextRange = "This is subtitle text"
End With Parent topic: Common

name: Get Table
title: Get Table
text:
Get Table
 
 
  
  

  
   getTable

   Description: 

   Get the table information on the page and output the information. Please pick a cell in the table for the desktop application.

   Input: none

   Parameters: 

   
    
     
      
      
      
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        is_required

       
        default

       
        range

       
        help

      

      
       
        target

       
        json

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Recorded or picked up form control information,Please pick a cell in the table for the desktop application

      

      
       
        mode

       
        list

       
        -

       
        common

       
        common|by_scroll|redraw

       
        Select the mode for fetching tabular data.

        1) Obtain directly(Default): directly obtain the data in the current table control

        2) Obtain by scrolling(Only SAP tables are supported.): obtain the data in the current table control, then scroll once to obtain the data in the updated table control, and cycle until no new data is obtained or until timeout

        3) Refresh the page text and then obtain the data. This method is used when the table data cannot be obtain directly.

      

      
       
        scroll_offset

       
        number

       
        -

       
        100

       
        -

       
        The offset of each scrollbar movement

      

      
       
        scroll_times_limit

       
        number

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Stop the execution when the number of times the scroll bar is scrolled reaches the limit.

      

      
       
        timeout

       
        number

       
        -

       
        30000

       
        -

       
        Timeout interval(ms). The default timeout interval is 30 seconds. After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded.

      

      
       
        delay

       
        number

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Delay from the previous operation

      

     
    
   

   Output: 

   
    
     
      
      
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        default

       
        range

       
        help

      

      
       
        return

       
        Object

       
        getTable_ret

       
        -

       
        Data in the table

      

      
       
        return_type

       
        list

       
        -

       
        list

       
        Type of return value,Default is Dataframe

      

     
    
   

    samples

   Get the table data of the control whose name attribute value is equal to tableName

name: Open Web Page
title: Open Web Page
text:
Open Web Page
 
 
  
  

  
   openurl

   Description: 

   Open a web page;

   IE browser search rules for opened pages: match from back to front, match priority: 1. Address and title all match 2. Address all match 3. Title all match 4. Index match window (only use index match, delete other match methods) 5. Element match window (only use element match, delete other match methods) 6. Addresses with * wildcard fuzzy matching 7. Title with * wildcard fuzzy matching 8. Not found;

   Other browser search rules for opened pages: match from back to front, match priority: 1. Address and title all match 2. Address all match 3. Title all match 4. Address and title contain 5. Address contain 6. Title contain 7. Addresses with * wildcard fuzzy matching 8. Title with * wildcard fuzzy matching 9. Not found

   Input: none

   Parameters: 

   
    
     
      
      
      
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        is_required

       
        default

       
        range

       
        help

      

      
       
        url

       
        string

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        target URL(Tips:The corresponding protocol must be filled in the URL, such as http, https, file, etc. The url cannot be directly entered, such as www.example.com. See the samples for proper formatting)

      

      
       
        browser

       
        list

       
        -

       
        chrome

       
        chrome|firefox|msedge|360se|360ent|hitoorbrowser|ie

       
        Optional, Select the type of browser you want to use

      

      
       
        method

       
        list

       
        -

       
        new

       
        active|new

       
        The opening method of the web page, opening the web page in the current window means opening the specified web page on the active tab in the current browser; opening the web page in a new tab means opening a new tab page, and opening the specified web page in the new tab page; When empty, the default is new.

      

      
       
        resize-max

       
        list

       
        -

       
        True

       
        True|False

       
        If the value is True, maximize the page when opening the page.

      

      
       
        timeout

       
        number

       
        -

       
        30000

       
        -

       
        Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded.

      

      
       
        delay

       
        number

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Delay from the previous operation

   OfflineOcrAutoForm

   Description: 

   Offline OCR Auto Form

   [Paddle]

   For details about the environment configuration, see https://bbs.huaweicloud.com/forum/thread-194071-1-1.html

   [Tesseract]

   Firstly, before configuring the OCR engine, perform the following steps:

   1. Download the Tesseract-OCR installation package from https://digi.bib.uni-mannheim.de/tesseract/?C=M;O=D, which is similar to tesseract-ocr-w64-setup-v5.1.0.20220510.exe.

   2. Set environment variables for the installation directory. For example, add D:/Tesseract-OCR to Path.

   3. Set the system variable name TESSDATA_PREFIX and the variable value to D:/Tesseract-OCR/tessdata.

   4. By default, only the English package is available. Therefore, download the required language package to the directory in step 3. The language package download address is https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata. For example, chi_sim.traineddata is the Chinese language package.

   5. If "no module named'pytesseract" is displayed, go to the python folder in the studio installation directory, open the cmd command line black window, and enter python -m pip install pytesseract.

text:
Convert PDF to Image
 
 
  
  

  
   pdfToImage

   Description: 

   Convert PDF to image;

   There are two ways to use this command (we recommend the first method because the first method covers more scenarios than the second method):

   Method 1: Configure the third-party software according to the RPA forum, forum address: https://bbs.huaweicloud.com/forum/thread-186377-1-1.html;

   Method 2: Install PyMupdf>=1.18.14 version tripartite;

   installation steps:

   1. Enter the Python directory under the studio installation directory;

   3. Windows system enter the command in the cmd window: Python.exe -m pip install pymupdf to install; Linux system enter the command in the terminal: ./python3 -m pip install pymupdf

   Method 2: Download the conversion tool poppler;

   installation steps:

   1. Download link http://blog.alivate.com.au/poppler-windows/,

   2. After downloading, unzip the serial bin/folder and add it to the environment variable;

   3. Restart the computer.

   Input: none

   Parameters:

        Path for storing converted PDF images.

        True

       
        image.png

       
        -

       
        Name of the image converted from the PDF file,The file name used must end with a valid image extension. The supported file names include .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .tif, .tiff, .bmp, and .gif.

      

      
       
        filter-page

       
        string

       
        True

       
        1-2

       
        -

       
        Specifies the number of pages to be converted to images. You can specify a page or a range of pages to be converted to images. If you want to convert all PDF pages to images, enter all. (Note: If the file size is too large, system freezing may occur.) e.g.:1-2

        Note: The number of pages can only be a positive integer, and the start page cannot be greater than the end page when specifying the range of pages

      

      
       
        timeout

       
        number

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded.

        number

       
        -

Read Range
 
 
  
  

  
   pdfGetContents

   Description: 

   Obtains the text in the rectangle specified by the pos-upper-left and pos-lower-right parameters on the filter-page page in the PDF file or generates images based on the specified range.

   Command

   Run this command. Install the third-party software of the pymupdf later.

   Installation procedure:

   1. Go to the python directory from the Studio installation directory.

   2. Open a terminal in this folder.

   3. Enter the command in a terminal window: python -m pip install pymupdf to install.The version cannot be earlier than 1.18.14.

   Determine the coordinates.

   In the PDF file, the upper left corner of the entire page is the origin, and the coordinates are 0 and 0. The lower right corner of the page is the pole, and the coordinate width (page width) and height (page height). The positive axis is the x axis from the origin to the right. The value range of x is 0 ≤ x ≤ width. Positive axis of the y axis starting from the origin. The value range of y is 0 ≤ y ≤ height.

text:
Transfer Output Text To Table console.outputTextToTable Description: Converts tabular output text to a list or DataFrame. Input: none Parameters: name type is_required default range help terminal_output_text string True - - The text output from executing a terminal command. header json - [] - Custom header of DataFrame, It only takes effect when the output result is a DataFrame. mark String - --- - mark, this mark is the end value of a certain row of data, and is added to the table data starting from the next row of the row, ending with the line before the last line whose end with the center character '---' ignored_start_rows number - - - The first n lines of the output text are ignored. After the configuration, the first n lines of the output text are trimmed, and the remaining text is converted into a table. ignored_end_rows number - - - The last n lines of the output text are ignored. After the configuration, the last n lines of the output text are trimmed, and the remaining text is converted into a table. timeout number - - - Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded. delay number - - - Delay before the current operation Output: name type default range help return Array outputTextToTable_ret - Table converted from output text return_type list - list|DataFrame Type of return value samples Convert terminal output text to table Param Value terminal_output_text X1 XX XX
X2 XX XX
X3 XX XX ---
a1 b1 c1
a2 b2 c2
X3 XX XX
X4 XX XX ---
X5 XX XX header ["A", "B", "C"] mark --- ignored_start_rows 2 ignored_end_rows 1 Expected Result: ``` [['A', 'B', 'C'], ['a1', 'b1', 'c1'], ['a2', 'b2', 'c2'], ['X3', 'XX', 'XX']] ``` The usage example is as follows: Parent topic: Terminal

Multiple keys should be separated by semicolons. If this parameter is left blank, all valid data will be extracted. separator string - : - Separator of a key-value pair. title: Run Python Statement
text:
Run Python Statement exec.statement Description: Run the python statement. 1. Enter the python code for the value parameter, which must be in the python encoding format. Otherwise, an error will be reported. 2. This command does not return a value and can only process the code logic. For example, add, delete, or modify the context definition list or dictionary. Changes of immutable objects such as string and int are invalid. 3. External parameters can be referenced without @ {}. 4. The third-party package that can be used in the code is the third-party package installed by the Studio. 5. Functions that require console input, such as input(), are not supported. 6.If you want to reassign a value to an external variable referenced in a statement block or declare a variable as an external variable, use the global keyword.For details, see the example Input: none Parameters: name type is_required default range help value python True - - Python Statement timeout number - - - Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded. delay number - - - Delay from the previous operation Output: none Samples Dictionary assignment Param Value value assign_ret = {}

title: Try
text:
Try
 
 
  
  

  
   Try

   Description: 

   Try exception handling statement:

   1.The exception handling logic is used together with catch and finally.

   2.Exceptions that can be handled by the control.

   3.When a control in the subprocess of the control fails to run, a specific exception is thrown. You can set the exception attribute of try to capture the exception.

   4.If an exception is captured, execute the corresponding logic in the catch.

   5.redo_times indicates the number of times that the try logic is executed after catch processing if an exception occurs.

   6.from_error_node indicates whether to execute the control that fails to be executed during retry.

   7.redone_times indicates that if an exception occurs during operation, the try logic will be re-executed after catch processing, and the current number of retries.

   Attributes

   
    
     
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        help

      

      
       
        redo_times

       
        string

       
        When the redo_times attribute is specified, after the catch processes the exception, it starts from the try tag again, and execute the failed action until there is no error or redo_times value is executed.

      

      
       
        redone_times

       
        string

       
        When there is the redo_times attribute, catch handles the exception and then returns to try to continue execution from the failed action position, displaying the current number of retries.

      

      
       
        from_error_node

       
        list

       
        Indicates whether to start execution from an incorrect action during retry upon an error. The default value is True.

name: Identify Image Online
title: Identify Image Online
text:
Identify Image Online
 
 
  
  

  
   getpicinfo_online

   Description: 

   OCR recognizes the picture online and returns the data information in the picture:

   1. Usage guide: use online recognition when there is a network (warm reminder: based on the current data model, the image recognition result cannot be guaranteed to be 100% accurate);

   2. Usage scenario: Mainly identify button screenshots of webpages and apps;

   3. OCR online recognition currently has two data models, noah-scene and noah-doc, which can be selected for use. For details, see the help of parameter ocr-mode;

   4. Method to obtain application user_id and user-key: See https://connect.huaweicloud.com/courses/learn/Learning/sp:cloudEdu_?courseNo=course-v1:HuaweiX+CBUCNXEA006+Self-paced&courseType=1, view Chapter 3, Section 3.2 of the course.

   Input: none

   Parameters: 

   
    
     
      
      
      
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        is_required

       
        default

       
        range

       
        help

      

      
       
        image

       
        file

       
        True

       
        -

       
        png|jpg|jpeg|bmp

       
        Picture path:

        Support png, jpg, jpeg, bmp four formats;

        The recognition languages are Chinese and English and Picture size does not exceed 3M and The pixel size on each side of the image is between 5 and 5120;

        Files of the modified type are not supported

      

      
       
        ocr-online-api

       
        string

       
        -

       
        https://apigw.huawei.com/api/v3/ocr/general-text

       
        -

       
        OCR Cloud API Interface

      

      
       
        user-id

       
        string

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        User ID to access OCR online interface

      

      
       
        user-key

       
        password

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        User Key to access OCR online interface

      

      
       
        ocr-mode

       
        list

       
        -

       
        noah-scene

       
        noah-scene|noah-doc

       
        The data model required by the OCR cloud interface to recognize pictures currently has two models (note that only for picture recognition):

        noah-scene: scene mode, for natural scenes, such as billboards;

        noah-doc: document mode, to identify the pictures converted from documents, such as pictures converted from word documents, pictures converted from PDF documents, and screenshot pictures;

      

      
       
        coordinate

       
        list

       
        -

       
        false

       
        true|false

       
        Whether to return the coordinates corresponding to the identification data. Optional parameter, true returns, false does not return, default does not return

      

      
       
        timeout

       
        number

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded.

      

      
       
        delay

       
        number

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Delay from the previous operation

      

     
    
   

   Output: 

   
    
     
      
      
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        default

       
        range

       
        help

      

      
       
        return

       
        Array

        -

       
        Text in Image

title: Compare Text Similarity
text:
Compare Text Similarity
 
 
  
  

  
   textSimilarityNLP

   Description: 

   For the input source sentence and a set of target sentences (the input text and the target sentence contain special characters, SQL injection may be recognized), the ability to calculate the similarity of the two sets of input texts is provided. This control integrates the Huawei Manas service to obtain application user_id and User-key method: See https://connect.huaweicloud.com/courses/learn/Learning/sp:cloudEdu_?courseNo=course-v1:HuaweiX+CBUCNXEA006+Self-paced&courseType=1, and see Section 3.2 of Chapter 3 of the course.

   Input: none

   Parameters: 

   
    
     
      
      
      
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        is_required

       
        default

       
        range

       
        help

      

      
       
        src-text

       
        string

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        The source sentence, the length should not exceed 5000 words, and the UTF-8 encoding format is used by default

      

      
       
        target-text-list

       
        string

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Target sentence list. the length of each sentence should not exceed 5000 words. The UTF-8 encoding format is used by default

      

      
       
        user-id

       
        string

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        User ID to access OCR online interface

      

      
       
        user-key

       
        password

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        User Key to access OCR online interface

      

      
       
        language

       
        list

       
        -

       
        -

       
        zh-cn|en-us

       
        Specify the language type of the model (such as selecting a language, the source sentence and target sentence list must contain characters of this language)

        1.zh-cn: Chinese;

        2.en-us: English

      

      
       
        domain

       
        list

       
        -

       
        common

       
        common|FITO|CUSTOM_DICT

       
        Specify the domain type, and use common by default. You can use the domain parameter alone or in combination with the other three parameters: fault-code-dictionary, professional-word-dictionary, and unrelated-word-list, which can increase the accuracy of text similarity comparison rate.

        common --- The above three parameters are based on the actual file ID, if not, leave it blank

        FITO --- The above three parameters are based on FITO's exclusive document ID.

        CUSTOM_DICT --- fill in the custom and exclusive file ID for the above three parameters.

      

      
       
        fault-code-dictionary

       
        string

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Fault code dictionary file ID and weight, optional, data type is dictionary, example: {"**********************": 0.9}

        -

       
        -

       
        -

        unrelated-word-list

       
        string

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Irrelevant dictionary file ID, optional, data type is list, example: ["**********************"]

      

      
       
        timeout

       
        number

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded.

      

      
       
        delay

       
        number

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Delay from the previous operation

        default

text:
Automate Classification and Recognition
 
 
  
  

  
   ocrAutoClassification

   Description: 

   Detect the designated ticket (ticket, certificate or other text carrier) to be identified on the positioning picture, and return the structured result of the identification in json format. The interface returns the location coordinates of the ticket to be identified on the picture, the content of the structured identification, and the corresponding category in the form of a list.

   Input: none

   Parameters: 

   
    
     
      
      
      
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        is_required

       
        default

       
        range

       
        help

      

      
       
        img_path

       
        file

       
        True

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Picture path

      

      
       
        request_url

       
        string

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        Request URL. The default interface has been built in and does not need to be set. If you need to enter the information, choose HUAWEI CLOUD My Credential (https://console.huaweicloud.com/iam/?region=cn-north-1#/mine/apiCredentialQuery the project ID corresponding to the HUAWEI CLOUD region code, for example, project ID corresponding to CN North-Beijing 4 (cn-north-4). The URL is /v2/{project_id}/ocr/auto-classification.

      

      
       
        type_list

       
        string

       
        -

       
        -

       
        -

       
        You can specify the ticket to be recognized, and the ticket that does not appear in this list after the designation is not recognized. If not specified, the identification information of all supported category tickets will be returned by default. The input fields are separated by half-width commas (,). For example, if you enter the face of the ID card and the home page of the driving license, then id_card_portrait_side, vehicle_license_front.

        For specific supported ticket types, see Table 4 in https://support.huaweicloud.com/api-ocr/ocr_03_0113.html.

      

      
       
        timeout

       
        number

text:
Merge DataFrame
 
 
  
  

  
   pandas.merge

   Description: 

   Merge DataFrames according to one or more fields, similar to the join operation of database table.List of user-defined parameters:

   1. left_on: The field used for connection in the left data table, multiple fields use the form of an array.

   2. right_on: The field used for connection in the right data table, multiple fields use the form of an array.

   3. left_index: Whether to use the index of the left data table as the connection field, the default is False.

   4. right_index: Whether to use the index of the right data table as the connection field, the default is False.

   5. copy: Whether to copy the data table, the default is True.

   6. indicator: Whether to add a column of data in the result data table, indicating the source of each row of data. The default is False.

   7. Set the type of validation merge:

   one_to_one: Check whether the merged field is unique in the two data tables.

   one_to_many: Check whether the merged field is unique in the left data table.

   many_to_one: Check whether the merged field is unique in the right data table.

   many_to_many: The merge field does not need to be unique in both data tables.

name: Traversing the Table by Row
title: Traversing the Table by Row
text:
Traversing the Table by Row
 
 
  
  

  
   pandasForEachRow

   Description: 

   Traverse the table by row:

   1.Traverse the DataFrame two-dimensional table by row. Any other control can be nested in the subprocess.

   2.The 2D table to be traversed can be referenced only by variables.

   3.The control also supports the normal use of break and continue, that is, stop traversing the 2D table and continue traversing the 2D table.

   Attributes

   
    
     
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        help

      

      
       
        for_each

       
        string

       
        The name of the variable that stores the row data. Use numbers, letters, and underscores.

      

      
       
        of

       
        TableObject

       
        References of Table object to traverse

      

      
       
        index_name

       
        string

       
        Index variable name.Leave blank and use the default variable name index

      

      
       
        is_parallel

       
        list

       
        Concurrently execute the sub-processes that traverse the table.

        Note:

        1. After Parallel Mode is enabled, an independent scope will be used in the sub-process, and modifications to parameters will not affect the values in the context (except for some reference variables that cannot be deep copied);

   toqrcode

   Description: 

   Data generation QR code:

   1. The data is converted to a QR code, which does not have the encryption effect. If the QR code is lost, related information will be disclosed. Therefore, do not use it for private data transmission.

Q-Sender
 
 
  
  

  
   sendQrData

   Description: 

   Sends data in the QR code transmission scheme:

   1. This command is used only in specific scenarios. The receiveQrData command is used at the other end of the transmission. Used to transfer files or data volume when a single QR code cannot be transferred.

   2. This command involves camera shooting. The camera image is not displayed. Align the camera with the receiver screen to adjust the camera.

   Input parameter:

   1. kind: int type, mandatory, data|file, transfer data type (string or file).

   2. qrcode_size: optional, int type, data stored in each QR code.

   3. image_size: optional. The value is an int type. The value is greater than 300 and less than 1200. The length and width of the image to be displayed are the same. If the value is greater than the resolution of the local computer, the screen is adaptive.

   4. position: position of the image to be displayed. The value type is list. The default value is middle.

   5. data: string type. This parameter is mandatory when kind is set to data. It indicates the data character string to be transferred.

   6. file: indicates the absolute path of the file to be transferred. This parameter is mandatory when kind is set to file.

name: Traversing the Model by Row
title: Traversing the Model by Row
text:
Traversing the Model by Row
 
 
  
  

  
   traverseModelData

   Description: 

   Traverse the model by row:

   1.Traverse the model two-dimensional table by row. Any other control can be nested in the subprocess.

   2.The 2D table to be traversed can be referenced only by variables.

   3.The control also supports the normal use of break and continue, that is, stop traversing the 2D table and continue traversing the 2D table.

   Attributes

   
    
     
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        name

       
        type

       
        help

      

      
       
        for_each

       
        string

       
        The name of the variable that stores the row data. Use numbers, letters, and underscores.

      

      
       
        of

       
        string

       
        References of Table object to traverse

      

      
       
        index_name

       
        string

       
        Index variable name.Leave blank and use the default variable name index

      

      
       
        is_parallel

       
        list

       
        Concurrently execute the sub-processes that traverse the table.

        Note:

        1. After Parallel Mode is enabled, an independent scope will be used in the sub-process, and modifications to parameters will not affect the values in the context (except for some reference variables that cannot be deep copied);

        2. Concurrent use of system-level resources (physical mouse, keyboard, etc.) may cause conflicts. Please ensure that system-level resources are not used in the sub-process;

      

      
       
        parallel_max_num

       
        number

       
        Maximum number of concurrent threads, which prevents system resources from being insufficient due to excessive threads(The default maximum number of concurrencies is the number of physical CPU cores of the computer * 2)

      

     
    
   

    Sample

   traverse_model_data

   Create a model object in advance, 'model'：

   
    
     
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        id

       
         filed 1 

       
        filed 2

      

      
       
        1

       
        a1

       
        a2

      

      
       
        2

       
        b1

       
        b2

      

     
    
   

   row_data stores the data of each row.

   Traverse the model object by row and obtain the 'id' in each row.

   
    
     
      
      
     
     
      
       
        Parameter Name

       
        Parameter value transfer

      

      
       
        for_each

       
        row_data

      

      
       
        of

       
        modelName

      

     
    
   

   row_data stores the data of each row.

   1. Invoke Python and use @{row_item}['id'] to obtain the ID of each line, corresponding to '1' and '2'.

name: Execute sql statement
title: Execute sql statement
text:
Execute sql statement database.execute Description: Execute a SQL statement against a relational database. If you execute a query and return all query results, you can execute multiple SQL statements separated by semicolons.postgresql database SQL statements can only use single quotes, Oracle SQL statements can not end with a semicolon Input: name type help reference DBObject Database connection session Parameters: name type is_required default range help sql-statement string True - - In the SQL statement, %s is used as a placeholder, %% for unescaped%. When connecting to the Oracle database, use :1 to indicate the first placeholder. The value starts from 1 and so on. params string - - - parameters required in the sql statement, one sql statement: list form (et: ["xiaohua", 10]); many sql statements: two-dimensional list form (et: [["xiaohua", 10], ["xiaoli", 20]), these two values correspond to the parameters of the sql statement that requires parameters, and the sql statement without parameters is not reflected in this array. execute-type list - one one|many Select whether to execute multiple SQL statements or a single SQL statement. The default value is one. timeout number - - - Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded. delay number - - - Delay from the previous operation Output: name type default range help return String databaseexecute_ret - Result returned by execution of sql statement return_type list - string|list Type of return value Samples Execute multiple sql statements to MySQL database, create database, select database, create table, insert data into table Param Value sql-statement create database test;
use test;
create table student(id int(4) not null primary key auto_increment, name char(20) not null, sex int(4) not null default 0, degree double(16,2));
insert into student values(0,'xiaoming',0,37.2);
insert into student values(7,'joan',1,36.8);
insert into student values(2,'xiaohua',0,37.1);
insert into student values(3,'lucy',0,36.3);
insert into student values(4,'hanmeimei',1,36.7);
insert into student values(5,'lilei',0,37.5);
insert into student values(6,'marry',1,37.6); execute-type many Execute sql statement, select test database Param Value sql-statement use test; Execute the sql statement, create a stored procedure, the procedure name is proctest, the sql statement: select * from student where id>num; the stored procedure is for a specific library, so if you do not link to a specific library, you must first select the library (use dbname;) Param Value sql-statement create procedure proctest(in num int)
begin
select * from student where id>num;
end Insert a data record into the student table of the Oracle database. Param Value sql-statement insert into student(name, age) values(:1, :2) params ["xiaoming", 18] execute-type one Insert multiple data into non-Oracle database Param Value sql-statement use test;insert into student(name, age) values(%s, %s);insert into student(name, age) values(%s, %s) params [["xiaoming", 18],["xiaoli",20]] execute-type many Parent topic: SQL

   getRuntimeInfo

   Description: 

   Get Runtime Info,Including project name (projectName), project version (projectVersion), project start time(startTime), job name(jobName), task tag(taskTag), job mode(jobMode), queue name(queueName), agent name(agentName) , cluster name(clusterName) and agent type(agentType);

   1. When the designer is executed, the return value includes the project name, project version, project startup time, agent name and agent type; the executor name here is the name in the designer management center when it is online, and the name of the designer in the management center when it was online last time when it is offline;

   2. When the executor executes, the return value adds the job name, task tag, and job mode;

   3. The queue name is added to the return value when the management center schedules the queue to start, and the cluster name is added to the return value when the cluster task is started.

   Part of the field return value enumeration value:

        Whether to pause the task. 1. The default value is false, which means that the executor will wait until the human-machine collaborative task is processed, that is, the executor has been occupied by the robot script task and cannot process other robot script tasks.

        -

       
        Timeout interval(ms). After the execution of an atomic command fails, if the execution time does not exceed the set timeout period, the atomic command is retried until the set timeout period is exceeded.,the default value is 600000 ms.

        number

The acquisition method is: @{upload_file_info_ret['space_id']}; 2) Secondly, click the link to pin the customer End Cloud Disk -> Select the enterprise to which the application belongs -> Select the uploaded folder -> Click the copy link -> Copy the spaceId value in the link;

   3. Methods to obtain dentry_id: 1) The first method is to obtain it through the dingding.upload_file control. The returned result is a dictionary consisting of spaceId and dentry_id. The acquisition method is: @{upload_file_info_ret['dentry_id']}; 2) Secondly, click on DingTalk client Dingdisk->Select the company to which the application belongs->Select the uploaded folder->Click to copy the link->Copy the value of fileId in the link;

   4. Method to obtain conversation_id: 1) Copy CorpId in DingTalk developer backend, link: https://login.dingtalk.com/oauth2/challenge.htm?redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fopen-dev.dingtalk.com %2Fdingtalk_sso_call_back%3Fcontinue%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fopen-dev.dingtalk.com%252F%253Fspm%253Dding_open_doc.header.unLogin.openDevBtn&response_type=code&client_id=dingbakuoyxavyp5ruxw&scope=openid+corpid#/;

   3) Scan the QR code generated on the page after calling the interface;

   4) After successfully scanning the QR code, click on the next page to initiate an appeal;

name: Control Description
title: Control Description
text:
Control Description
 
 
  
  

  
   This section describes the controls in Studio.

   
    Restrictions

    
     RPA provides security protection for robots by means of prompt messages, role permission separation, and whitelist control for high-risk commands. However, due to business scenario requirements, users record any operation, develop executable scripts such as Python scripts, execute SQL statements, and run SendKeys to transfer function keys. Therefore, users are liable for the security risks caused by the operations, executable scripts, and function keys. In addition, users can decide not to deliver and execute this type of robots.

     When a job is executed, the robot operates the file system and executes local programs based on orchestrated controls, which occupies the file system, CPU, and memory. You need to consider the impact on the file system and OS when orchestrating these controls.

     If the control references or processes files, the following file types are supported:
      .doc, .docx, .xls, .xlsx, .xlsm, .ppt, .pptx, .json, .zip, .rar, .7z, .gz, .vsd, .gif, .png, .jpg, .jpeg, .pdf, .msg, .oft, .htm, .html, .xml, .svg, .app, .itf, .bm, .jks, .keystore, .patch, .wav, .ico, .mp4, .avi, .bmp, .tif, .tiff, .exe, .dll, .jar, .wsdl, .so, .data, .spl, .apk, .keytab, .txt, .bas, .csv, .tar, .py, .cer, .crt, .pem, .key, and .bat

     In Studio 2.14.0, UI Automation controls, including Java, web, and Win32 playback controls, are added to replace UI common processing controls in versions earlier than 2.14.0. The original UI Common is changed to UI(deprecated) to ensure software compatibility. In the same scenario, these two types of controls cannot be used together. Otherwise, unexpected exceptions may occur.

    

   

   
    Viewing the Control Description

    
     Start Studio.

     In the navigation pane, choose .

     Choose Help > Help Center.

     In the Help Center area, click Help Document to download the Studio help file.

    Exception Example

    <try xmlId="cf619037-d84f-4f7c-b7a1-69206ebff9d5">

<params/>
</action>
</try>
<catch xmlId="ecbbde41-c8a2-4d89-8f36-62a934c4a1b4" exception="RobotError">
<action xmlId="68daf2f9-b077-44f7-80c8-3e43769214ff" driver_type="common" desc="Confirmation dialog box" return="messageBox_ret" fail_on_error="True">
<command>messagebox</command>
<params>
<param name="value">Capture errors</param>
</params>
</action>
</catch>

RobotNoSuchElementException
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Definition

    The NoSuchElement exception occurs because the corresponding element is not found when a web command is used.

   

   
    Exception Example

    <try xmlId="cf619037-d84f-4f7c-b7a1-69206ebff9d5">

<params>
<param name="target">id=uid</param>
</params>

text:
RobotTimeoutError

    <procedure>
