name: Run python Expression (eval)
title: Run python Expression (eval)
text:
Run python Expression (eval)
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Control Description

    The Run python Expression control is used to dynamically calculate the value of an expression. You can use it to perform operations on common data types, such as strings, lists, sets, tuples, and dictionaries.

   

   
    Parameter Description

    
     
      
       Table 1 Control parameter description
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Expression

        
         Python expression to be executed

       

       
        
         Time out

        
         Timeout interval for executing a control operation, in milliseconds

       

       
        
         Delay Before Run

        
         Waiting duration before the control is executed, in milliseconds

       

       
        
         Comment

        
         Result returned after the Run python Expression control is executed.

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Usage Example

    
     Example A: Create a variable named variable, and assign the value of its type to that of typeOfVariable.
      

      

     Example B: Enter 3==3 to the variable named variable, assign the value of its type to that of typeOfVariable, and print the result of typeOfVariable.
      

      

     Example C: Define the set fruits, delete the element pear from the set, and print the result of fruits.
      

      

     Example D: Define the data dictionary tel, add the key-value pair 'David' : '63289438' to tel, and print the result of tel.
      

      

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Control Parameter Description

name: Invoke C#
title: Invoke C#
text:
Invoke C#
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Control Description

    The Invoke C# control is used to call the specified functions of C#.

   

   
    Usage Restrictions

    The .net version on which this control depends must be 4.0 or later. If the version of .net running Windows 7 is earlier than 4.0, this control cannot be used.

   

   
    Parameter Description

    
     
      
       Table 1 Control parameter description
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         DLL File Name

        
         Name of the .dll file to be executed

         
          If the .dll file is stored in %Studio installation directory%\Robot\cfg\plugin, enter the .dll file name.

          If the .dll file is stored in another path, click  and select the file in the corresponding path.

         

       

       
        
         Method Name

        
         Name of the Invoke C# control

         Value format: Space name.Class name.Method name

       

       
        
         Parameters for Class

        
         Class parameter that needs to be transferred when Invoke C# is called

         Separate multiple parameters using commas (,).

       

       
        
         Parameters for Method

        
         Method parameter that needs to be transferred when Invoke C# is called

         Separate multiple parameters using semicolons (;).

         Parameter types of int, float, bool, str, list, tuple, dict, and set are supported.

         
          A parameter of the str type must be enclosed in double quotation marks (").

          A parameter of any type except str (including the variable type) does not need to be enclosed in double quotation marks (")

          If the parameter is a path string, add r before the parameter to prevent it from being escaped, for example, r"path".

         

       

       
        
         Time out

        
         Timeout interval for executing a control operation, in milliseconds

       

       
        
         Delay Before Run

        
         Waiting duration before the control is executed, in milliseconds

       

       
        
         Comment

        
         Result returned after the Invoke C# control is called

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Usage Example

    Customize parameter a whose type is number and value is 111, and then call the ConsoleApp3.calculate.Sub method in the calculate.dll file stored in Robot/cfg/plugin. The class parameters are para1 and para2, and the method parameters are a and 222.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Control Parameter Description

name: Call Function in Python Script
title: Call Function in Python Script
text:
Call Function in Python Script
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Control Description

    The Call Function in Python Script control is used to call the function or script in the Python script.

   

   
    Parameter Description

    
     
      
       Table 1 Control parameter description
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Python File

        
         Name of the Python file to be executed

         Click  and select the file in the corresponding path.

       

       
        
         The Name of the Function Called

        
         Function name of the called Python script

         If this parameter is not set, the entire Python script is called. In this case, the local Python environment is required.

       

       
        
         Function Parameters

        
         Parameter that needs to be transferred when the function or script of the Python script is called

         You can directly enter the parameter value or use the variable @{}. Separate multiple parameters using semicolons (;).

         Parameter types of int, float, bool, str, list, tuple, dict, and set are supported

         If the entire Python script is called, only parameters of the str type can be entered.

         
          A parameter of the str type must be enclosed in double quotation marks (").

          A parameter of any type except str (including the variable type) does not need to be enclosed in double quotation marks (")

          If the parameter is a path string, add r before the parameter to prevent it from being escaped, for example, r"path".

         

       

       
        
         Time out

        
         Timeout interval for executing a control operation, in milliseconds

       

       
        
         Delay Before Run

        
         Waiting duration before the control is executed, in milliseconds

       

       
        
         Comment

        
         Result returned after the function or script of the Python script is called

       

       
        
         Convert the Output Type To

        
         Execution result that can be converted to the string, int, float, or bool type

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Usage Example

    Call the fun_name method in the x.py file stored in F:\test\python and transfer value1, value2, and value3.

          The format of a function key is {Function key} and the function key name is case insensitive. For example, {Ctrl} and {Enter}.

          The format of a combination key is {function key} or {function key}{function key}. For example, {ctrl}a and {ctrl}{shift}a.

name: Send Keys to Web Page
title: Send Keys to Web Page
text:
Send Keys to Web Page
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Control Description

    The Send Keys to Web Page control is used to simulate the keyboard inputs in the specified position of the web page.

   

   
    Parameter Description

    
     
      
       Table 1 Control parameter description
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Target Element

        
         Web page where a function key or combination key is located

         Click  to pick up control elements.

       

       
        
         Simulate Manual Keypress

        
         Whether to simulate manual keyboard pressing

         
          True: A keystroke event is triggered by simulating manual operations.

          False: A keystroke event is triggered by entering the automation API of the target element. In some special scenarios, the page may not respond to the keystroke event triggered by the automation API. In this case, you need to simulate manual triggering.

         

       

       
        
         Function key

        
         Function key or combination key to be sent

         
          The format of a function key is {Function key} and the function key name is case insensitive. For example, {Ctrl} and {Enter}.

          The format of a combination key is {function key} or {function key}{function key}. For example, {ctrl}a and {ctrl}{shift}a.

         

       

       
        
         Wait For Page Ready

        
         Policy for waiting for page loading before a function key or composite key is executed

         
          complete: Wait until the page is loaded, and then perform the function key or function key.

          loading: Press a function key or function key without waiting for the page to be loaded.

         

         The default value is complete.

       

       
        
         Time out

        
         Timeout interval for executing a control operation, in milliseconds

       

       
        
         Delay Before Run

        
         Waiting duration before the control is executed, in milliseconds

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Usage Example

    Press Enter in the Huawei Zone element on the Vmall home page.

name: Parameter and Variable Description
title: Parameter and Variable Description
text:
Parameter and Variable Description
 
 
  
  

  
   This section describes how to use parameters and variables in Studio.

   
    Definition

    
     Parameter: Data transferred from external systems, which cannot be modified. Parameters include global parameters and local parameters. Global parameters can be used in any script but local parameters can be used only in specified scripts.

     Variable: Variable data defined in the system, which can be changed as required. Variables include global variables and local variables (variables) based on their scopes. Global variables can be used in any script but local variables can be used only in specified scripts.

    

   

   
    Creation Method

    
     Start Studio.

     In the navigation pane, click .

     In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

     Create a global parameter.
      
       Under the canvas, click the Global Parameters tab.

       Click the plug sign (+) to add a global parameter.
        

        

        
         
          
           Table 1 Parameter description
          
          
           
           
          
          
           
            
             Name

            
             Description

           

          
          
           
            
             Group

            
             Name of the group to which a global parameter belongs

           

           
            
             Name

            
             Name of a global parameter

           

           
            
             Type

            
             Type of a global parameter

             The following types are supported: Boolean, Number, String, Object, Array, Attachment, Sensitive, Credential, and Attachment List.

           

           
            
             Value

            
             Value of a global parameter

           

           
            
             Description

            
             Description of a global parameter

           

          
         
        

       (Optional) After the configuration is complete, click the plug sign (+) to configure other global parameters.

      

     Create a parameter.
      
       Under the canvas, click the Parameters tab.

       Click Add Data and set parameters.
        

        

        
         
          
           Table 2 Parameter description
          
          
           
           
          
          
           
            
             Name

            
             Description

           

          
          
           
            
             Group

            
             Name of the group to which a parameter belongs

           

           
            
             Name

            
             Parameter name

           

           
            
             Type

            
             Parameter type

             The following types are supported: Boolean, Number, String, Object, Array, Reference, Attachment, and Attachment List.

           

           
            
             Value

            
             Parameter value

           

           
            
             Input/Output

            
             Parameter category

             
              in: Input parameter

              out: Output parameter

             

           

           
            
             Description

            
             Parameter description

           

          
         
        

       (Optional) After the configuration is complete, click Add Data to set other parameters.

      

     Create a global variable.
      
       Under the canvas, click the Global Variables tab.

       Click the plug sign (+) to add a global variable.
        

        

        
          
         
          The following types are supported: Boolean, Number, String, Object, and Array.

         

        

       (Optional) After the configuration is complete, click Add Data to configure other global variables.

      

     Creates a variable.
      
       Under the canvas, click the Variables tab.

       Click Add Data and configure the variable information.
        

        

        
          
         
          The following types are supported: Boolean, Number, String, Object, Array, Reference, Attachment, and Attachment List.

         

        

       (Optional) After the configuration is complete, click Add Data to configure other variables.

      

    

   

   
    Reference Rule

    After a parameter or variable is defined in a script, the parameter or variable can be referenced in other scripts or processes. The rules for referencing parameters and variables are as follows:

    
     The reference format must be @{Parameter name or variable name}.

     You can group variables or parameters and select variables or parameters by group name.

     Parameters or variables can be referenced using the following table and keywords, for example, @{Parameter name or variable name [Index]} and @{Parameter name or variable name ["Key"]}.

     Parameters or variables can be referenced in the text box of a control to dynamically assign values.
      
       The following parameter types are supported: Boolean, Number, String, Array, Object, Sensitive, Credential, Attachment, and Attachment List. If a parameter or variable is of the Sensitive type, the system encrypts the parameter or variable but does not store it. You need to set this parameter or variable when creating a job in RPA Orchestrator.

       The following variable types are supported: Boolean, Number, String, Array, and Object.

      

     Parameters or variables can be referenced in logical condition expressions such as if, while, and for, for example, @{Parameter name or variable name}[Index] and @{Parameter name or variable name}["Key"].

     A maximum of 100 layers of nested references are supported. If more than 100 layers of nested references or cyclic references are used, the parsing of parameters or variables ends.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: References

name: Excel Assistant
title: Excel Assistant
text:
Excel Assistant
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Description

    The Excel assistant on the Excel pickup panel is used to perform operations on cells or areas in a specified Excel file. Five types of operations are preset in the system: Select, Text, Number, Date, and File. If other customized names exist in the name manager of the specified Excel file, StudioE will also load them to the Excel assistant for users.

    

    The functions of each operation type are as follows:

    
     Select: Select a specified cell, area, or sheet in an Excel file.

     Text: Perform operations on cells of an Excel file such as finding, replacing, and inputting the cell content and shifting between uppercase and lowercase.

     Number: Perform operations such as retaining decimals, entering values, and rounding values in cells or cells of an Excel file

     Date: Calculate the working day, obtain the current date, format the date, and enter the date in cells of an Excel file.

     File: Perform operations on cells of an Excel file such as inputting a file path and obtaining a file name.

    

   

   
    Precautions

    
     After you choose excel assistant > Select from Excel, StudioE automatically opens the Excel_helper_****.xlsx file in the save path of the current project for you to select cells or areas.

     When you choose excel assistant > test > Select from Excel, StudioE automatically opens the specified test file for you to select cells or areas. test is the alias of the defined Excel file object. It is displayed only when the specified Excel file is opened using the Open Excel control.

     After selecting cells or areas, click the WeAutomate sheet in the opened Excel file, ensure that the information in Current Selected Area is correct, and click OK.
      

    

   

   
    Usage Example

    Open the text.xlsx file in the F:\test\python directory and write the test in cell A3 on Sheet1 of the file.

    
     Drag the Open Excel control to the canvas and set Excel Path and Excel Object for the control.

     Drag the Write cell control to the canvas and click  on the right of Target Cell.

     Choose excel assistant > test > Select in Excel from the drop-down list box.

     In the test file, click the WeAutomate sheet.

     Select a cell or area based on site requirements and click OK.
      

     Enter test in the Write Contents text box.

name: How Do I Search For the Required Content in a Project?
title: How Do I Search For the Required Content in a Project?
text:
How Do I Search For the Required Content in a Project?
 
 
  
  

  
   Searching in a project helps you quickly locate the required content.

   
    Procedure

    
     Start Studio.

     In the navigation pane, click .

     In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

     Choose Advance > Find in Project or press Ctrl+Shift+F.

     Enter a keyword in the displayed search box.
      

      

      

     In the search results, click the required content to go to its location based on site requirements.
      

      
       If the current page is in the Canvas mode, double-click the search result to go to the location of the required content. If you click the search result, the page will be displayed in the Xml Code mode, and the required content is located by the cursor.

       If the current page is in the Xml Code mode, double-click the search result to go to the location of the required content, and use the cursor to locate the content. If you click the search result, the page will be displayed in the Canvas mode, and the corresponding control is located.

      

      
        
       
        The historical search result is recorded by Studio only after the keyword is searched for and keyword is located by pressing Enter or clicking or double-clicking the search result. When there are a large number of historical search records, click Clear historical search records.

name: How Do I Use the Automation-Related Controls of Machine Vision?
title: How Do I Use the Automation-Related Controls of Machine Vision?
text:
How Do I Use the Automation-Related Controls of Machine Vision?
 
 
  
  

  
   Machine vision–based automation control helps you use AI-related interfaces to operate windows or identify image on enterprise WeChat and DingTalk.

   
    Context

    
     When the machine vision–based automation control is used, other controls can be used only after the Set CV Target Window control is used.

     The recommended AI interfaces are as follows:
      
       URL of the recommended AI interface for enterprise WeChat: https://apigw-02.huawei.com/api/v1/ui-element/detect/wechat

       URL of the recommended AI interface for DingTalk: https://apigw-02.huawei.com/api/v1/ui-element/detect/dingding

      

    

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Use the machine vision–based automation control in the script.
      

      
       Start Studio.

       In the navigation pane, click .

       In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

       Drag the Set CV Target Window control to the canvas, and configure the control information.
        

        

        
         
          
           Table 1 Key parameters
          
          
           
           
          
          
           
            
             Name

            
             Description

           

          
          
           
            
             Window Name

            
             Customized name of the window to be operated

           

           
            
             Window type

            
             Type of the window to be operated

             
              target window: Use the AI-related services to operate a specific UI window.

              target image: Use the AI-related services to annotate and save a specific image.

             

           

           
            
             UI Window Info

            
             Window to be operated. Click  to pick up the corresponding UI window.

             This parameter is displayed only when Window type is set to target window.

           

           
            
             Image Path

            
             Path of the image to be used. Click  to select the path of the image.

             This parameter is displayed only when Window type is set to target image.

           

           
            
             Panel

            
             Target area corresponding to the window or image to be operated

             To set this parameter, perform the following steps:

             
              In the preview area of the control, double-click an image to view the area block of the window or image.

              Select the block name of the area based on site requirements, for example, panel2.

             

           

           
            
             AI interface address

            
             Address for accessing the AI service interface. The information about the annotated image and target control can be returned by accessing the interface. The value of this parameter is that of API URL set during service subscription.

           

           
            
             Token ID

            
             Token ID for accessing the AI service. The value of this parameter is that of Token ID set during service subscription.

             Contact Huawei technical support to obtain the token ID.

           

           
            
             Token Key

            
             Token key for accessing the AI service. The value of this parameter is that of Token Key set during service subscription.

             Contact Huawei technical support to obtain the token key.

           

           
            
             Annotation Map Save Path

            
             Path for storing the image that is annotated by the AI service. Click  and select the path.

             This parameter is displayed only when Window type is set to target image.

           

           
            
             Is Top Window

            
             Whether to pin the window to be operated on top. The options are as follows:

             
              True

              False

             

             This parameter is displayed only when Window type is set to target window.

           

          
         
        

       After the setting is complete, click  in the preview area of the control to refresh the page.

       Drag other controls to the canvas based on site requirements, and configure the control information.
        The following uses the CV Click control as an example to click a specific window.

        

        

      

      

     Use the machine vision–based template to create a project and develop the script.
      

      
       Start Studio.

       In the navigation pane, click .

       In the Create From Template area, select Machine Vision Automation Template and configure the project information.
        

        

       Click Create to go to the project design page.

       Click the Project tab, double-click the required subscript in the script list, and modify the control attributes and control script parameters.
        

        

       Click Save.

       Click Run to execute the script and check whether the function is normal.

      

      

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: FAQs

name: How Do I Obtain the Service Certificate and CRL?
title: How Do I Obtain the Service Certificate and CRL?
text:
How Do I Obtain the Service Certificate and CRL?
 
 
  
  

  
   The digital certificate and CRL of the server can be exported using a browser for being used by Studio.

   
    Procedure

    The following uses Google Chrome as an example to describe how to obtain the digital certificate and CRL of the server.

    
     Use a browser to open the web page of the server.

     Click  on the left of the URL and select Certificate (Valid).

     Export the service certificate.
      

      
       Click the Details tab, and click Copy to File.
        

       Click Next.

       In the displayed Export File Format dialog box, select DER encoded binary X.509 (.CER), and click Next.
        

       Click Browse on the right of File Name, select the directory where the file to be imported is located and enter the file name, and click Next.
        

       Check details about the exported certificate, and click Finish.
        

       In the displayed Certificate Export Wizard dialog box, click OK to save the service certificate to the specified directory.

      

      

     Export the CRL.
      

      
       Click the Details tab, and click CRL Distribution Points in the Field column.
        

       In the content display box in the lower part, copy the URL information.

       Enter the copied URL in the address box of the browser to download the CRL to your local PC.

name: What Do I Do If the Screen Is Locked Because No Operation Is Performed for a Long Time During Script Execution?
title: What Do I Do If the Screen Is Locked Because No Operation Is Performed for a Long Time During Script Execution?
text:
What Do I Do If the Screen Is Locked Because No Operation Is Performed for a Long Time During Script Execution?
 
 
  
  

  
   When the script is executed by an executor, if no operation is performed for a long time, the PC screen is locked, affecting the subsequent script execution. In this case, you can use the Run python Expression control to solve the issue.

   
    Procedure

    
     Start Studio.

     In the navigation pane, click .

     In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

     Configure the screen lock prevention function.
      

      
       Drag the Run python Expression control to the canvas, and click  on the right of Expression.

       In the displayed Expression dialog box, enter the following expression to prevent the screen locking:
        from ctypes import windll

        windll.kernel32.SetThreadExecutionState(0x80000002)

        

       Click OK.

      

      

     Disable the screen lock prevention function.
      

      
       Drag the Run python Expression control to the canvas, and click  on the right of Expression.

       In the displayed Expression dialog box, enter the following expression to disable the screen lock prevention:
        from ctypes import windll

        windll.kernel32.SetThreadExecutionState(0x80000000)

       Click OK.

      

      

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: FAQs

name: How Do I Change Port Configurations of Studio and Assistant?
title: How Do I Change Port Configurations of Studio and Assistant?
text:
How Do I Change Port Configurations of Studio and Assistant?
 
 
  
  

  
   You can modify the port configurations of Studio and Assistant based on site requirements, preventing faults caused because the port is occupied.

   
    Procedure

    
     Change the port number of the Studio recording function and the communication port number between Studio and the executor.
      

      
       Access AppData\Local\HuaweiRPA\public\share in the user directory, for example, C:\Users\test\AppData\Local\HuaweiRPA\public\share.

       Open the communicate.json file, change the values of debug and webservice or async_msg under studio, and save the changes.
        {
	"recorder": {
		"recorder": 58809
	},
	"studio": {
		"debug": 58054,
		"webservice": 57929,
		"async_msg": 58172
	},
	"assistant": {
		"playback_web": 58697,
		"playback_java": 58856,
		"webservice": 58803,
		"websocket": 57909
	}
}
        
         
          
           Table 1 Parameter description (Studio port)
          
          
           
           
          
          
           
            
             Name

            
             Description

           

          
          
           
            
             recorder

            
             Communication port for recording. If the system displays a message indicating that the port is occupied when the recording function is enabled, you can change the port number.

           

           
            
             debug

            
             Communication port for commissioning. If a message is displayed indicating that the port is occupied when the commissioning function is enabled, you can change the port number.

           

           
            
             webservice

            
             Communication port for Studio. If the system displays a message indicating that the webservice port is occupied after Studio is started, you can change the port number.

           

           
            
             async_msg

            
             Communication port for Studio. If the system displays a message indicating that the async_msg port is occupied after Studio is started, you can change the port number.

           

          
         
        

       Restart Studio to make the modifications take effect.

      

      

     Modify the configurations of the communications port between Assistant and the executor.
      

      
       Access AppData\Local\HuaweiRPA\public\share in the user directory, for example, C:\Users\test\AppData\Local\HuaweiRPA\public\share.

       Open the communicate.json file, change the values of playback_web, playback_java, and webservice or websocket under assistant, and save the changes.
        {
	"recorder": {
		"recorder": 58809
	},
	"studio": {
		"debug": 58054,
		"webservice": 57929,
		"async_msg": 58172
	},
	"assistant": {
		"playback_web": 58697,
		"playback_java": 58856,
		"webservice": 58803,
		"websocket": 57909
	}
}
        
         
          
           Table 2 Parameter description (Assistant port)
          
          
           
           
          
          
           
            
             Name

            
             Description

           

          
          
           
            
             playback_web

            
             Web playback communication port. If a message is displayed indicating that the port is occupied when the web playback function is enabled, you can change the port number.

           

           
            
             playback_java

            
             Java playback communication port. If a message is displayed indicating that the port is occupied when the Java playback function is enabled, you can change the port number.

           

           
            
             webservice

            
             Communication port for Assistant. If the system displays a message indicating that the webservice port is occupied after Studio is started, you can change the port number.

           

           
            
             websocket

            
             Communication port for Assistant. If the system displays a message indicating that the websocket port is occupied after Studio is started, you can change the port number.

           

          
         
        

       Restart Assistant to make the modifications take effect.

      

      

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: FAQs

name: What Do I Do If the Message "Internal error in Huawei AntRobot Studio." Is displayed When the License and Web Driver File Fail to Be Imported?
title: What Do I Do If the Message "Internal error in Huawei AntRobot Studio." Is displayed When the License and Web Driver File Fail to Be Imported?
text:
What Do I Do If the Message "Internal error in Huawei AntRobot Studio." Is displayed When the License and Web Driver File Fail to Be Imported?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    The license and web driver file fail to be imported to Studio, and the message "Internal error in Huawei AntRobot Studio." is displayed.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    Port 11483 used by Studio is occupied or <-loopback> exists in Proxy Settings of Windows.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Check whether the port is occupied.
      

      
       Run Windows PowerShell as an administrator to open the Windows PowerShell CLI.

       On the CLI, run the following command:
        netstat -nao|findstr "11483"

        Information similar to the following figure is displayed. In the following figure, 12488 is the process ID of the port.

        

       Right-click the task bar, and choose Task Manager from the shortcut menu.

       Click the Details tab, and view the process corresponding to the process ID.
        

       Right-click the process name, and choose Open file location from the shortcut menu.
        
         If the opened directory is the installation directory of Studio, for example, C:\Program Files\HuaWei\GDE IPA\Studio x.x.x\jre\jre_x64\bin, the process that is running is the required one. In this case, go to the next step.

         If the opened directory is not the installation directory of Studio, the port is occupied by other processes. In this case, right-click the process in Task Manager, and choose End task. Restart Studio.

        

      

      

     Check the proxy settings of Windows.
      

      
       In the Windows Settings dialog box, click Network & Internet.

       In the navigation pane on the left, click Proxy.

       In the Manual proxy setup area, set Address based on site requirements. If the text box under Address contains <-loopback>, delete it.
        

      

      

     Import the license and web driver file again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: FAQs

name: What Do I Do If the File in the Specific Directory Fails to Be Opened?
title: What Do I Do If the File in the Specific Directory Fails to Be Opened?
text:
What Do I Do If the File in the Specific Directory Fails to Be Opened?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    When a control of Studio is used, a file in a specific directory fails to be opened by clicking .

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The file name or the directory where the file is located contains any of the following special characters: \.., \., /.., /., :, *, ?, <, >, |, ", \, and /.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Change the name of the file or the directory where the file is located to ensure that the name does not contain the preceding special characters.

     Use the Rename File control to change the name of file or directory where the file is located, ensuring the name meets the requirements of Studio.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: FAQs

name: What Do I Do If the Java Application Script Fails to Be Recorded?
title: What Do I Do If the Java Application Script Fails to Be Recorded?
text:
What Do I Do If the Java Application Script Fails to Be Recorded?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    
     When a Java application opened by Internet Explorer is recorded in Studio, the related elements cannot be picked up.

     When the Java application script is executed in Studio, in the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, the message "Check whether the target is correct or the jabswitch status is enable." is displayed.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    
     The running roles of Studio and the browser are inconsistent.

     The local Java configuration is incorrect.

    

   

   
    Solution

    
     Start Studio and browser in either of the following ways to ensure that the roles are the same:
      

      
       Start Studio and browser by choosing Run as administrator.

       Start Studio and browser by double-clicking the desktop icons.

      

      

     Record the Java application script again. If the elements still cannot be picked up, perform the following steps:
      

      
       Go to the %WeAutomate Studio installation directory%\jre\jre_x64\bin directory.

       Enter cmd in the address box to access CLI.

       Run the following command to enable the jabswitch function of the local Java environment:
        jabswitch.exe /enable

        When the message "The Java Access Bridge has been enabled." is displayed in the command output, the jabswitch function is successfully enabled.

      

      

     Record the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support.

name: What Do I Do If Inaccurate Elements Are Picked Up During Script Record in the Multi-Monitor Scenario?
title: What Do I Do If Inaccurate Elements Are Picked Up During Script Record in the Multi-Monitor Scenario?
text:
What Do I Do If Inaccurate Elements Are Picked Up During Script Record in the Multi-Monitor Scenario?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    In multi-monitor scenario (such as dual-monitor scenario), when the record function of Studio is used, inaccurate elements are picked up.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The scaling ratios of multiple monitors are different.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Adjust the scaling ratio of each monitor.
      

      
       Right-click a blank area on the desktop, and choose Display settings.

       Select a monitor in the Rearrange your displays area.

       In the Scale and Layout area, set Change the size of text, apps, and other items to 100% (Recommended).
        

       Repeat 1.b and 1.c to set the scaling ratios of other monitors.

      

      

     Restart your PC for the monitor settings to take effect.

     Set Change high DPI settings of the recorded application.
      

      
       The following uses Google Chrome as an example to describe the change method:
       
        Right-click the Google Chrome icon on the desktop, and choose Properties.

        In the Google Chrome Properties dialog box, click the Compatibility tab.

        Click Change high DPI settings.

        In the High DPI scaling override area in the displayed dialog box, select Override high DPI scaling behavior., and set Scaling performed by to System.
         

        Click OK.

       

      

      

     Record the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: FAQs

name: What Do I Do If Variables Referenced in a Control Are Invalid?
title: What Do I Do If Variables Referenced in a Control Are Invalid?
text:
What Do I Do If Variables Referenced in a Control Are Invalid?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    After a variable name is customized in the return value of a control, the customized variable will be invalid when it is being referenced by other controls.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The customized variable name is in the format of "@{xxx}". However, when the variable is referenced by other controls, @{@{xxx}} will be entered. As a result, the variable nesting issue occurs, and Studio cannot identify the reference of the variable.

   

   
    Solution

    Delete @{} from the customized variable name.

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: FAQs

name: What Do I Do If a Script Fails to Be Executed Due to Inconsistent Keys?
title: What Do I Do If a Script Fails to Be Executed Due to Inconsistent Keys?
text:
What Do I Do If a Script Fails to Be Executed Due to Inconsistent Keys?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    The script fails to be executed. The log area under the canvas displays the following error message "[Detail] [NOK][2021-11-12 14:27:19] Complete the execution of [atomic command] [playbackScript.xml Line 4] Get Email(pop) [Get Email(pop)] [NOK] [RobotValueError] [User input error: Login failed. The user name or password may be incorrect.]".

   

   
    Possible Causes

    
     When Studio is uninstalled, the caches and settings to be deleted are selected.
      

      

     Project development and running of Studio are performed on two different PCs.

    

   

   
    Solution

    Before running the script, set the parameter whose type is sensitive or the parameter related to the password in the control, and save the settings.

name: Multiple Users Fail to Open Studio at the Same Time
title: Multiple Users Fail to Open Studio at the Same Time
text:
Multiple Users Fail to Open Studio at the Same Time
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    In the Windows OS, after user A installs and starts Studio, other users fail to log in to the same Windows OS and start Studio.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    In the current version, Studio cannot be used by multiple users. Therefore, only one user can use Studio at the same time.

   

   
    Solution

    Log in to the Windows OS as the administrator, open Task Manager, and check whether other users are using Studio. If yes, contact other users for negotiation. The following uses Windows 10 as an example to describe how to check the version settings.

    
     Log in to the Windows OS as a system administrator.

     Right-click the blank area on the taskbar and select Task Manager.

     Click the Details tab and check whether multiple users exist in the User Name column of the GDE IPA Studio.exe process.
      

      
       If there are multiple users, contact them to ensure that only one user uses and runs Studio at a time.

       If there are no multiple users, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

name: What Should I Do If Automated Operations Cannot Be Performed on Chrome by Multiple Users Using Chrome?
title: What Should I Do If Automated Operations Cannot Be Performed on Chrome by Multiple Users Using Chrome?
text:
What Should I Do If Automated Operations Cannot Be Performed on Chrome by Multiple Users Using Chrome?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    If Chrome is used by multiple users, automated operations such as installing Chrome plugin and recording or running Chrome-related scripts cannot be performed.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    If Chrome is used by multiple users, when Chrome is started, the user selection page is displayed. As a result, the loading of browser resources is affected automated operations fail to be performed.

    

   

   
    Solution

    You can use either of the following methods to rectify the fault based on site requirements:

    
     Do not create multiple users in the Chrome browser.

     If you need to create multiple users in the Chrome browser, deselect Show on startup on the user selection page displayed when you start Chrome.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: FAQs

name: What Do I Do If Removing the Studio License Fails?
title: What Do I Do If Removing the Studio License Fails?
text:
What Do I Do If Removing the Studio License Fails?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    On the Settings > License page of Studio, after you click Remove to delete the imported license, any of the following symptoms occurs in Studio:

    
     The license fails to be removed and the message "Failed to remove the local independent license because of insufficient permissions. Start the license as an administrator and try again." is displayed on Studio.

     The license is successfully removed but it still can be viewed on Studio.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    
     Cause 1: When the license is removed, the Studio login user does not have the administrator permission.

     Cause 2: RPA Orchestrator connected to Studio has an independent license, and Studio automatically obtains the license from RPA Orchestrator and displays it.

    

   

   
    Solution

    To resolve the problem that the Studio login user does not have the administrator permission, perform the following steps:

    
     Start Studio as an administrator.

     On the Settings > License page, click Remove to delete the imported license again.

    

    

    To resolve the problem that Studio automatically obtains the license from RPA Orchestrator, perform the following steps:

    
     Log in to RPA Orchestrator and choose Products and Services > RPA Orchestrator > Workstations > License.

     Click the Independent License tab and click Delete on the right of the independent license used by Studio.

     In the displayed dialog box, click OK.

     Start Studio as an administrator.

     On the Settings > License page, click Remove to delete the imported license again.

name: What Do I Do If the Operation for Opening an Excel Is Blocked but No Error Is Reported and Process Is Not Failed or Stopped?
title: What Do I Do If the Operation for Opening an Excel Is Blocked but No Error Is Reported and Process Is Not Failed or Stopped?
text:
What Do I Do If the Operation for Opening an Excel Is Blocked but No Error Is Reported and Process Is Not Failed or Stopped?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    During the script execution, the Open Excel control is executed for a long time. However, no error is reported, and the process is not failed or stopped.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    Residual Excel processes exist in the system.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Start Studio.

     In the navigation pane, click .

     In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

     Drag the Kill the Excel process. control to the canvas, and make it be followed by the Open Excel control.

     Click Save.

     Click Run to run the script again.

     If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Running Issues

name: What Do I Do When Controls Related to the Mouse Are Invalid During the Script Running?
title: What Do I Do When Controls Related to the Mouse Are Invalid During the Script Running?
text:
What Do I Do When Controls Related to the Mouse Are Invalid During the Script Running?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    When controls related to the mouse in the script are executed, a message is displayed in Studio, indicating that the execution is successful but the corresponding effect is not achieved.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The browser has security settings. It judges that the file upload may bring risks and requires you to move the mouse to prove that the file upload is a manual operation. Otherwise, the script is considered as a malicious script.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Set Simulate Manual Click and Delay before Run for controls related to the mouse.
      

      
       Start Studio.

       In the navigation pane, click .

       In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

       In the canvas, click a control related to the mouse.

       On the Attribute tab page on the right, set Simulate Manual Click to True.

       Set Delay before Run to a proper latency time based on site requirements to make the control be executed after the specified latency.

      

      

     Check whether the address bar blocks pop-ups.
      

      
       Check whether a message is displayed on the right of the address bar of the browser, indicating that a pop-up window is blocked 
        
         Yes: Go to 2.b.

         No: Go to 3.

        

       Cancel the pop-up blocking settings of Google Chrome.
        
         Open Google Chrome, click  in the upper right corner, and select Settings.

         In the navigation pane of the left, click Privacy and security.

         Click Site Settings.

         In the Content area, click Pop-ups and redirects.

         Use either of the following methods for settings based on site requirements:
          
           In the Default behavior area, select Sites can send pop-ups and use redirects.

           In the Customized behaviors area, click Add on the right of Allowed to send pop-ups and use redirects, and enter a specified URL. Click Add.

          

         Restart Google Chrome for the settings to take effect.

        

      

      

     If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

name: What Do I Do If the Message "Could not find module" Is Displayed When an Error Occurs During the Get Data in QR Code Control Execution in a Script?
title: What Do I Do If the Message "Could not find module" Is Displayed When an Error Occurs During the Get Data in QR Code Control Execution in a Script?
text:
What Do I Do If the Message "Could not find module" Is Displayed When an Error Occurs During the Get Data in QR Code Control Execution in a Script?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    The Get Data in QR Code control in the script fails to be executed. In the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, the message "[NOK] (RobotFileNotFoundError) exception details: line:11 Could not find module '%Studio\Robot\components\libzbar-64.dll' (or one of its dependencies). Try using the full path with constructor syntax" is displayed.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The msvcr120.dll file is missing in the Studio installation directory.

   

   
    Solution

    Go to the C:\Windows\System32 directory of your local PC, copy the msvcr120_clr0400.dll file, and rename it as msvcr120.dll.

name: What Do I Do If a Message Indicating that the C++ Library File Does Not Exist Is Displayed During the Script Running?
title: What Do I Do If a Message Indicating that the C++ Library File Does Not Exist Is Displayed During the Script Running?
text:
What Do I Do If a Message Indicating that the C++ Library File Does Not Exist Is Displayed During the Script Running?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    The script fails to be executed. In the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, a message is displayed, indicating that the C++ library file is missing.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The OS does not have the C++ dependency library, which is required for running the script. As a result, the script fails to be executed.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Use a browser to access ISUPCloud at the following URL:
      

      https://isupcloud.huawei.com/group/newsite/app-download?appId=1927

      

     Click  on the left of Reliance Library to expand the corresponding directory.

     In the software package list, click vc .zip to download it.

     Copy the downloaded vc .zip package to the specified directory and decompress it.

     Go to the vc decompression directory\vc++\2015 directory, and double-click vc_redist.x64.exe to install the dependent C++ library.
      

      

      

     Select I agree to the license terms and conditions, and click Install.

     After the installation is complete, click Close.
      

      

      

     Run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

title: What Do I Do If the Message "importerror DLL load failed" Is Displayed When the pandas-related Controls Fail to Be Executed in a Script?
text:
What Do I Do If the Message "importerror DLL load failed" Is Displayed When the pandas-related Controls Fail to Be Executed in a Script?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    The pandas-related controls in the script fail to be executed. In the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, the message "importerror DLL load failed : The specified module could not be found" is displayed.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The DLL file that the pandas-related controls depend on is missing.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Use a browser to access the following URL to download pandas 1.1.3:
      

      URL:

      https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/dd/15/11efbb7b702abb3e5fe54385962bc1bab429ddfd1801c092b9960ea8e476/pandas-1.1.3-cp38-cp38-win_amd64.whl

      

     Use a decompression tool to decompress the downloaded pandas-1.1.3-cp38-cp38-win_amd64.whl file to the specified directory.

     Go to the pandas decompression directory\pandas\_libs\window directory, and copy the concrt140.dll and msvcp140.dll files to the %Studio installation directory%\python\Lib\site-packages\pandas\_libs\window directory.

     Run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

name: Error Message "exception details: Get xml namespace info exception, status code: 502" Is Displayed During Script Running
title: Error Message "exception details: Get xml namespace info exception, status code: 502" Is Displayed During Script Running
text:
Error Message "exception details: Get xml namespace info exception, status code: 502" Is Displayed During Script Running
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    The script fails to be executed. In the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, the error message "[Detail] [NOK][2021-11-05 13:10:38]playbackScript.xml line:4 console.login [Login server] [NOK] (RobotError) exception details: Get xml namespace info exception, status code: 502" is displayed.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    A proxy server is configured in the OS, but 127.0.0.1 is not masked. As a result, Studio fails to communicate with the executor due to network faults.

   

   
    Solution

    The following uses Windows 2010 as an example to describe how to modify the proxy settings of the OS.

    
     On the PC, click Start in the lower left corner and click .

     On the displayed page, click Network & Internet.

     In the navigation pane, choose Network & Internet > Proxy.

     In the Manual proxy setup area, locate the text box under Use the proxy server except for addresses that start with the following entries.. Enter 127.0.0.1 in the text box.

     Click Save.

     Restart the PC for the settings to take effect.

     Run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Running Issues

name: Error Message "pywintypes.com_error: (-2147417851, 'Server exception occurs', None, None)" Is Displayed When the Open Excel File Control in the Script Fails to Be Executed
title: Error Message "pywintypes.com_error: (-2147417851, 'Server exception occurs', None, None)" Is Displayed When the Open Excel File Control in the Script Fails to Be Executed
text:
Error Message "pywintypes.com_error: (-2147417851, 'Server exception occurs', None, None)" Is Displayed When the Open Excel File Control in the Script Fails to Be Executed 
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    The Open Excel File control in the script fails to be executed. In the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, the error message "pywintypes.com_error: (-2147417851, 'Server exception occurs', None, None)" is displayed.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The Excel file cannot be opened because it contains add-ins.

     Open an Excel file and choose File > Options.

     In the navigation pane, choose Add-Ins.

     On the right of Manage, select COM Add-ins and click Go....

     In the Available Add-ins area, deselect FoxitReader PDF Creator COM Add-in and click OK.
      

      

      

     Click OK.

     Close all Excel files and run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

name: What Should I Do If the Invoke C# Control in the Script Fails to Be Called and the Message "XXX has stopped working" Is Displayed?
title: What Should I Do If the Invoke C# Control in the Script Fails to Be Called and the Message "XXX has stopped working" Is Displayed?
text:
What Should I Do If the Invoke C# Control in the Script Fails to Be Called and the Message "XXX has stopped working" Is Displayed?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    The Invoke C# control in the script fails to be called and the system displays the message "XXX has stopped working."

    

    Close the dialog box, open the executor client, click  in the upper right corner, and select Log to view the execution logs. The message "System execution error: Uncaptured exception occurred" is displayed in the log.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The value of the Dll File Name parameter of the Invoke C# control contains Chinese characters, for example, E:\CASE\test.dll. As a result, the .dll file fails to be parsed.

   

   
    Solution

    The following example uses Windows 10 to describe how to set the system locale to resolve the issue that the .dll file path in Chinese fails to be parsed.

    
     Click Start in the lower left corner, and click Control Panel in the System Tools area.

     On the Adjust your computer's settings page, click Clock and Region.

     Click Region.

     In the displayed dialog box, click the Administrative tab.

     Click Change system locale.

     In the displayed dialog box, set Current system locale to Chinese (Simplified, China) and click OK.
      

      

      

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Running Issues

name: Error Message "There is no item named 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in the archive" Is Displayed When the Excel File of an Earlier Version Fails to Be Read During Script Running
title: Error Message "There is no item named 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in the archive" Is Displayed When the Excel File of an Earlier Version Fails to Be Read During Script Running
text:
Error Message "There is no item named 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in the archive" Is Displayed When the Excel File of an Earlier Version Fails to Be Read During Script Running
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    After the script is executed, the Excel file of an earlier version fails to be read. In the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, the error message "KeyError: "There is no item named 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in the archive" is displayed.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The matched Pandas or OpenPyxl cannot be used to read Excel files of earlier versions because the version of the third-party Python library (xlrd) is too late.

   

   
    Solution

    Manually uninstall the third-party Python library xlrd and install xlrd 1.2.0.

    
      
     
      If you use this solution, other scripts that use xlrd may run improperly. Evaluate the risks before using this solution.

     

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Running Issues

name: What Do I Do If the Message "login failed, may be username or password is incorrect" Is Displayed When a Script Is Executed to Send Emails?
title: What Do I Do If the Message "login failed, may be username or password is incorrect" Is Displayed When a Script Is Executed to Send Emails?
text:
What Do I Do If the Message "login failed, may be username or password is incorrect" Is Displayed When a Script Is Executed to Send Emails?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    After the script that uses the SMTP control to send QQ emails is executed, the same sender sends multiple emails consecutively and quickly. On the Log tab page under the canvas, the error message "login failed, may be username or password is incorrect" is displayed.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The frequency for sending emails exceeds the limit of the Tencent mailbox. For details, see https://service.mail.qq.com/cgi-bin/help?subtype=1&&no=1000723&&id=20022.

   

   
    Solution

    To solve this problem, stop sending emails, wait until the email sending frequency decreases, and then resend them.

name: What Do I Do If a Macro in Excel Fails to Be Executed Using a Script?
title: What Do I Do If a Macro in Excel Fails to Be Executed Using a Script?
text:
What Do I Do If a Macro in Excel Fails to Be Executed Using a Script?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    When you execute the script that uses the Run Macro control to run a macro in an Excel file, the macro fails to be executed. In the Log area at the bottom of the canvas, an error message is displayed, indicating that the running of the XX macro fails. The possible cause is that the macro is unavailable in the workbook or all macros are disabled.

    

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The name of a procedure or function to be executed in VBAProject of the Excel file conflicts with the reference name of a cell in the Excel file. For example, the function A1 exists in VBAProject of an Excel file, and A1 indicates that cell A1 is referenced. Therefore, the function name conflicts with the reference name. When you record a macro, the system displays a message indicating that the entered name is invalid even if you set the name to the macro name. Even though you can manually create a macro, the macro cannot be executed.

    

   

   
    Solution

    
     Change the procedure name or function name in the Excel file and ensure that the name does not conflict with the cell reference name.

     Go to the Design page of Studio, and modify the attributes of the Run Macro control.

     Run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Running Issues

name: What Do I Do If Executing the Script to Obtain the Clipboard Content Fails?
title: What Do I Do If Executing the Script to Obtain the Clipboard Content Fails?
text:
What Do I Do If Executing the Script to Obtain the Clipboard Content Fails?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    After the setClipboard component is successfully executed, the getClipboard component fails to be executed. In the Log area under the canvas, the message "thread does not have an open clipboard" is displayed.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    To save content to the clipboard or obtain the clipboard content, you need to open the clipboard and then close it. If the interval between clipboard opening and closing is short, the content fails to be read or written when the system freezes. As a result, the clipboard-related operations fail to be performed.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Return to the Design page of Studio and increase the value of Delay before Run on the right of the getClipboard component.

     Run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Running Issues

name: WeAutomate StudioE Issues
title: WeAutomate StudioE Issues
text:

text:
What Do I Do If the Format of the Content Read from the Excel Cell Is Different from the Actual Format?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    In the Excel file, the content in the cell is specified as 2021/10/12. However, the content read from the cell during the script running is 2021-10-12 00:00:00+00:00. The two formats are different.

    
     Figure 1 Content in the Excel cell
     
    

    
     Figure 2 Content read from the Excel cell after the script running
     
    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    When Excel Assistant is used in the control to read the cell content, Type of the cell is not Text. As a result, the content in the Excel and that read from the Excel by the control are in different formats.

   

   
    Solution

    Before Excel Assistant is used to read the cell content, set Type of the specified cell to Text in the Excel file, and enter the text again. Then, use Excel Assistant to read the cell.

    Symptom

    When a script related to Internet Explorer is executed, in the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, the message "Internet Explorer restricted this webpage from running scripts or ActiveX controls." is displayed.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The Internet Explorer settings restrict the running of scripts or active controls on web pages.

     In the Internet Options dialog box, click Advanced.

     In the Settings area, select Allow active content to run in files on My Computer.

     Click Apply and then OK.

     Restart your PC for the Internet Explorer settings to take effect.

What Do I Do If the Login Page Is Displayed Again When a New Internet Explorer Window Is Opened During the Script Running?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    During the script running, when a new Internet Explorer window is opened, the login page is displayed again, and the message "cookie or session lost" is displayed.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    Residual Internet Explorer processes exist in the system.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Start Studio.

     In the navigation pane, click .

     In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

     Drag the kill process control to the canvas, and make it be followed by the Open Web Page control.

     Click Save.

     Click Run to run the script again.

     If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

    Symptom

    When the Sendkeys control in the script is executed to send key information to a text box, the cursor stays at the beginning of the text. The cursor needs to be placed at the end of the text.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The cursor stays at the beginning of the text, affecting the key information input.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Start Studio.

     In the navigation pane, click .

     In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

     Drag the Sendkeys control to the canvas, and make it be followed by the existing Sendkeys control.

     Click  on the right of Control Information to select the corresponding element, and enter {CTRL}{END} in the Function key text box.

     Click Save.

     Click Run to run the script again.

     If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

     Start Studio.

     In the Recently Edited Items area, click the project name to go to the project design page.

     Click  on the right of Control Information and select the required element.

title: What Do I Do If an Internet Explorer Script Fails to Be Recorded?
text:
What Do I Do If an Internet Explorer Script Fails to Be Recorded?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    An Internet Explorer script fails to be recorded in Studio.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    There are a large number of Internet Explorer processes. As a result, the record function of the Internet Explorer script cannot be used.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Close Studio.

     Right-click the task bar, and choose Task Manager from the shortcut menu.

     Click the Details tab page, right-click the iexplorer.exe process, and choose End task.

     Repeat 3 to end all iexplorer.exe processes.

     Restart Studio. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

    When the Click control in the script is executed, a pop-up fails to be clicked.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    Solution

    
     Open Internet Explorer, click  in the upper right corner, and click Internet Options.

     In the Internet Options dialog box, click Privacy.

     In the Pop-up Blocker area, deselect Turn on Pop-up Blocker.

     Click Apply and then OK.

     Run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

What Do I Do If the Language of the Opened Browser Window Is Inconsistent with Local Configuration During the Use of Local Configuration of Mozilla Firefox?

    The use_local_config parameter of Mozilla Firefox is set to True and the local language is Chinese. When a script related to Mozilla Firefox is executed, the language type of the opened browser window is different from that set for Mozilla Firefox.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    After Mozilla Firefox is uninstalled, there is residual configuration file. When Mozilla Firefox is reinstalled, the original configuration file is used.

   

   
    Solution

    After Mozilla Firefox is uninstalled, delete the configuration file from the C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla directory.

text:
What Do I Do If Elements Fail to Be Picked Up During Web Application Recording?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    
     When a web application opened by Google Chrome is recorded in Studio, the related elements cannot be picked up, and a message is displayed, indicating that the connection to the browser is interrupted and asking you to go to chrome://extensions/ to check whether the browser plugin is correctly installed or enabled.

     Google Chrome scripts fail to be executed in Studio. The log area under the canvas displays the "[Detail] [NOK][2021-12-03 15:19:44]Complete the execution of [atomic command] [playbackScript.xml Line 239] Click a Web Page Element [Click Web Element] [NOK] [RobotWebPluginError] [System execution error: Web plug-in control execution timed out. The playback plug-in is not started or not installed] error message."

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The plugin is not installed in Google Chrome or the WeAutomate plugin is installed but not enabled.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Open Google Chrome, click  in the upper right corner, and choose More tools > Extensions.

     In the extension program list, check whether the WeAutomate Web extension program shown in the following figure exists.
      

      

      
       Yes: Go to the next step.

       No: Perform the following steps to manually install the extension program:
        
         Go to the %Studio installation directory%\public\extension directory.

         Drag the huawei_rpa_web_chrome.crx file to the extension program list of Google Chrome for installation.

         Restart Google Chrome for the installed extension program to take effect.

        

      

      

     Check whether the WeAutomate Web extension program is enabled, that is, the switch in the lower right corner of the extension program is in  state.
      

      
       Yes: Go to the next step.

       No: Click the switch to enable the extension program.

      

      

     Record or run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

name: What Do I Do If a Script Fails to Be Executed Due to Timeout After the Plugin Is Installed?
title: What Do I Do If a Script Fails to Be Executed Due to Timeout After the Plugin Is Installed?
text:
What Do I Do If a Script Fails to Be Executed Due to Timeout After the Plugin Is Installed?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    A script related to Google Chrome fails to be executed. In the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, a message is displayed, indicating that the execution fails due to timeout.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The network is disconnected.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Run Windows PowerShell as an administrator to open the Windows PowerShell CLI.

     Run the following command in CLI to check whether the port is occupied:
      

      netstat -nao|findstr "{Port}"

      
       In the preceding command, {Port} indicates the port number of Studio. To query the port number, access AppData\Local\HuaweiRPA\public\share in the user directory, open communicate.json, and view the value of playback_web under the assistant configuration item.
       
        If the port is in LISTENING state, the port is properly occupied. In this case, contact Huawei technical support.

        If the port cannot be found or the port is not in LISTENING state, the port is abnormal. In this case, go to the next step.

       

      

      

     Run the following command in the CLI to reset the Winsock directory on your local PC:
      

      netsh winsock reset

      
        
       
        Incorrect Winsock protocol configuration may cause the network connection issues. You can run the command to restart the Winsock directory to restore the network. The command is mainly used to re-initialize the network to solve the incorrect parameter issues caused by the software conflicts and viruses.

       

      

      

     If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Google Chrome Issues

title: What Do I Do If a Parameter Error Message Is Displayed When a Script Is Executed in Windows 7?
text:
What Do I Do If a Parameter Error Message Is Displayed When a Script Is Executed in Windows 7?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    When a script is executed in Studio in Windows 7, in the Log area in the lower part of the canvas, the message "DLL load failed while importing win32api: Parameter Error" is displayed.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015 software or the KB3063858 OS patch is not installed.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Use a browser to visit the following URL and download and install Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015:
      

      https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=48145

      

     Based on the PC OS version, use a browser to visit the following URL and install the KB3063858 OS patch:
      

      
       32-bit: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=47409

       64-bit: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=47442

      

      

     Restart your local PC for the installed software or OS patch to take effect.

     Run the script again. If the fault persists, contact Huawei technical support to locate, analyze, and rectify the fault.

name: Installed Plugins Are Displayed as 0 on Extension Management After Studio Is Installed in Windows 7
title: Installed Plugins Are Displayed as 0 on Extension Management After Studio Is Installed in Windows 7
text:
Installed Plugins Are Displayed as 0 on Extension Management After Studio Is Installed in Windows 7
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    After Studio 2.17.0 or 2.18.0 is installed in Windows 7, the number of installed plugins on Extension Management is displayed as 0. As a result, controls in plugins cannot be used.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    Microsoft visual c++ 2015 in Windows 7 needs to be upgraded to Microsoft visual c++ 2015 redistributable update 3.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Download the Microsoft visual c++ 2015 redistributable update 3 installation package.
      

      
       Use a browser to open the page for downloading the Microsoft visual c++ 2015 redistributable update 3 installation package.
        Download URL: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=53587

       Click Download.

       Select the corresponding file based on the OS type (32-bit or 64-bit) and click Next to download the file to the local PC.

      

      

     Go to the local path where the file is downloaded, double-click the installation package, and install the software as prompted.

     After the installation is complete, restart Studio and go to the Extension Management page to install all plugins.

What Should I Do If the Number of Official Plugins Are Displayed as 0 on the Extension Center Page After Studio Is Installed in Windows 7?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    After Studio 2.17.0 or 2.18.0 is installed on Windows 7, choose Extension Center > Installed to check whether the number next to Official is displayed as 0. If yes, controls in the plugin cannot be used.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The KB2533623 patch is not installed in Windows 7. As a result, Studio cannot start Python to automatically install the official plugin.

   

   
    Solution

    
     Download the KB2533623 patch installation package for Windows 7.

     Go to the local path where the file is downloaded, double-click the installation package, and install the software as prompted.

     After the installation is complete, restart Studio and go to the Extension Center page to install all official plugins.
