   If canUseWhenOffline is set to false, the offline status is unavailable. If the value of this property is true (default or specified), the offline service must be configured as well. Otherwise, the obtained data is inaccurate. The configuration method is as follows: In mobilemarket.app, open the mobilemarket_service_config_grid page, configure a service with the same name as serviceId and the service type GETLIST and GET. The GetList service is used to periodically synchronize mobile cache data and server data; therefore, it must be configured as well.

        Obtains the values of system variables provided by the system. For example, #Sys["utc"] is used to obtain the current UTC time. #Sys["now"] is used to obtain the current time. #Sys["localtime"] is used to obtain the current local time. #Sys["username"] is used to obtain the current user name. #Sys["userinfo"] is used to obtain the information about the current user. #Sys["url"] is used to obtain the URL of the current page. #Sys["locale"] is used to obtain the language of the current system. #Sys["location"]is used to obtain the longitude and latitude of the current system.

      

      
       
        #Form[xxx]

       
        Obtains the value of a component in a form. For example, #Form[formPanel1.textInput],formPanel1 indicates the ID of the formPanel component, and textInput indicates the ID of the dataField component.

name: Simple Select
title: Simple Select
text:
Simple Select
 
 
  
  

  
   Properties

   
    
     
      
      
     
     
      
       
        Property Name

       
        Description

      

     
     
      
       
        ID

       
        Component ID

      

      
       
        Label

       
        Component label

      

      
       
        Output

       
        Used to convert loaded data in the query service to display values in a drop-down list. Each option in a drop-down list has two field values: display value and hidden value. For example, {"text": "Label", "value": "Name", "parse_expr": "results"} indicates that the label field returned by a service is converted to the display value in a drop-down list, and that the value of the name field is converted to the value in the drop-down list. parse_expr indicates that the data in the results node of the service will be converted. If output is not configured, the default display value is the value of the text field; the hidden value is the value of the value field; and the default value of parse_expr is results.

      

      
       
        Parameters

       
        Service request parameter, in JSON format

      

      
       
        ParentSelectName

       
        Name of the parent drop-down list of the child filter drop-down list

      

      
       
        PlaceHolder

       
        Default display value

      

      
       
        Read Only

       
        Whether the component is read-only. The value can be true or false.

      

      
       
        Service ID

       
        OWS service, which is generally the GetList service.

      

      
       
        Value

       
        Default

      

      
       
        Visible

       
        Whether the control is visible. A TQL expression is supported. You can determine whether to display the control based on the values of other controls.

      

      
       
        Width

       
        Component width

      

      
       
        Required

       
        Whether the component is mandatory

      

     
    
   

   APIs

   isRequired

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameter: true or false

   Description: whether the control is mandatory

   Example: C("simpleSelect").isRequired(); // simpleSelect indicates the component ID.

   addOptions

   Input parameter (options): a single object or array

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Options in the drop-down list are added.

   Example:

   // Add a single option.

   C("simpleSelect").addOptions({"value":"test1","text":"Text Display Value1"});

   // Add multiple options.

   C("simpleSelect").addOptions([{"value":"test1","text":"Text Display Value1"},

   {"value":"test2","text":"Text Display Value2"}])

   clearOptions

   Input parameters: Boolean. The value can be true or false and these parameters are optional.

   Output parameters: none

   Description: whether a specified option in the drop-down list is cleared. A Boolean value is transferred and the default value is false.

   Example:

   C("simpleSelect").clearOptions();

   reload

   Input parameter: params, in JSON or Object format

   Output parameters: none

   Description: drop-down list for reloading service IDs applicable to a drop-down list. It does not apply to static data drop-down lists.

   Example:

   C("simpleSelect").reload({"testKey":"testValue"});

   setValue

   Input parameters: String

   Output parameters: none

   Description: A value is re-assigned to the drop-down list.

   Example:

   C("simpleSelect").setValue("test");

   setReadOnly

   Input parameters: Boolean. The value can be true or false.

   Output parameters: none

   Description: The drop-down list is set to read-only.

   Example:

   // Set the drop-down list to read-only.

   C("simpleSelect").setReadOnly(true);

   // Set the drop-down list to a selective drop-down list.

   C("simpleSelect").setReadOnly(false);

   Events

   valueChanged

   Description: event triggered when the value changes

   Example:

   C("id").on("valueChanged",function(){

   console.log('aaa')

   })

   change

   Description: event triggered when the value changes

   Example:

   C("id").on("change",function(json){

   console.log(json.value)

   })

   Precautions

   When both static options and services are configured, all the configured data is displayed in the drop-down list.

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Mobile Component Usage Guide

name: Photograph
title: Photograph
text:
Photograph
 
 
  
  

  
   Properties

   
    
     
      
      
     
     
      
       
        Property Name

       
        Description

      

     
     
      
       
        ID

       
        Component ID

      

      
       
        Label

       
        Component label

      

      
       
        Name

       
        Component name

      

      
       
        NeedSubmit

       
        Whether the component can be submitted with the form. The value can be true or false.

      

      
       
        Parameters

       
        Service request parameter in JSON format. The default parameters are task_id, group, and module. task_id and group are mandatory.

      

      
       
        Quality

       
        The options are 1024 * 768, 640 * 480, 320 * 240, and 160 * 120. The default value is null.

      

      
       
        Read Only

       
        Whether the component is read-only. The value can be true or false.

      

      
       
        EnableSystemPhotoSelection

       
        Whether the system album can be selected. true indicates that the system album can be selected, and false indicates that the system album cannot be selected.

      

      
       
        Value

       
        Default

      

      
       
        Visible

       
        Whether the control is visible. A TQL expression is supported. You can determine whether to display the control based on the values of other controls.

      

      
       
        Watermark

       
        Watermark display condition, which is a TQL statement text box. For example, to display the current geographic information, set this parameter to location:#Sys[location]. To display the current time, set this parameter to time:#Sys[localtime]. To display geographical locations, set location_gather_enable to true on the mobilemarket_config_grid page in the mobilemarket.app file to allow location information collection.

      

      
       
        WaterMarkText bold

       
        Whether the watermark text is bold. The value is true or false.

      

      
       
        WaterMarkColor

       
        Watermark color

      

      
       
        WaterMarkText Size

       
        Watermark text font size

      

      
       
        Cache Key

       
        After the configuration, photos can be displayed based on the cache key. You can use #Get to set dynamic parameters, for example, #Get[orderid]. In this way, the caches of different photographing components can be distinguished.

      

     
    
   

   APIs

   isRequired

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: Boolean

   Description: Determine whether the component is mandatory.

   Example:

   C("id").isRequired();

   setParameters

   Input parameters: taskId, group, and item

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Set the taskId, group, and item parameters of the component.

   Example:

   C("id").setParameters(taskId,group,item);

   getValue

   Input parameters: taskId, group, and item of the component to be obtained

   Output parameters: taskId, group, and item

   Description: Set the taskId, group, and item parameters of the component.

   getPictureNum

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: Number

   Description: Obtain the number of photos.

   setReadonly

   Input parameters: Boolean

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Set the component status to read-only.

   getPhotoDetail

   Input parameters: Function

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Call the callback function after obtaining the component details.

   FAQs

   Scenarios

   1. Take photos with watermarks, including the current location information and time.

   Example: link to mobile_sample

   2. Users can select photos from the system album.

   Example: link to mobile_sample

   Precautions

   When the location information needs to be displayed, you need to configure the parameter to specify whether the mobile allows the location information collection.

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Mobile Component Usage Guide

        Component width. Enter a number ranging from 1 to 10000.

      

     
    
   

   APIs

   setStatusByIndex

   Input parameter: index status

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Set the node status based on the node index.

   Example:

   C("step1").setStatusByIndex(4,"succeed");

   setStatusByLabel

   Input parameter: label status

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Set the node status based on the node label.

   Example:

   C("step1").setStatusByLabel("label1","succeed");

   loadData

   Input parameters: serviceId and parameters

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Reload the data rendering node.

   Example:

   C("step1").setStatusByLabel("renderSteps",{});

   Events

   click

   Description: click event. The input parameters are the configuration of the clicked node.

   Example:

        Used to convert the loaded data of the query service to the value displayed in the drop-down list. Each option in the drop-down list has two field values: one displayed value and one hidden value. For example:

        {"text":"label","value":"name","parse_expr":"results"} indicates that the label field returned by the service is converted to the value displayed in the drop-down list and that the value of the name field is converted to the value in the drop-down list. parse_expr indicates that the data in the results node of the service is converted. If Output is not set, the value of the text field is displayed by default and that of the value field is hidden by default. The default value of parse_expr is results.

name: List View
title: List View
text:
List View
 
 
  
  

  
   Properties

   
    
     
      
      
     
     
      
       
        Property Name

       
        Description

      

      
       
        Aggregation Title

       
        List View can classify data of the same type into one category and display the data together. It allows users to configure the title of this type of data, that is, the aggregation title. The format is "#Row[xx]".

      

      
       
        Aside Field

       
        Side title field

      

      
       
        Can Use When Offline

       
        Whether the component is available in offline mode

      

      
       
        Config Aggregation

       
        Fields by which data is aggregated. For example, if this property is set to task_id, task_type, all data with the same task_id and task_type is aggregated into a category.

      

      
       
        Custom Row Template

       
        Custom list display content. Use {{row.xx}} to obtain service data. After a custom template is configured, content is displayed firstly based on the template, and the header field and other configuration items become invalid.

      

      
       
        Empty Message

       
        Default content to be displayed when there is no data.

      

      
       
        Header Field

       
        Field of a service that is used as the title

      

      
       
        Id

       
        Component ID

      

      
       
        Ignore Item Page History

       
        Whether to record the history when a user clicks a list item

      

      
       
        Image Field

       
        Field returned by the service, which is used as the image path.

      

      
       
        Item Identify Field

       
        Field returned by the service, which is used as the unique identifier of the data record.

      

      
       
        Item Url Field

       
        Redirection link

      

      
       
        Link Parameters

       
        Parameter transferred during redirection

      

      
       
        Location

       
        Page to be redirected to. This property has a higher priority than url.

      

      
       
        Page Size

       
        Page size, that is, number of data records to be loaded each time.

      

      
       
        Searchable

       
        Whether the list is searchable. If the property is set to true, the search box is displayed above the list. You are advised to configure the filter item, which is more powerful than the search function.

      

      
       
        Search Field

       
        Field to be used for searching. This property can be used together with Searchable.

      

      
       
        Search PlaceHolder

       
        Placeholder in the search box

      

      
       
        Service Id

       
        List data source

      

      
       
        Service Parameters

       
        Parameters required for obtaining list data

      

      
       
        Summary Field

       
        List content field, which is displayed under the title.

      

      
       
        Support Multiple Select

       
        Whether multiple options can be selected in the list. If this property is set to true, multiple options can be selected but this function is available only when the current page contains only the List View component.

      

      
       
        url

       
        Redirection URL. After a URL is configured, redirection is executed when a list item is clicked.

      

     
    
   

   APIs

   deleteRow

   Input parameters: Number

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Delete the Nth line of the list, and the value of N starts from 0.

   Example:

   C("ComId").deleteRow(1); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   hide

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Hide the list.

   Example:

   C("ComId").hide(); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   show

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Show the list.

   Example:

   C("ComId").show(); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   refresh

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Refresh the list.

   Example:

   C("ComId").refresh(); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   reloadFromCache

   Input parameters: Array

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Refresh the list based on the data transferred from the input parameters.

   Example:

   C("ComId").reloadFromCache([{task_id:"0001",task_type:"CM"},{..}, ...]); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   destroy

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Destroy a component.

   Example:

   C("ComId").destroy(); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   stick

   Input parameters: String:ItemIdField

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Perform the pinning operation based on the transferred flag bit.

   Example:

   C("ComId").stick("0001"); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   unStick

   Input parameters: String:ItemIdField

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Perform the unpinning operation based on the transferred flag bit.

   Example:

   C("ComId").unStick("0001"); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   openMultiSelectMode

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Enter the multi-selection mode.

   Example:

   C("ComId").openMultiSelectMode(); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   closeMultiSelectMode

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Exit the multi-selection mode.

   Example:

   C("ComId").closeMultiSelectMode(); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   getSelectedItems

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: Array

   Description: In multi-selection mode, obtain the selected data.

   Example:

   C("ComId").getSelectedItems(); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   Events

   dataLoaded

   Description: The event is triggered after data loading is complete.

   Example:

   C("id").on("dataLoaded",function(json){

   //do something

   })

   itemClick

   Description: This event is triggered when a row is clicked.

   Example:

   C("id").on("itemClick",function(row){

   //do something

   })

name: List Filter Item
title: List Filter Item
text:
List Filter Item
 
 
  
  

  
   Used to set the filtering item.

   Properties

   
    
     
      
      
     
     
      
       
        Property Name

       
        Description

      

      
       
        Default Value

       
        Default value of the filtering item

      

      
       
        Id

       
        Component ID

      

      
       
        Label

       
        Filtering item label

      

      
       
        Model Key

       
        Model field to be used for filtering

      

      
       
        Operator

       
        Operator. The options are >, <, >=, and <=. This property takes effect when Type is set to select. To use an operator, the filter value must be in the {{xx}} format.

      

      
       
        Options

       
        Static option. This property takes effect only when Type is set to select or multiSelect.

      

      
       
        Output

       
        Used to convert the loaded data of the query service to the value displayed in the drop-down list. Each option in the drop-down list has two field values: one displayed value and one hidden value. This property takes effect only when Type is set to select or multiSelect. For example:

        {"text":"label","value":"name","parse_expr":"results"} indicates that the label field returned by the service is converted to the value displayed in the drop-down list and that the value of the name field is converted to the value in the drop-down list. parse_expr indicates that the data in the results node of the service is converted. If Output is not set, the value of the text field is displayed by default and that of the value field is hidden by default. The default value of parse_expr is results.

      

      
       
        Parameters

       
        This property is used with Service Id and functions as service input parameters.

      

      
       
        Parent Id

       
        Used for filtering. The usage of this property is the same as that of the Simple Select component.

      

      
       
        Parent Key

       
        Used for filtering. The usage of this property is the same as that of the Simple Select component.

      

      
       
        Service Id

       
        This property takes effect only when Type is set to select or multiSelect. It is used to load the filter item data source.

      

      
       
        Type

       
        The options are input, datetime, select, and multiSelect. This property is used to configure different types of filtering items.

      

     
    
   

   Events

   selectFilterChanged

   Description: This vent is triggered when a filtering item is selected.

   Example:

   C("id").on("selectFilterChanged",function(option){

   //do something

   })

   Input parameters:

   Service input parameter in parameters:json format.

   _options:{script:xx, width:xx, height:xx}: VisualScript script configuration

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Reload data.

   Example:

   C("ComId").reload({start:0,limit:10},{script:testWidget,width:200,height:200}); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   destroy()

   Input parameters: none

   Output parameters: none

   Description: Destroy a component.

   Example:

   C("ComId").destroy(); // ComId indicates the component ID.

   Events

   dataLoaded

   Description: The event is triggered after data loading is complete.

   Example:

   C("id").on("dataLoaded",function(json){

   //do something

   })

   beforeInit

   Description: This event is triggered before initialization.

   Example:

   C("id").on("beforeInit",function(json){//do something})

   afterInit

   Description: This event is triggered after initialization.

   Example:

   C("id").on("afterInit",function(json){

   //do something

   })

name: Introduction to the Data Visualization Screen Designer
title: Introduction to the Data Visualization Screen Designer
text:
Introduction to the Data Visualization Screen Designer
 
 
  
  

  
   You can use the data visualization screen designer to develop the data visualization function and modify data on the data visualization screen.

   The difference between data visualization screen orchestration and common UI orchestration is as follows: Common UI orchestration applies to web pages and supports operations on various pages in the system. Data visualization screen orchestration applies to the data visualization on the data visualization screen and integrates visualized information components into a dark black screen.

   

   

   
    Canvas Operations

    
     You can drag a component from the component library on the left to the canvas to add a component.

     You can right-click a component in the canvas and choose Copy, Move To Top, Move To Bottom, Move Up, Move Down, or Delete from the shortcut menu.

     You can select multiple components in the canvas, right-click a component, and choose Create Group from the shortcut menu to combine multiple components into a group for unified management. After being grouped, the components can be nested into another group. You can right-click a component in a group and choose Delete Group from the shortcut menu.

     You can click  in the lower right corner of the canvas to view the shortcut keys supported by the canvas.

     When two or more components are selected at the same time, you can align the components by clicking the Top, Middle, Bottom, Left, Center, or Right button.
      When three or more components are selected at the same time, you can arrange the components horizontally or vertically by clicking the Horizontal or Vertical button.

     When multiple same components are selected at the same time, the properties of the upper-layer components are displayed on the right. You can modify the properties in batches.

    

   

   
    Rapid Reuse of Component Assets

    
     System components: basic components, such as charts, tables, and media, preset in the system.

     Extended components: components that are extended based on basic components, which provide certain service capabilities and apply to certain scenarios. Generally, a component is developed and customized by developers using Pro Code.
      

      

     Block: A block is a combination of multiple components and cards. Developers can save orchestrated data visualization screen components as blocks for personal use or sharing. The system accumulates multiple blocks based on service scenarios for developers to use. When using a block, developers can instantiate, add, delete, or modify the component content in the block.

    

   

   
    Layer

    
     When multiple components are used, you can drag the components to adjust the component display layer.
      

      

     You can double-click a layer to rename it.
      

      

    

   

   
    Data Visualization Screen Card

    You can reuse data visualization screen cards on the data visualization screen.

    

   

   
    Property Configuration

    You can configure properties for the components that have been added to the canvas. The properties that can be configured vary with components.

    

    

   

   
    Event Configuration

    Some components can trigger and respond to events. Event configuration helps call services or scripts.

    

    

   

   
    Script Configuration

    Data visualization screen configurations can be customized through JavaScript and CSS scripts. For details, see Page JS Script Development Guide.

   

   
    Internationalization Configuration

    The title of the data visualization screen and the text in the component can be configured in multiple languages.

    You can configure internationalization resources by adding new internationalization resources or referencing existing ones. For details, see Configuring internationalization by adding an internationalization resource and Configuring internationalization by referencing an internationalization resource.

name: Configuring Basic Information About the Data Visualization Screen
title: Configuring Basic Information About the Data Visualization Screen
text:
Configuring Basic Information About the Data Visualization Screen
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project on which you want to perform operations.

     Access the target module. If there is only one module, it is accessed by default. If there are multiple modules, manually select one.
      

      

      

      

     Choose Data Visualization.

     Click , set the data visualization screen name, and create a data visualization screen.

     Click the blank area in the canvas and configure global page properties in the property area on the right.
      

      
        
       
        
         After you click a blank area in the canvas, the global configuration of the data visualization screen is displayed on the right.

         After you click a component, the property configuration of the component is displayed on the right.

        

       

      

      

     Configure basic properties of the data visualization screen
      

      
       
        
         Table 1 Basic properties of the data visualization screen
        
        
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Property Name

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           Title

          
           Title of the data visualization screen. You can click  to configure multiple languages for the title.

           You can configure internationalization resources by two modes. For details, see 8 and 9.

         

         
          
           Label

          
           Configured label. To configure a label for the data visualization screen, choose Data Visualization, click  (Data Visualization list), and then click Tag Management.

         

         
          
           Display Name

          
           Name displayed in the data visualization screen list. You can set this parameter to a name that is easy to identify.

         

         
          
           Open Level

          
           Openness level of the data visualization screen. The options are:

           
            Module: The data visualization screen can be used only by a module.

            Project: When multiple modules exist in a project, the data visualization screen can be called across modules.

            Public: The data visualization screen is opened and can be called in the system.

           

         

         
          
           Screen Size

          
           Resolution. The following options can be selected from the drop-down list, which can be adjusted:

           
            1366 * 768

            1500 * 1000

            1600 * 900

            1920 * 1080

            3480 * 2080

           

           The recommended resolution is 1280 x 1024 or higher.

         

         
          
           Zoom

          
           Supports auto-fit to the screen size.

         

         
          
           Cover

          
           Click Upload to upload an image from the local PC as the cover. Click Capture to make a screenshot for the cover.

         

         
          
           Direction

          
           When multiple background colors are set, the gradient effect is provided. You can set the gradient direction.

           
            Horizontal: Gradient the background color from left to right.

            Vertical: Gradient the background color from top to bottom.

           

           If only one background color is set, gradient effect is not displayed.

         

         
          
           Background Color

          
           Click the text box and select a color from the palette. You can also enter the color code after the pound key (#).

         

         
          
           Background Image

          
           Click Upload and select an image as the background image.

         

         
          
           Scrollbar Background Color

          
           Background color of the scroll bar when the page content exceeds the page width and the scroll bar needs to be used.

         

         
          
           Scrollbar Slider Color

          
           Slider color of the scroll bar when the page content exceeds the page width and the scroll bar needs to be used.

         

         
          
           Enable watermarking

          
           After this function is enabled, data visualization screen pages can be protected through a watermark. The watermark can be set using the user name, timestamp, or customized content.

         

         
          
           Enabling Copyright Information

          
           After this function is enabled, data visualization screen pages can be protected through a copyright statement. The copyright information can be set through the copyright text or icon.

         

        
       
      

      

     Configure internationalization by adding an internationalization resource.
      

      
       Add a page-specific internationalization resource.  indicates that internationalization can be configured for this field.
        

        

        
         
          
           Table 2 Parameters for configuring the internationalization information
          
          
           
           
          
          
           
            
             Name

            
             Description

           

          
          
           
            
             Resource ID

            
             Resource ID. The value can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and periods (.).

           

           
            
             Save Bundle

            
             Whether to save a created internationalization resource to a bundle

             
              Yes: Select the bundle where the created internationalization resource is to be stored. This bundle has been added to the I18n tab page. After the created internationalization resource is saved to the bundle, the bundle can be reused on other pages based on the openness level of the bundle.

              No: The created internationalization resource is saved in Page Internationalization Resource and can be used only on the current page.

             

           

          
         
        

       Manage the internationalization resources added to Page Internationalization Resource on the I18n tab page.
        

        

       Manage and edit page-specific internationalization resources in a unified manner.
        

        

      

      

     Configure internationalization by referencing an internationalization resource. Before the operation, create an internationalization resource bundle on the I18n tab page.
      

      
       On the I18n tab page, create an internationalization resource bundle and configure the corresponding properties and multi-language data. For details, see Configuring the Internationalization Information.

       In the right pane, click the I18n tab.

       Click + to reference an internationalization resource.
        

        

       In the displayed dialog box, select the configured internationalization resource bundle and establish a reference relationship so that internationalization resources in the bundle can be referenced on the page. If a bundle is added repeatedly, the reference relationship is established only once.
        

        

        Click Confirm. The referenced internationalization resource bundles are displayed on the I18n tab page.

        

        

        

       Click  next to the property for which internationalization needs to be configured. On the Select tab page, select a property from the existing bundles and click Save.
        

        

        
          
         
          
           By default, page-specific internationalization resources can be selected on the Select tab page.

           For a public bundle, you can select it on the Select tab page only when the Quote Internationalization Resource relationship is configured for the bundle.

          

         

        

      

      

     Add a component.
      

      
       Drag a component from the component bar on the left to the designer.

       Select the component and configure component properties on the right to implement personalized display of the component. The properties that can be configured vary with components.

      

      

     Add a block.
      

      
       In the Components area on the left, click the Block tab.

       Select a block and drag it to the designer.

      

      

     Click  to save the page.

    

   

   
    Follow-up Procedure

    
     The effect can be previewed in the develop-state environment.
      

      

     After you choose Data Visualization and click , the data visualization screen list is displayed. You can view and manage the data visualization screens in the current module.
      
       You can disable, enable, edit, preview, and copy a data visualization screen.

       You can manage the customization status. After a data visualization screen is created, it is in the Non-customizable state by default. To allow customization, you can manually change Custom Status to Customizable.

Configuring Data Sources for the Data Visualization Screen
 
 
  
  

  
   In practice, data displayed on the data visualization screen is usually accessed through services or APIs. The following describes how to configure the two data source access modes.

name: Introduction to Data Sources of the Data Visualization Screen
title: Introduction to Data Sources of the Data Visualization Screen
text:
Introduction to Data Sources of the Data Visualization Screen
 
 
  
  

  
   You need to import data to the components displayed on the data visualization screen for visualized display.

   
    Unified data sources: data sources that can be used by all orchestration components on the data visualization screen. After a unified data source is added, you can apply it to any component.

    Independent data sources: data sources configured for a single component and cannot be shared by other components.

   

   Currently, the following data source access modes are supported:

   
    Static data: Fixed values are displayed. This mode applies to the scenario where data is displayed in static mode and does not need to be updated.

    Service: Values are obtained and displayed by calling the orchestration service. This mode applies to the data display in the system.

    API: Values are obtained and displayed by calling APIs. This mode applies to the data display from external systems.

    TQL expression: Model data is obtained using TQL expressions.

    Custom data source: user-defined data sources

    Model: model created based on the current system, which is used as the data source of the data visualization screen.

Configuring Data Sources by Calling a Service
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Prerequisites

    A service has been configured for querying and obtaining data. For details, see Configuring Services.

   

   
    Context

    To obtain data from the current app for display, you need to configure the data source by calling a service.

    For example, visitors added every day need to be displayed on the data visualization screen. The data comes from the models created in the current app and can be accessed by calling a service.

    The following figure shows the model configuration.

    

    

    The model data has been created. The following figure shows the data obtained by the list query service.

    

    

    The following uses the unified data source as an example to describe how to call a service to obtain data and display the data in the component.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project to be operated.

     Access the target module. If there is only one module, it is accessed by default. If there are multiple modules, select a module to access.

     Choose Data Visualization and select the created data visualization screen.

           Name

           Parameters

          
           Set the input parameters of the service.

           
            Name: parameter name

            Value: parameter value

           Filterable

           The filter calls a JavaScript script to convert the output result of the service into the input parameter data. The output result must be in array format, for example, return [data.results].

name: Configuring Data Sources Using TQL Expressions
title: Configuring Data Sources Using TQL Expressions
text:
Configuring Data Sources Using TQL Expressions
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Context

    You can use TQL expressions to directly query model data and use the model data as data sources of the data visualization screen.

    To query model data using TQL expressions and use the model data as data sources of the data visualization screen, Data can be accessed by the frontend must be enabled for the model.

    For example, you need to use TQL expressions to query device information model data. This model contains the status field, which is used to identify device states. The number of assets in different states can be displayed in a pie chart on a data visualization screen.

    To use the model for TQL query, you need to enable the frontend data access function.

    

    

    

    Assume that you need to collect statistics on assets in different device states and display the statistical results in a pie chart. The corresponding TQL statement is as follows:

    select status,count(1) as num from "/office_equipment/office_equipment/office_equ_equipment_mgt" as office_equ_equipment_mgt group by status
   

   In this statement, the group by method is used to group the value of status and count the number of data records in each group. For example, there are three data records whose status is using and two data records whose status is vacant.

   Developers can learn about how to use the TQL syntax by referring to TQL Syntax Reference.

   The following describes how to configure the TQL data sources by configuring the unified data source and using it in a pie chart.

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project to be operated.

     Access the target module. If there is only one module, it is accessed by default. If there are multiple modules, manually select one.

     Choose Data Visualization and select the created data visualization screen.

     Click the Data tab on the right and configure the unified data source.
      

      

      

      
       
        
         Table 1 Parameter description
        
        
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Parameter

          
           Description

         

        
        
         
          
           Data Source Type

          
           TQL expression: You can edit TQL expressions to query data and use the data as the data source of the screen.

         

         
          
           TQL expression

          
           You can directly compile a TQL expression, or click  and enter a TQL expression after being debugged in the TQL expression editing and debugging window.

         

         
          
           Interval

          
           Interval for refreshing data by executing an API

         

         
          
           Parameters

          
           Source of the variable value in the TQL expression

         

         
          
           Filterable

          
           You can click Config Filter to configure a data filter.

           The result returned by the TQL expression is as follows. To facilitate parameter mapping, you can use a filter to obtain only the content under results.

           {
  "resultCode": "0",
  "resultMessage": "Success",
  "result": {
    "total": 2,
    "results": [
      {
        "num": 2,
        "status": "vacant"
      },
      {
        "num": 3,
        "status": "using"
      }
    ]
  }
}

           The filter configuration is as follows:

           return data.result.results; 
           After the filter is enabled, the returned parameter structure is as follows:

           [
  {
    "num": 2,
    "status": "vacant"
  },
  {
    "num": 3,
    "status": "using"
  }
]
           

         

        
       
      

      

     Click Confirm to save the configuration.

     Drag the Pie Chart component from the left pane and select the component in the canvas.

     Click the Data tab on the right and click Edit Data Source.

     Configure data mapping in the component.
      

      

      

      

     Click Confirm.

     View the pie chart effect. The statistics can be properly displayed.
      

      

      

    

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Configuring Data Sources for the Data Visualization Screen

name: Configuring Custom Data Sources
title: Configuring Custom Data Sources
text:
Configuring Custom Data Sources
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Prerequisites

    For custom data sources, you need to develop and upload custom components. For details, see Managing Customized Page Components.

   

   
    Context

    Data displayed on the data visualization screen is static data, API data, or service data by default.

    

    If the data source of a service is not any of the preceding ones, you can customize data sources.

    For example, if a developer wants to define a BIDS data source, the developer needs to customize a page component first. For details, see Managing Customized Page Components.

    The props configuration of the custom component is as follows:

    const props = defineProps({
  dsConfig: Object,
});
    The framework system transfers the dsConfig object as props of the custom component. The dsConfig object stores the data source configuration.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project on which you want to perform operations.

     Access the target module. If there is only one module, it is accessed by default. If there are multiple modules, manually select one.

     Develop a custom data source component by following instructions provided in Managing Customized Page Components and upload the component to the custom component page.
      

      

      

      Obtain the access address of the custom component based on the uploaded custom component. Managing Data Visualization Screen Blocks
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Background

    A block is a combination of multiple components and cards.

    The system accumulates multiple blocks based on service scenarios for developers to use. When using a block, developers can instantiate, add, delete, or modify the component content in the block.

    Developers can save orchestrated data visualization screen components as blocks for personal use or sharing.

   

   
    Procedure

    
     Choose Project Management.

     Select the project on which you want to perform operations.

     Access the target module. If there is only one module, it is accessed by default. If there are multiple modules, manually select one.

     Create a data visualization screen block.
      

      
       Create a data visualization screen.

name: Line Chart
title: Line Chart
text:
Line Chart
 
 
  
  

  
   A category in the line chart component corresponds to only a value. The changes of different data under the same category are displayed after multiple series of data is configured. Lines can be used together with areas to intelligently display the change trend of multi-dimensional data. This section describes how to configure a line chart.

   

   
    Properties

    
     
      
       Table 1 Fundamental properties
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Hidden

        
         Whether to hide a component. If a component is hidden by default, components in the group can no longer use unified data sources.

       

       
        
         Id

        
         Component ID, which can be changed to a required value.

       

       
        
         Size

        
         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

       

       
        
         Position

        
         The value includes the horizontal coordinate and vertical coordinate of the component. The unit is px. The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

       

       
        
         Rotate

        
         Rotation angle of the component with the center as the center point. The unit is degree (°).

       

      
     
    

   

   

   

   
    
     
      Table 2 Common properties
     
     
      
      
     
     
      
       
        Name

       
        Description

      

     
     
      
       
        Color

       
        Several color schemes provided by the system by default. Developers can select a proper color as the chart color.

      

      
       
        Animation

       
        Whether to start the initial animation of a chart.

      

      
       
        Animation Duration

       
        Duration of the initial animation, in milliseconds.

      

      
       
        Animation Easing

       
        Slow-moving effect of the initial animation. For details about different slow-moving effects, see https://www.echartsjs.com/gallery/editor.html?c=line-easing.

      

      
       
        Padding

       
        Drawing grid margin in the rectangular coordinate system.

        Description

        Whether to show a legend.

      

      
       
        Position

       
        Legend display position.

      

      
       
        Icon

       
        Icon of a legend item. ECharts provides the following icon types:

        
         Circle

         Rect

         RoundRect

         Triangle

         Diamond

         Pin

         Arrow

         None

        

      

      
       
        Item Gap

       
        Interval between items in the legend. Horizontal spacing is used for horizontal layout, and vertical spacing is used for vertical layout.

      

      
       
        Item Width

       
        Width of the legend marker.

      

      
       
        Item Height

       
        Height of the legend marker.

If this parameter is not set, the minimum value is automatically calculated to ensure even distribution of axis scales.

       

       
        
         Max

        
         Maximum value of the axis scale. You can set this parameter to Data Max. In this case, the maximum value of the data on the axis is used as the maximum scale. If this parameter is not set, the maximum value is automatically calculated to ensure even distribution of axis scales.

If there are multiple series, add a column of data to the data source, and add the data mapping of the series.

name: Line Stack Chart
title: Line Stack Chart
text:
Line Stack Chart
 
 
  
  

  
   A line stack chart is a type of line chart. You can configure stack properties to stack data of different series layer by layer. The start point of each data series is the end point of the previous data series. The line stack chart can show the trend of each data series or the overall change trend. This section describes how to configure a line stack chart.

   

   
    Properties

    
     
      
       Table 1 Fundamental properties
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Hidden

        
         Whether to hide a component. If a component is hidden by default, components in the group can no longer use unified data sources.

       

       
        
         Id

        
         Component ID, which can be changed to a required value.

       

       
        
         Size

        
         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

       

       
        
         Position

        
         The value includes the horizontal coordinate and vertical coordinate of the component. The unit is px. The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

title: Pie Chart
text:
Pie Chart
 
 
  
  

  
   A pie chart divides a pie into multiple blocks based on the proportion of each category. The total amount of data is represented by a pie. Pie charts are widely used in various fields to show the proportions of different categories. By comparing the sizes of categories by the values of radians, you can quickly understand the proportion of each type of data.

         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

         The value includes the horizontal coordinate and vertical coordinate of the component. The unit is px. The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

text:
Hybrid Chart of Line and Column
 
 
  
  

  
   A hybrid chart of line and column is a type of column chart. It uses column chart and line chart to represent two dimension values of the same category. In this way, the data differences between categories and within each category can be clearly and intelligently displayed within a limited space.

         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

Region Map
 
 
  
  

  
   The region map displays data of different regions on the map. You can configure map data and region value data to display the distribution of map statistics.

         Hidden

         Size

        
         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

       

       
        
         Position

        
         The value includes the horizontal coordinate and vertical coordinate of the component. The unit is px. The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

            Title: Map title, which is used to distinguish different maps on the same page. Therefore, when entering a custom map title, do not name multiple maps on the same page repeatedly.

            JSON Map Data: You can directly enter data or upload the JSON map data to the JSLib and enter the JSLib link. After data is uploaded to JSLib, copy the link ${staticContextPath}/${jslibPrefix}/${tenant_id}/[projectName]/[moduleName]/echartmap/0.0.4/test.json in View List and enter it.

title: Funnel Chart
text:
Funnel Chart
 
 
  
  

  
   A funnel chart is a graphical component used to visualize data changes in a process. Because variable values gradually decrease during the process, a funnel chart is widely used to represent sales channels, recruitment, and order fulfillment processes.

   You can adjust the direction of the funnel chart and then use it as a pyramid chart.

         Size

        
         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

       

       
        
         Position

        
         The value includes the horizontal coordinate and vertical coordinate of the component. The unit is px. The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

Scatter Chart
 
 
  
  

  
   A scatter chart is used to display the distribution of multiple data nodes of two-dimensional data. Multiple data series can be configured.

         Id

        
         Component ID, which can be changed to a required value.

       

       
        
         Size

        
         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

       

       
        
         Position

        
         The value includes the horizontal coordinate and vertical coordinate of the component. The unit is px. The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

   The Tab Panel component provides multiple tabs. Only one tab page can be opened at a time. You can switch between tab pages by clicking them.

   

   

   
    Properties

    
     
      
       Table 1 Fundamental properties
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Hidden

        
         Whether to hide a component. If a component is hidden by default, components in the group can no longer use unified data sources.

       

       
        
         Id

        
         Component ID, which can be changed to a required value.

       

       
        
         Size

        
         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

       

       
        
         Position

        
         The value includes the horizontal coordinate and vertical coordinate of the component. The unit is px. The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

       

       
        
         Rotate

        
         Rotation angle of the component with the center as the center point. The unit is degree (°).

       

      
     
    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 2 Animation Settings
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Carousel

        
         Whether to enable the rotation display mode.

       

       
        
         Duration(s)

        
         Rotation display duration, in seconds.

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       
        Table 3 Basic Properties
       
       
        
        
       
       
        
         
          Name

         
          Description

        

       
       
        
         
          Border

         
          Color at the bottom of the tab page after being selected.

        

       
      
     

    

    
     Default Style
      

      

      
       Font: font style of the unselected tab

      

     Activation Style
      

      

      
       Font: font style of the selected tab

      

    

   

   
    Event

    
     
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Event Name

        
         Description

        
         Callback Parameter

        
         Example

       

      
      
       
        
         value-change

        
         The event is triggered when a button is clicked.

        
         Component ID, for example, {id: "button"}

        
         Spl.EventBus.register("compId", "value-change", (params) => {

         console.log(params);

         })

       

      
     
    

   

   
    APIs

    
     
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         API Name

        
         Description

        
         Parameter

        
         Example

       

      
      
       
        
         hide

        
         Hides the current component.

        
         -

        
         S("compId").hide()

       

       
        
         show

        
         Shows the current component.

        
         -

        
         S("compId").show()

       

       
        
         setCustomStyle

        
         Sets the custom style.

        
         Object. width, height, top, left, and rotate can be set.

        
         S("compId").setCustomStyle({width: xxxx})

name: States Toggle Panel
title: States Toggle Panel
text:
States Toggle Panel
 
 
  
  

  
   The states toggle panel is a (multi-state) content container developed to facilitate content switching. The dynamic panel can include multiple states with each state supporting the deployment of multiple components. The automatic carousel state can be set separately or the tab component can be used to control the status switching. When complex interaction configuration is required between components or pages, such as component switching and page carousel, is required, you can use the states toggle panel to implement this function.

   

   
    Properties

    
     
      
       Table 1 Fundamental properties
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Hidden

        
         Whether to hide a component. If a component is hidden by default, components in the group can no longer use unified data sources.

       

       
        
         Id

        
         Component ID, which can be changed to a required value.

       

       
        
         Size

        
         The value includes width and height of the component. The unit is px.

       

       
        
         Position

        
         The value includes the horizontal coordinate and vertical coordinate of the component. The unit is px. The horizontal coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the left boundary of the page, and the vertical coordinate indicates the pixel distance between the upper left corner of the component and the upper boundary of the page.

       

       
        
         Rotate

        
         Rotation angle of the component with the center as the center point. The unit is degree (°).

       

      
     
    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 2 Basic properties
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Edit States Toggle Panel

        
         You can click it to go to the page for editing the status switching panel.

       

       
        
         Carousel

        
         If you select Yes, the system automatically switches between different states on the panel. This parameter is used together with the period attribute configuration. To use with the tab panel, set this property to No.

       

       
        
         Duration

        
         Duration for switching the status on the states toggle panel

       

      
     
    

    Edit States Toggle Panel

    On the states toggle panel, click +Add a State to add a state. Double-click the state name to change the name. The editing page of the dynamic panel is basically the same as that of the data visualization screen page. In the Basic Properties area on the right, you can set the page for each state and adjust the background color and background image.

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 3 Basic properties
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Background Color

        
         Background color of each state

       

       
        
         Background Image

        
         Background image of each state

       

      
     
    

   

   
    APIs

    
     
      
       Table 4 APIs
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         API Name

        
         Description

        
         Parameter

        
         Example

       

      
      
       
        
         setActiveState

        
         Sets the current display status.

        
         String, status ID or status name

        
         S("compId").setActiveState(xxxx)

       

       
        
         setCustomStyle

        
         Sets the custom style.

        
         Object. width, height, top, left, and rotate can be set.

        
         S("compId").setCustomStyle({width: xxxx})

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Tab Panel for Controlling States Toggle Panel

    The states toggle panel can be used together with the tab panel. The tab panel is used to dynamically control the state switching in the states toggle panel.

    1. Configure the states toggle panel on the data visualization screen page and set Carousel to No.

name: Assistant Panel
title: Assistant Panel
text:
Assistant Panel
 
 
  
  

  
   The Assistant panel is used to build unified intelligent app page interaction components.

   

   
    Properties

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 1 Basic properties
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Id

        
         Unique ID of a component, which is used to bind events and call APIs.

       

       
        
         Size

        
         Width and height of the component

       

       
        
         Position

        
         Position of the component in the canvas

       

       
        
         Rotate

        
         Rotation angle of the component

       

       
        
         Position of the floating button

        
         Position of a floating button in the canvas. After the component is collapsed, the floating button is displayed.

       

      
     
    

    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 2 Common properties
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         (Mandatory) Component name, which is the unique index in some scenarios.

       

       
        
         Theme

        
         Component theme. The skin can be changes in one-click mode.

       

       
        
         Title

        
         Component title

       

       
        
         Font Style

        
         Text style of the title

       

       
        
         Request Config

        
         Method of sending a request to the server after a dialog is sent. The configuration is the same as that of Request Config on the Body tab page. If the parameter is not configured, the request configuration under the common properties is used.

       

      
     
    

    

    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 3 Request Config
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Custom Function

        
         After the custom function is enabled, you need to compile the function for handling requests.

       

       
        
         Request Function

        
         JavaScript script, which is used to send requests to the foundation model and obtain replies.

       

       
        
         Type

        
         SSE and BASIC are supported. BASIC indicates ajax requests, and SSE indicates streaming requests.

       

       
        
         URL

        
         Request URL

       

       
        
         Stream Type

        
         Whether a streaming request is fully or partially returned when Type is set to SSE.

       

       
        
         Pre Request Function

        
         Callback function used before a request is sent. In most cases, this function is used to set parameters.

       

       
        
         Success Function

        
         Handling function after the request succeeds. However, if a service logic is taken over by a custom function, the system does not handle the returned logic any longer.

       

       
        
         Error Function

        
         Handling function after the request fails

       

      
     
    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 4 Header
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Height

        
         Height of the header area

       

       
        
         Background

        
         Background of the header area

         Picture: allows users to set the background image for the element.

         Repeat: allows users to define the repetition mode of the background image. The background image may be repeated along the horizontal axis and/or the vertical axis, or not be repeated at all.

         Color: allows users to set the background color of the element.

         Size: allows users to set the background image size. You can retain its original image size, stretch to a new size, or scale to the size of the available space of the element while retaining its original scale.

         Position: allows users to set the initial position of the background image.

       

       
        
         Actions Config

        
         Definitions on the operation buttons in the upper right corner

         History Record: Displays chat records, and allows users to edit, delete, and resend the records.

         System Settings: indicates a system configuration button, which is used to configure whether to display the profile and the command display mode.

         HTML Panel: indicates a common component, which is used to customize content. For details about the configuration items, see the HTML panel component of the system.

         Button: indicates a common component, which is used to configure common buttons with click events.

         Dropdown Select: indicates a common component that supports custom drop-down options.

         Copilot Select: has similar functions as the drop-down list. Images can be configured.

       

      
     
    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 5 History Record
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Visible Condition

        
         Whether the button is visible and the visibility conditions by returning true or false in the function.

       

       
        
         List Query Function

        
         Request function for querying historical records. If this parameter is not set, the default handling logic is used.

       

       
        
         Update Function

        
         Function for updating historical records. If this parameter is not set, the default handling logic is used.

       

       
        
         Delete Function

        
         Function for deleting historical records. If this parameter is not set, the default handling logic is used.

       

       
        
         Save Function

        
         Function for saving historical records. If this parameter is not set, the default handling logic is used.

       

       
        
         Query Detail Function

        
         Function for querying a single historical record. If this parameter is not set, the default handling logic is used.

       

      
     
    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 6 Buttons
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Click Handler

        
         Handling logic after a button is clicked

       

       
        
         Visible Condition

        
         Whether the button is visible and the visibility conditions by returning true or false in the function

       

      
     
    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 7 Body
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Tabs Config

        
         Content on the tab. Multiple tabs need to be configured. When there is only one tab, the tab is not displayed on the top.

       

       
        
         Tabs Style

        
         Display style of the tab in the normal or activated state

       

      
     
    

    

    

    
     
      
       Table 8 Tab configuration
      
      
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         (Mandatory) Tab name

       

       
        
         Title

        
         Tab title

       

       
        
         Activate

        
         Whether the current tab is activated. Only one activated tab is allowed in the multi-tab scenario.

       

       
        
         Guide Configuration

        
         Content in the wizard area which is displayed when there is no dialog in the dialog box.

       

       
        
         Message Header Config

        
         Custom function. The returned content is displayed as the message title.

       

       
        
         Message Content Config

        
         Prefix and suffix of the message

       

       
        
         User Meta Config

        
         User profile information

       

       
        
         Assistant Meta Config

        
         Assistant profile information

       

       
        
         Actions Config

        
         Shortcut buttons after a dialog is returned

       

       
        
         Input Config

        
         Placeholder, operation button, and input prompt information of the input box

       

       
        
         Request Config

        
         Method of sending a request to the server after a dialog is sent. The configuration is the same as that of Request Config on the tab page. If the parameter is not configured, the request configuration under the common properties is used.

       

      
     
    

   

   
    APIs

    
     
      
       Table 9 APIs
      
      
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Method

        
         Description

        
         Example

       

      
      
       
        
         show

        
         Displays a component.

        
         S("compId").show()

       

       
        
         hide

        
         Hides a component.

        
         S("compId").hide()

       

       
        
         clearScreen

        
         Clears the screen.

        
         S("compId").clearScreen()

       

       
        
         createSession

        
         Creates a session.

        
         S("compId").createSession()

       

       
        
         sendMessage

        
         Sends a message to the foundation model.

        
         S("compId").sendMessage("Hello")

       

       
        
         sendPostBackMessage

        
         Sends an implicit message to the foundation model. The message content is not displayed in the chat box.

        
         S("compId").sendPostBackMessage("Hello")

       

       
        
         mergeExtraParams

        
         Merges parameters into the global variable extraParams.

        
         S("compId").mergeExtraParams({globalName: "copilot"})

       

       
        
         setExtraParams

        
         Sets the value of the global variable extraParams.

        
         S("compId").setExtraParams({globalName: "copilot"})

       

       
        
         focusInput

        
         Enables the input box to obtain the focus.

        
         S("compId").focusInput()

       

       
        
         hideInput

        
         Hides the text box.

        
         S("compId").hideInput()

       

       
        
         showInput

        
         Displays the text box.

        
         S("compId").showInput()

       

       
        
         setGuideConfig

        
         Sets the guide configuration. The parameters are merged into the existing configuration. If tabName exists, the parameters are merged into the specified tab. Otherwise, all the parameters are merged together.

        
         S("compId").setGuideConfig ({title:"Hello Copilot"})

       

       
        
         scrollToBottom

        
         Scrolls the page to the bottom.

        
         S("compId").scrollToBottom()

       

       
        
         setInput

        
         Sets a value for the text box.

        
         S("compId").setInput ("Hello")

       

       
        
         setHelloMessage

        
         Sets a greeting message.

        
         S ("compId").setHelloMessage ("Hello")

       

       
        
         triggerButtonAction

        
         Sets the button triggering action.

        
         S("compId").triggerButtonAction ({"type": "sendEmail","text": "Customer complaint email reply","content": {"emails":["xx@163.com"]}})

       

       
        
         setActiveTab

        
         Sets the activation status based on the tab ID.

        
         S("compId").setActiveTab("tab-1")

       

       
        
         setCustomStyle

        
         Sets the custom style.

        
         Object. width, height, top, left, and rotate can be set.
