name: Function Overview
title: Function Overview
text:
Function Overview
 
 
  
  

  
   A process supports the following condition types: TQL condition, Script condition (JUEL), and Script Condition (TEL). TEL is a new condition added in 2.1.

   
     
    
     
      Only TQL and TEL can be used by new processes.

      TQL, JUEL, and TEL can be used by historical processes.

     

    

   

   During process configuration, condition expressions are used in the following scenarios:

   
    Configure the input parameters of Start Event.

    Configure the output parameters of End Event.

    Configure the skip expression of User Task.

    Configure the conditions of Sequence Flow.
     In the process diagram, components of Event, Activity, and Gateway can be connected to one or multiple Sequence Flow. After the flow conditions are configured for Sequence Flow, the process is executed based on Sequence Flow that meets conditions.

    Configure API Input, API Output, and Fault Handling Policy (Customize Exception) of Service Task.

    Configure the input and output parameters of Call Subprocess.

   

   The following topics mainly describe how to use the Script condition expressions.

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Guidance for the Conditional Expressions

name: Comparison Between JUEL and TEL
title: Comparison Between JUEL and TEL
text:
Comparison Between JUEL and TEL
 
 
  
  

  
   Although JUEL and TEL are two languages with differences in syntax and functions, their functions are basically matched and can be replaced with each other.

   
     
    
     This topic only lists the common TEL specifications of BPM. For details, see the TEL general syntax specifications.

    

   

   
    
     
      
      
      
      
     
     
      
       
        Category

       
        JUEL

       
        TEL

       
        Difference

      

     
     
      
       
        Distinguishing constants and variables

       
        
         Variable: The variable is packaged in ${}, for example, ${api_input.title eq "abc"}.

         Constant: The constant is not packaged in ${}, for example, abc and "abc".

        

       
        
         Variable: The variable is unquoted or is package in double quotation marks ("). A variable that is unquoted must start with a letter, digit, or an underscore (_). A variable that is packaged in double quotation marks (") is escaped using backslashes (\), for example, api_input.title = 'abc' and "api_input"."title" = 'abc'.

         Constant: The constant is packaged in single quotation marks ('), for example, 'api_input.title'.

        

       
        The variable is packaged by ${} in JUEL while the variable is unquoted or is packaged in double quotation marks (") in TEL.

      

      
       
        Variable access

       
        The variable can be accessed through a period (.), get, or square brackets ([]). The following shows examples:

        
         ${api_input.title = "abc"}

         ${api_input."title" = "abc"}

         ${api_input.get("title") = "abc"}

         ${api_input["title"] = "abc"}

        

       
        The variable can be accessed through a period (.) or [index]. The following shows examples:

        
         api_input.title = 'abc'

         api_input.users[0] = 'test'

        

       
        The variable cannot be accessed by using get or ["Variable name"] in TEL.

      

      
       
        Relation operators

       
        
         ==, !=, <, >, <=, >=

         eq, ne, lt, gt, le, ge

        

        For example, ${8 == 8} or ${8 eq 8}. The using method of other operators is similar to the example.

       
        =, !=, <, >, <=, >=

       
        
         Alias is not used in TEL.

         An equal sign (=) is used to indicate equal to in TEL.

         Comparison: Only the comparison between two digits is supported in TEL while the comparison between character strings, JSON (converted to character strings), and digits is supported in JUEL.

        

      

      
       
        Logical operators

       
        and or &&, or or ||, not or !

       
        and, or, !

       
        In TEL, each operator is unique and does not have an alias.

      

      
       
        Arithmetic operators

       
        +, -, *, div or /, mod or %

       
        +, -, *, /, %

       
        In TEL, each operator is unique and does not have an alias.

      

      
       
        Null operation

       
        empty A

        
         If A is a null object, true is returned.

         If A is an empty string, true is returned.

         If A is an empty array, true is returned.

         Otherwise, false is returned.

        

       
        
         string.is_empty(null) = true

         string.is_empty('') = true

         string.is_empty(' ') = false

         string.is_empty('bob") = false

         collection.is_empty(list_input) = false //No data exists in the list.

         collection.is_empty(map_input) = false //No data exists in the map.

         collection.is_empty(null) = true

        

       
        An operator is used to determine whether an object is empty in JUEL while different methods are provided for determining whether an object is empty in TEL.

      

      
       
        Ternary expression

       
        ${A ? B : C}

       
        A ? B : C

       
        The syntax is the same. (For details about how to distinguish variables and constants, see the first item in the table.)

      

      
       
        Common built-in functions

       
        N/A

       
        Multiple functions corresponding to string, math, crypto, collection, and time are provided.

       
        -

      

      
       
        BPM built-in functions

       
        The following functions can be customized for extension:

        
         BpmUtils.isLastTaskSuccess()

         BpmUtils.isAllTaskSuccess()

         BpmUtils.getLastTaskResult()

         BpmUtils.getAllTaskResult()

        

       
        The following functions can be customized based on the TEL extension registration mechanism for extension:

        
         bpm_utils.is_last_task_success()

         bpm_utils.is_all_tasks_success()

         bpm_utils.get_last_task_result()

         bpm_utils.get_all_tasks_result()

        

       
        The customized extension is supported both in JUEL and TEL.

      

     
    
   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Guidance for the Conditional Expressions

name: Operation Object
title: Operation Object
text:
Operation Object
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Obtaining Process Variables and Context Objects

    The expression can be used to obtain and use the process variable or context object. Use a period (.) to obtain an element of an object.

   

   
    The input parameter object of the Start Event node is API_Input, for example, ${API_Input.orderid eq "API-20170624-00000002"}.

    The input and output parameter objects of the Service Task node are API10_input and API10_output. API10 indicates the node ID, for example, ${API10_input.title eq "title1"} and ${API10_output.title eq "title2"}.

    The process context object is _context, which contains the parameters related to the current process instance. The input parameters configured on the debugging page, input and output parameters of the Service Task node, and parameters of Script Task will be automatically written to the process context, for example, ${_context.orderid eq "API-20170624-00000002"}.

   

   
    Using Operation Objects

    For data types such as object, string, array, number, boolean, and null, the corresponding methods of the data types can be called for the expressions to select common JSON objects and character strings of the string type. For details, see the following table.

    
     
      
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Data Type

        
         Calling Method

        
         Example

       

      
      
       
        
         JSON object

        
         get

        
         ${API_Input.get("testtype") eq "test"}

       

       
        
         String type

        
         equals

        
         ${API10_input.get("testtype").equals("test")}

       

       
        
         contains

        
         ${ API10_input.get("testtype").contains("test")}

       

      
     
    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Guidance for the Conditional Expressions

name: Operators
title: Operators
text:
Operators
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Operators Brackets ([]) and Periods (.)

    A period (.) and brackets ([]) can be used to navigate the data.

   

   
    Same usage of a period (.) and brackets ([]):

   

   If the expression is "${_context.orderid} = ${_context[" ordered "]}", both a period (.) and brackets ([]) can be used.

   For example: ${_context.results[0].orderid}

   
    Different usages between a period (.) and brackets ([]):
     
      If the property name contains some special characters, such as a period (.) or en dash (–), only brackets ([]) can be used.

     

     For example, the format of ${API_Input.test-type} is incorrect, the format of ${API_Input["test-type"]} is correct.

     
      If the value is a dynamic value, only brackets ([]) can be used.

     

     For example, in the format of ${_context[API_Input.obtainMode]}, obtainMode is a variable. If the value of obtainMode is orderid, the expression equals to ${_context["orderid"]}. If the value of obtainMode is ticketid, the expression equals to ${_context["ticketid"]}. For this dynamic value, only brackets ([]) rather than a period (.) can be used.

     
      For data types that do not contain keys, such as arrays, a period (.) cannot be used to obtain a value. A value can be obtained using brackets ([]) or get () for such data types.

     

     For example, in the format of ${_context.results[0].orderid} or ${_context.results.get(0).orderid}, results is an array.

   

   
    Relational Operators

    
     The following table lists the relational operators. 
      
       
        
         
         
         
         
        
        
         
          
           Relational Operator

          
           Description

          
           Example

          
           Result

         

        
        
         
          
           eq or ==

          
           Equal to.

          
           ${8 == 8} or ${8 eq 8}

          
           true

         

         
          
           ne or !=

          
           Not equal to.

          
           ${8 != 8} or ${8 ne 8}

          
           false

         

         
          
           lt or <

          
           Less than.

          
           ${6 < 8} or ${6 lt 8}

          
           true

         

         
          
           gt or >

          
           Greater than.

          
           ${6 > 8} or ${6 gt 8}

          
           false

         

         
          
           le or <=

          
           Less than or equal to.

          
           ${6 <= 8} or ${6 le 8}

          
           true

         

         
          
           ge or >=

          
           Greater than or equal to.

          
           ${6 >= 8} or ${6 ge 8}

          
           false

         

        
       
      

    

   

   
    The rule for using relational operators is as follows: A Relational operator B
     
      String objects comparison: If A or B is a string, the other one is also converted into a string. Then, the lexical comparison is performed, that is, the encoding values of the characters in the strings are compared one by one.

      Null objects comparison: If A or B is a string, the other one is also converted into a string. Then, the lexical comparison is performed, that is, the encoding values of the characters in the strings are compared one by one.

      JSON objects comparison: The obtained JSON objects are converted into string objects or null objects, and then the converted objects are compared.

      Number objects comparison: Number objects are compared according to operators.

     

    When the relational operator is used, the writing format must meet related requirements.
     
      For example, the formats ${API_Input.orderid} eq ${_context.orderid} and ${${API_Input.orderid} eq ${_context.orderid} are incorrect.

      The format ${API_Input.orderid eq _context.orderid} is correct.

     

   

   
    Logical Operators

    
     The following table lists the logical operators.

    

    
     
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Logical Operators

        
         Description

        
         Example

        
         Result

       

      
      
       
        
         and or &&

        
         And

        
         ${A && B} or ${A and B}

        
         If the values of both A and B are true, true is returned. Otherwise, false is returned.

       

       
        
         or or ||

        
         Or

        
         ${A || B} or ${A or B}

        
         If the values of both A and B are false, false is returned. Otherwise, true is returned.

       

       
        
         not or !

        
         Not

        
         ${!A} or ${not A}

        
         If the value of A is true, false is returned. If the value of A is false, true is returned.

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Logical operator rule: Perform the preceding operations on A and B or convert them into the boolean type, and then perform the operation based on the operators.

   

   
    Arithmetic Operators

    The following table lists the arithmetic operators.

    
     
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Arithmetic Operator

        
         Description

        
         Example

        
         Result

       

      
      
       
        
         +

        
         Addition

        
         ${8+6}

        
         14

       

       
        
         -

        
         Subtraction

        
         ${8-6}

        
         2

       

       
        
         *

        
         Multiplication

        
         ${8*6}

        
         48

       

       
        
         div or /

        
         Division

        
         ${8/6} or ${8 div 6}

        
         1

       

       
        
         mod or %

        
         Remainder

        
         ${8%6} or ${8 mod 6}

        
         2

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Empty Operators

    Empty operators are used to determine whether an operation object is a null object or empty, for example, ${empty _context.result}.

    The rules for the Empty operator are as follows: empty A

    
     If A is a null object, true is returned.

     If A is an empty string, true is returned.

     If A is an empty array, true is returned.

     Otherwise, false is returned.

    

   

   
    Conditional Operators

    For example: Condition statement: A? The expression "B : C" is "${A?". The meaning of the expression "B: C}" is as follows: If A is true, the result of B is returned. If A is false, the result of C is returned.

   

   
    Built-in Functions

    Application scenarios: Input and output parameters of Service Task.

    
     
      
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Function

        
         Description

        
         Example

       

      
      
       
        
         isLastTaskSuccess()

        
         Checks whether the previous activity is successful and returns a boolean value.

        
         ${BpmUtils.isLastTaskSuccess()}

       

       
        
         isAllTaskSuccess()

        
         Checks whether all previous activities are successful and returns a boolean value.

        
         ${BpmUtils.isAllTaskSuccess()}

       

       
        
         getLastTaskResult()

        
         Obtains the result of the previous activity and returns a value in JSON format.

        
         ${BpmUtils.getLastTaskResult().IsSuccess}

         Returned value example:

         {"ActivityName": "Create Task","ServiceName": "app.service.usermgt.um_user_getList","IsSuccess": true}

       

       
        
         getAllTaskResult()

        
         Obtains the result of all activities and returns a value in JSON format.

        
         ${BpmUtils.getAllTaskResult().API10.ActivityName}

         Returned value example:

         { "API10": { "ActivityName": "Create Task", "ServiceName": "app.service.usermgt.um_user_getList", "IsSuccess": true }}

    Examples

    In the example, if the value of a field is integer but the field type is Long, the actual field can be Long.

   

   
    Constraints

    The develop state is separated from the runtime state. In normal cases, services in the runtime state are not allowed to invoke interfaces in the develop state.

    If the service script is used to call the develop-state interface, the following error message is displayed:

    InvocationException: code=500;msg={source=ADC.COMM.SDK, code=01020000, args=[:Access denied.App not exist in white list.], message=This is system error., solution=Please copy the error information and contact the administrator!, caused_by=null}
    If the develop-state interface needs to be called, ensure that the develop-state interface can be called properly in the service deployment solution. If the deployment solution supports this function, you can enable the invoking permission by enabling the whitelist.

    Function Description

    This API is used to query app parameter details on GDE 24.2. This API applies only to ADC apps and is not used in the GDE AppM scenario.

   

   
    Calling Methods

    POST

   

   
    URI

    /adc-app-mgt/rest/v1/app-mgt/params/query

   

   
    Request Body Parameters

    
     
      
       Table 1 Request body parameters
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         requestDto

        
         AppParameterOpenRequestDto

        
         Yes

        
         Input Parameter of the API for Querying App Parameters

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 2 AppParameterOpenRequestDto
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         app_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Application

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

         Regular expression constraint: ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_\-.]+$

       

       
        
         param_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Parameter

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 50 characters

         Regular expression constraint: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]*$

       

       
        
         param_value

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Set the parameter value.

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 500 characters

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Request Example

    POST /adc-app-mgt/rest/v1/app-mgt/params/query HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
{
	"app_name":"mwTest",
	"param_name":"mwParamName",
	"param_value":"mwValue"
}
   

   
    Response Parameters

    The returned status code is 200, indicating whether the app parameter query is successful. The value true indicates that the query is successful, and the value false indicates that the query fails.

    
     
      
       Table 3 Parameters in the response body
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

Interface for Creating a Data Export Task
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Function

    This API is used to create an Excel/CSV data export task on GDE 24.2. You can export Excel/CSV files based on a specified service or template.

   

   
    Calling Methods

    POST

   

   
    URI

    /adc-batch/rest/v1/export-tasks/actions/create

   

   
    Request body parameters

    
     
      
       Table 1 Request body parameters
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

         Yes

        
         Data Export Task Request

         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         callback

        
         CallBackDto

        
         No

        
         Callback result.

       

       
        
         subTaskType

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Asynchronous Task Source Type

         Regular expression constraint: ^[\u4e00-\u9fa5_a-zA-Z0-9\-]*$

       

       
        
         type

        
         String

        
         Not mandatory

        
         Export task type, which is mandatory. The value can only be csv_export, default_excel, enhanced_excel, jxls or customized_export.

       

       
        
         fileName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         File Name

         Regular expression constraint: ^$|^[^!@& %;,:*?"'<>|#$\/\\]+$

       

       
        
         user

        
         String

        
         No

        
         User Name

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

       

       
        
         encryptExport

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         Encrypt or Not

       

       
        
         templates

        
         Array of String

        
         No

        
         Template

         Minimum quantity: 0

         Maximum number: 20

       

       
        
         extendConfig

        
         JSONObject

        
         No

        
         Extended Configuration

       

       
        
         selectFields

        
         Array of String

        
         No

        
         Selecting fields to be exported

         Minimum quantity: 0

         Maximum number: 500

       

       
        
         selectFieldsExportMode

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Select the export mode of the field to be exported.

       

       
        
         parameters

        
         Object

This interface is used to create a data import task and supports app isolation.
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Function

    This interface is used to create data import tasks in GDE 24.2. App isolation is supported.

   

   
    Calling Methods

    POST

   

   
    URI

    /adc-batch/rest/v2/import-tasks/{project}/create

    
     
      
       Table 1 Request path parameters
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         project

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Request body for creating an import task.

       

      
     
    

    

   

   
    Request body parameters

    
     
      
       Table 2 Request body parameters
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         importTaskDto

        
         DataImportTaskDto

        
         Yes

        
         Importing Tasks

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 3 DataImportTaskDto
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         callback

        
         CallBackDto

        
         No

        
         Callback result.

       

       
        
         subTaskType

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Asynchronous Task Source Type

         Regular expression constraint: ^[\u4e00-\u9fa5_a-zA-Z0-9\-]*$

       

       
        
         type

        
         String

        
         Not mandatory

        
         Import task type, which is mandatory. The value can only be csv, excel, or customized.

       

       
        
         dirPath

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Directory for Storing Files to Be Imported on the File Server

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 65536

       

       
        
         fileToken

        
         String

        
         No

        
         File token.

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 1024 characters

       

       
        
         fileName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         File Name

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 255 characters

       

       
        
         templates

        
         Array of String

        
         No

        
         Template

         Minimum quantity: 0

         Maximum number: 20

       

       
        
         batchImport

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         Indicates whether to import data in batches. The default value is false.

       

       
        
         parameterNode

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Node for Importing Data After Batch Import Is Enabled

         Regular expression constraint: ^[\u4e00-\u9fa5_a-zA-Z0-9\-]*$

       

       
        
         user

        
         String

        
         No

        
         User who initiates the export task. If this parameter is left blank, the current system user is used by default.

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

       

       
        
         inMemory

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         Indicates whether to read data from the memory. This parameter takes effect only when the file size is less than 1 MB.

       

       
        
         tables

        
         Array of CsvTableDto

        
         No

        
         Indicates the import information list. This parameter is specific to the CSV type.

       

       
        
         removeFile

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         Indicates whether to delete the imported file. This parameter is shared by the CSV and Excel types.

       

       
        
         truncateModel

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         Indicates whether to delete model data. This parameter is specific to Excel files.

       

       
        
         parameters

        
         JSONObject

        
         No

        
         Common parameter of the Excel and customized types, which is used to invoke the service request parameter.

       

       
        
         serviceUri

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Special parameter of the customized type, which is used to import the service address.

       

       
        
         serviceMethod

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Special parameter of the customized type, which is used to import a service request method.

         Enumerated value:

         
          
           GET

          
           POST

          
           UPDATE

          
           DELETE

         

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 4 CallBackDto
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         serviceName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         serviceName

       

       
        
         parameter

        
         JSONObject

        
         No

        
         Parameter

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 5 CsvTableDto
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         name

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Regular expression constraint: ^[\u4e00-\u9fa5_a-zA-Z0-9\-]*$

       

       
        
         service

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Regular expression constraint: ^.{0,1024}$

       

       
        
         parameters

        
         JSONObject

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         fileZipType

        
         String

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         fields

        
         Array of CsvFieldDto

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         fileNames

        
         Array of String

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         format

        
         CsvFmtDto

        
         Not mandatory

        
         -

       

       
        
         template

        
         String

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         parameterNode

        
         String

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         batchImport

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         parallel

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         matchLabel

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         -

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 6 CsvFieldDto
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         elementName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         columnNumber

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         columnIndex

        
         String

        
         Not mandatory

        
         -

       

       
        
         tip

        
         String

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         columnName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         -

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 7 CsvFmtDto
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         delimiter

        
         String

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         recordSeparator

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         -

       

       
        
         nullString

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         -

       

       
        
         startRow

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Minimum value: 2

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 8 JSONObject
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         empty

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         -

       

      
     
    

    

   

   
    Request Example

    POST /adc-batch/rest/v2/import-tasks/{project}/create HTTP/1.1

Host: example.com

Content-Type: application/json

Accept: application/json

{
	"callback":{
		"serviceName":"dwgService",
		"parameter":{
			"empty":"boolean"
		}
	},
	"subTaskType":"OrderQuery",
	"type":"excel",
	"dirPath":"/E/test",
	"fileToken":"",
	"fileName":"mwFile",
	"templates":"{
		mw
	}/{
		dwg
	}/{
		tql
	}",
	"batchImport":false,
	"parameterNode":"2",
	"user":"dwgUser",
	"inMemory":true,
	"tables":[
		{
			"name":"string",
			"service":"string",
			"parameters":{
				"empty":"boolean"
			},
			"fileZipType":"string",
			"fields":[
				{
					"elementName":"string",
					"columnNumber":"integer",
					"columnIndex":"string",
					"tip":"string",
					"columnName":"string"
				}
			],
			"fileNames":[
				"string"
			],
			"format":{
				"delimiter":"string",
				"recordSeparator":"string",
				"nullString":"string",
				"startRow":"integer"
			},
			"template":"string",
			"parallel":"boolean",
			"matchLabel":"boolean"
		}
	],
	"removeFile":"boolean",
	"truncateModel":"boolean",
	"parameters":{
		"empty":"boolean"
	},
	"serviceUri":"string",
	"serviceMethod":"string"
}

   

   
    Response parameters

    The returned status code is 200, indicating the task ID.

    
     
      
       Table 9 Parameters in the response body
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         taskId

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Indicates the task ID.

       

      
     
    

    

   

   
    Response Example

    HTTP/1.1 200 OK

Date:Thu,09 Nov 2023 09:57:00 GMT

Server: example.com

Content-Type: application/json

    If the status code is 200:
{
	"6a5ea9d3-36fc-1dwg-86a1-wmw94dnb4f749"
}

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Data Import Task V2

text:
This interface is used to query template information based on the project name, module name, and template name.
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Description

text:
Execute the high-level query service.
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Function Description

    Start with GDE 24.2, Interface script invoked by the instance:

    var request = {

    "start":0,

    "limit":10,

    "title": "a"

    };

    var response = ServiceInvoker.post("/adc-bpm/rest/v1/bpm/query/advance-query?app_name=CompatibilityProject&module_name=PreTestApp&process_name=ID_698_1565921678364&data_model_name=prea_pretype", request);

    var response = {

    "start": 0,

    "total": 1,

    "results": [

    {

    "active": "1",

    "allsubticketclose": "",

    "assign_to_fme: "",

    ...

    }

    ]

    }

   

   
    Calling Methods

    POST

   

   
    URI

    /adc-bpm/rest/v1/bpm/query/advance-query

    
     
      
       Table 1 Parameters in the query request
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         app_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Project

       

       
        
         module_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Module

       

       
        
         process_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Process Name

       

       
        
         data_model_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Name

       

      
     
    

    

   

   
    Request Body Parameters

    
     
      
       Table 2 Request body parameters
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         serviceInput

        
         JSONObject

        
         Yes

        
         Request parameter for executing the advanced query service. The input parameter name comes from the ticket model.

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 3 JSONObject
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         empty

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         -

       

      
     
    

    

   

   
    Request Example

    Host: example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

null&data_model_name=null HTTP/1.1

}
   

   
    Response parameters

    The returned status code is 200, indicating the high query result. For details, see the result class.

    
     
      
       Table 4 Parameters in the response body
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         empty

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         -

       

      
     
    

    

   

   
    Response example

    HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Date:Thu,02 Feb 2023 14:25:47 GMT

text:
Ticket operation API
 
 
  
  

  
   Ticket operation API

  

  
   
    Obtaining Attachment Information Associated with a Ticket

    Query the list of operation records of processing tickets in batches based on specified conditions.

    Query details about the batch processing logs of associated tickets based on the log ID.

    Deleting an Associated Ticket Based on the Associated Ticket ID

    Create a ticket operation log based on the log information in the request parameter list.

    Updating SLA Records of Ticket Suspension and Resumption Based on a Specified Ticket ID

    Supplementing Suspended and Resumed Work Orders

    Associate the original ticket with the ticket in the specified associated ticket list.

    Cancels a ticket and sends an SMS message or email to the handler. (Only tickets in the running state can be canceled.)

    Close the work order and do not send a message.

    Create a service sub-ticket with a specified parent ticket ID.

    Create a service ticket based on the parameter values in the request parameter list. (If the first phase is a manual task, the ticket is automatically transferred to this phase.)

    Delete Ticket

    Escalate the ticket to the specified escalation level.

    Exemption of specified work orders

    Transfer the ticket information to be modified to the request parameter list and modify the corresponding items in the ticket information.

    Transfer the business work order and execute the process instance.

    Used to re-assign a ticket to another ticket handler.

    Resuming a Suspended Ticket

    Create a service ticket based on the parameter values in the request parameter list. (The first manual task node of the ticket is not automatically transferred.)

    Suspend the execution of a work order within the specified suspension start time and end time.

    Transferring a Work Order to Another Work Order Handler

    Send a message based on the specified message type to urge the handler to process the ticket.

title: Deleting a Model Instance
text:
Deleting a Model Instance
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Function

    It starts with GDE24.2. This API is used to delete model instances in batches based on the model URI. For compatibility, use the V2 API. When data model instances are deleted in batches, a maximum of 10,000 data records can be processed. If the number of data records exceeds 10,000, the interface needs to be invoked for multiple times. When elastic model instances are deleted in batches, a maximum of 10,000 data records can be processed by default. You can adjust the upper limit by setting the tenant-level system parameter max-elastic-model-delete-limit. If the number of data records exceeds the upper limit, the interface needs to be invoked for multiple times.

title: Deleting a Model Instance (V2)
text:
Deleting a Model Instance (V2)
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Function Description

    It starts with GDE24.2. This API is used to delete model instances in batches based on TQL conditions. When data model instances are deleted in batches, a maximum of 10,000 data records can be processed. If the number of data records exceeds 10,000, the interface needs to be invoked for multiple times. When elastic model instances are deleted in batches, a maximum of 10,000 data records can be processed by default. You can adjust the upper limit by setting the tenant-level system parameter max-elastic-model-delete-limit. If the number of data records exceeds the upper limit, the interface needs to be invoked for multiple times.

title: Creating a Task
text:
Creating a Task
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Function

    It starts with GDE24.2.

   

   
    Calling Methods

    POST

   

   
    URI

    /adc-rpa/rest/v1/job/create

   

   
    Request Body Parameters

    
     
      
       Table 1 Request body parameters
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         request

        
         ApiRequestBody<JobCreateParam>

        
         Yes

        
         Request Body

       

      
     
    

    
     
     
      
       Table 2 ApiRequestBody<JobCreateParam>
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         channel

        
         Channel

        
         No

        
         Channel

       

       
        
         params

        
         JobCreateParam

        
         No

        
         Input parameters.

       

       
        
         version

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Interface Version

         Regular expression constraint: ^[.a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$

       

       
        
         teamUid

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Unique ID of a team.

       

       
        
         teamName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Team Name

         Regular expression constraint: ^[a-zA-Z0-9\u4E00-\u9FA5][\u4E00-\u9FA5_a-zA-Z0-9-]*$

       

      
     
    

    
     
     
      
       Table 3 Channel
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         name

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Channel

         Regular expression constraint: ^[.a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$

       

      
     
    

    
     
     
      
       Table 4 JobCreateParam
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         jobName

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Task Name

         Regular expression constraint: (^[a-zA-Z\u4E00-\u9FA5]$)|(^[a-zA-Z\u4E00-\u9FA5][\u4E00-\u9FA5_.\x20a-zA-Z0-9-]*[\u4E00-\u9FA5_.a-zA-Z0-9-]$)

       

       
        
         jobType

        
         Integer

        
         Yes

        
         Task type (0: script package task)

       

       
        
         runMode

        
         Integer

        
         Yes

        
         Running mode (1: online task)

       

       
        
         mode

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Trigger type. The options are as follows: once: single execution; repeat: repeated execution; cron: customized cron execution; agentTrigger: client execution.

       

       
        
         screenRecord

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Recording task, which is disabled by default. (0: no; 1: yes)

       

       
        
         queueParams

        
         JobQueueRelation

        
         Yes

        
         Queue parameters

       

       
        
         callback

        
         JobCallback

        
         Yes

        
         Task Callback Parameters

       

       
        
         params

        
         Array of ParameterCseDto

        
         No

        
         Parameter configuration of a script package job

       

       
        
         procedureId

        
         Long

        
         No

        
         Specifies the script ID.

       

       
        
         procedureUid

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Script UID. If both procedureId and procedureUid exist, use procedureUid.

       

       
        
         procedureName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Name of the script package bound to the parameter

         Regular expression constraint: ^[a-zA-Z\u4E00-\u9FA5][\u4E00-\u9FA5_a-zA-Z0-9-]*$

       

       
        
         procedureVersion

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Version of the script package bound to the parameter

         Regular expression constraint: ^[0-9]{1,2}(\.[0-9]{1,2}){2}$

       

       
        
         procedureVersionMatchType

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Script Version Matching Mode of a Task

       

       
        
         processId

        
         Long

        
         No

        
         Process ID (Disabled)

       

       
        
         processUid

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Process UID (Disabled)

       

       
        
         startType

        
         Integer

        
         Yes

        
         Execution type. The options are 1 (immediately), 2 (on a scheduled basis), and 3 (delayed).

       

       
        
         startTime

        
         Long

        
         No

        
         Start time. If the execution type is set to 2, startTime is mandatory. The format is timestamp. The start time must be at least one minute later than the current time.

       

       
        
         delay

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         If the execution type is set to 3, delay is mandatory (min = 0, max = 1440 minutes).

       

       
        
         schedule

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Repeat policy. If mode is set to repeat, schedule is mandatory. The options are times, everyday, and week.

       

       
        
         repeatCount

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Number of repetition times. If mode is set to repeat and schedule is set to times, the number of execution times is mandatory. The value 0 indicates that the task is executed only once, and the value -1 indicates that the task is executed for unlimited times.

       

       
        
         repeatInterval

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Execution interval. If mode is set to repeat and schedule is set to times, this parameter is mandatory. The execution interval cannot be less than 30 seconds or greater than 86400 seconds (24 hours).

       

       
        
         week

        
         String

        
         No

        
         If mode is set to repeat and schedule is set to week, week is mandatory.

         Regular expression constraint: ^([1-7])(,[1-7]){0,6}$

       

       
        
         time

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Scheduled time. If mode is set to repeat and schedule is set to everyday or week, time is mandatory.

         Regular expression constraint: ^(([01][0-9])|(2[0-3])):([0-5][0-9]):([0-5][0-9])$

       

       
        
         endTime

        
         Long

        
         Not mandatory

        
         End time. The end time must be at least 1 minute later than the current time.

       

       
        
         cronList

        
         String

        
         No

        
         List of customized cron expressions. If mode is set to customized cron, cronList is mandatory.

       

       
        
         timeout

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Timeout interval (min = -1,max = 120). If this parameter is not set, the default value 30 minutes is used.

       

       
        
         description

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Task Description (max = 100)

       

       
        
         workstations

        
         Array of Workstation

        
         Yes

        
         List of Executors Associated with a Task

       

       
        
         distributionMode

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Allocation mode when the executor is a cluster. The options are as follows: 0: random allocation; 1: all execution.

       

       
        
         supportConcurrency

        
         Integer

        
         Not mandatory

        
         Indicates whether to enable concurrency. This function is disabled by default. (0: no; 1: yes)

       

       
        
         needCleanEnv

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Indicates whether to clear the environment. This function is enabled by default (1: no; 2: yes).

       

       
        
         rdpConnectSetting

        
         RdpConnectSettingDto

        
         No

        
         RDP Connection Settings

       

       
        
         maxWaitTime

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Maximum waiting time (minutes) (min = -1,max = 1440) If this parameter is not set, the default value 30 minutes is used.

       

       
        
         randomMode

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Random execution mode. The default value is Executor (1: Executor; 2: Cluster).

       

       
        
         priority

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         Execution priority. The default value is low (1: low; 2: medium; 3: high).

       

      
     
    

    
     
     
      
       Table 5 JobQueueRelation
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         id

        
         Long

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         uid

        
         String

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         newData

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         -

       

       
        
         jobUid

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Job UID

       

       
        
         jobName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Task Name

         Regular expression constraint: (^[a-zA-Z\u4E00-\u9FA5]$)|(^[a-zA-Z\u4E00-\u9FA5][\u4E00-\u9FA5_.\x20a-zA-Z0-9-]*[\u4E00-\u9FA5_.a-zA-Z0-9-]$)

       

       
        
         queueUid

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Queue UID

       

       
        
         queueName

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Queue

         Regular expression constraint: ^[a-zA-Z\u4E00-\u9FA5][\u4E00-\u9FA5_a-zA-Z0-9-]*$

       

       
        
         taskCountPerData

        
         Integer

        
         No

        
         One job is triggered for every five pieces of data.

       

       
        
         scanDuration

name: Triggering SLA Recalculation
title: Triggering SLA Recalculation
text:
Triggering SLA Recalculation
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Function

    This function starts from GDE 24.2 and triggers batch recalculation of tickets or SLA instances. The mode parameter specifies the calculation mode. The value can be order or sla_instance. The default value is order. When mode is set to order, batch work order recalculation is triggered. The order_ids parameter cannot be empty. A maximum of 50 work orders are supported. Use commas (,) to separate multiple work orders. If mode is set to sla_instance, SLA instances will be recalculated in batches. The sla_instance_ids parameter cannot be empty. A maximum of 50 SLA instances are supported, which are separated by commas (,). The calculate_type parameter specifies the calculation method. The value can be default, pause_resume_reserved, or calendar_changed. The default value is default. If calculate_type is set to default, SLA instances are re-matched and generated based on the latest SLA configuration and calendar. If calculate_type is set to pause_resume_reserved, SLA instances are re-matched and generated based on the latest SLA configuration and calendar, and the suspension and resumption records are retained. When calculate_type is set to calendar_changed, the calendar in the SLA configuration associated with the SLA instance is updated, and the target time, target value, consumed time, and remaining time of the SLA instance are recalculated.

   

   
    Calling Methods

    POST

   

   
    URI

    /adc-slm/rest/v1/sla/recalculate

   

   
    Request Body Parameters

    
     
      
       Table 1 Request body parameters
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         requestDto

        
         SlaOperationRequestDto

        
         Yes

        
         Recalculate Service Object

       

      
     
    

    
     
     
      
       Table 2 SlaOperationRequestDto
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         mode

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Calculation mode (order|sla_instance)

       

       
        
         calculate_type

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Calculation Method (default|pause_resume_reserved|calendar_changed)

       

       
        
         order_ids

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Work order ID, which is separated by commas (,).

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 5000 characters

       

       
        
         sla_instance_ids

        
         String

        
         No

        
         SLA instance ID, which is separated by commas (,).

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 5000 characters

         Regular expression constraint: ^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-,]*$

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Request Example

    POST /adc-slm/rest/v1/sla/recalculate HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

    Function description

    It starts with GDE24.2. Deletes activities in the customized activity ID list in batches. The IDs of the activities that are successfully deleted are returned.

    Interface script invoked by the instance:

    var request = {
"activity_ids": ["TT10", "TT11"]

var url = "/adc-studio-bpm/rest/v1/custom-nodes/batch-delete";
var response = ServiceInvoker.post(url, request);

Copying Service Information
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Feature

    It starts with GDE24.2. Copy service information.

   

   
    Calling Methods

    POST

   

   
    URI

    /adc-studio-service/rest/v1/service-infos/clone

   

   
    Request body parameters

    
     
      
       Table 1 Request body parameters
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         requestDto

        
         AppServiceInfoCopyRequestDto

        
         Yes

        
         -

       

      
     
    

    

    
     
     
      
       Table 2 AppServiceInfoCopyRequestDto
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         src_project_name

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

       

       
        
         dest_project_name

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

       

       
        
         src_module_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

       

       
        
         dest_module_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

       

       
        
         src_service_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 250 characters

       

       
        
         dest_service_name

        
         String

        
         Yes

        
         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 250 characters

       

       
        
         copy_script

        
         Boolean

        
         No

        
         Whether to copy the script

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Request Example

    POST /adc-studio-service/rest/v1/service-infos/clone HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json
{
	"src_project_name":"string",
	"dest_project_name":"string",
	"src_module_name":"string",
	"dest_module_name":"string",
	"src_service_name":"string",
	"dest_service_name":"string",
	"copy_script":true
}
    

    

   

   
    Response parameters

    If the returned status code is 200, the service copy result is returned.

    Response parameters: none

text:
Querying Service Information in Pagination Mode
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Function Description

    It starts with GDE24.2. This API is used to query service information by page.

   

   
    Invoking method

    GET

   

   
    URI

    /adc-studio-service/rest/v1/service-infos

    
     
      
       Table 1 Parameters in the query request
      
      
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Mandatory or Not (Y/N)

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         project_name

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Project Name

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

         Regular expression constraint: ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z_\-0-9.]*$

       

       
        
         module_name

        
         String

        
         No

        
         Module

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 64 characters

         Regular expression constraint: ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z_\-0-9.]*$

       

       
        
         service_name

        
         String

        
         No

        
         serviceName

         Minimum length: 0 character

         Maximum length: 250 characters

         Regular expression constraint: ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z_\-0-9]*$

       

       
        
         start

        
         Integer

        
         Yes

        
         Start page.

         Minimum value: 0

       

       
        
         limit

        
         Integer

        
         Yes

        
         Limit on the Number of Results

         Minimum value: 1

         Maximum value: 1000

    N/A

name: Function Service Development
title: Function Service Development
text:
Function Service Development
 
 
  
  

  
   This section describes SDKs and APIs provided by the function service.

   
    Platform SDKs

    
     
      
       Table 1 Platform SDKs
      
      
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         SDK

        
         Import Mode

        
         Description

       

      
      
       
        
         Context

        
         from adc_sdk.context import Context

        
         Used to provide basic information about function call.

       

       
        
         ServiceInvoker

        
         from adc_sdk.api import ServiceInvoker

        
         Used to call orchestration APIs (such as model, logic flow, and function APIs) opened by ADC to streamline API orchestration. For details about the orchestration API definition, see API Catalog.

       

       
        
         FileInvoker

        
         from adc_sdk.api import FileInvoker

        
         Used to interact with the ADC file system and access temporary files.

       

       
        
         LoggerInvoker

        
         from adc_sdk.api import LoggerInvoker

        
         Used to record element operation information, warnings, and errors during app execution.

       

      
     
    

   

   
    Platform APIs

    
     
      
       Table 2 Platform APIs
      
      
       
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         SDK

        
         API

        
         Description

        
         Example

        
         Response

       

      
      
       
        
         Context

        
         context

        
         Provides basic function information.

        
         def handler(event: dict, context: Context):

         print('context:' + str(context.__dict__))

         The output is as follows:

         context:{'function_uri': '/project/module/function', 'tracker_id': 'xxxx', 'username': 'username_xx', 'timeout': 120, 'memory': 128}

        
         -

       

       
        
         ServiceInvoker

        
         ServiceInvoker.post(uri: str, data)

        
         Performs the create/modify operation.

        
         ServiceInvoker.post('/adc-model/rest/v1/model-instances/batch-create?uri=/proCode/faas/faas_model1', [{'property_values': {"text1":"woshishui","active":False}},{'property_values': {"text1":"woshiwo","active":True}}])

         ServiceInvoker.post("/adc-service/rest/v1/{}/{}/{}", {'faas': 'good'})

        
         Response in JSON format. The content is related to the specific API.

       

       
        
         ServiceInvoker.get(uri: str)

        
         Performs the query operation.

        
         ServiceInvoker.get('/adc-model/rest/v1/model-instances/find-by-keycode?uri=/proCode/faas/faas_model1&keycode=woshishei')

         ServiceInvoker.get("/adc-service/rest/v1/{}/{}/{}")

        
         Response in JSON format. The content is related to the specific API.

       

       
        
         ServiceInvoker.delete(uri: str)

        
         Performs the delete operation.

        
         ServiceInvoker.delete("/adc-service/rest/v1/{}/{}/{}")

        
         Response in JSON format. The content is related to the specific API.

       

       
        
         FileInvoker

        
         FileInvoker.read_code_file(path: str, r_mod: str)

        
         Reads files in the code.

        
         config_file = FileInvoker.read_code_file("/my_module/my_config/test.conf", "r")

         logging.info(config_file.read())

         config_file.close()

         path: Relative path of the file in the code, starting with a slash (/).

         r_mod: Read mode, which can be set to r, rb, or rU.

        
         File stream

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.get_tmp_file(path: str, mod: str)

        
         Obtains (reads and writes) temporary files.

        
         tmp_file = FileInvoker.get_tmp_file("/tmp.txt", 'w')

         tmp_file.write('this is a tmp file.')

         tmp_file.close()

         tmp_file = FileInvoker.get_tmp_file("/tmp.txt", "r")

         logging.info(tmp_file1.read())

         tmp_file1.close()

         path: Relative path of a file, starting with a slash (/).

         mod: Read/write mode. For details, see the definition of Python File mode.

        
         File stream

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.generate_file_token(token_request: dict)

        
         Obtains the token of the file service. The token is used together with the following APIs to interact with the file service.

        
         token_rsp = FileInvoker.generate_file_token(token_request)

         logging.info('file_token: %s' % token_rsp)

         Optional. If this parameter is set to None, the default value is used. (For details about the field description, see Table 4.) The following is an example:

         token_request = {"expire_time": 60 * 60, "file_check_rule": {"max_file_count": 5, "max_file_size": 50 * 1024 * 1024, "permission": "CRUD"}}

        
         Value of file_token

         {"result": "file_token"} can be decoded using Base64.

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.generate_file_token_by_filedir(token_request_by_filedir: dict)

        
         Obtains the token of the file service based on the file path. The token is used together with the following APIs to interact with the file service.

        
         token_rsp = FileInvoker.generate_file_token_by_filedir(token_request_by_filedir)

         logging.info('new_file_dir_token: %s' % token_rsp)

         Optional. If this parameter is set to None, the default value is used. (For details about the field description, see Table 4.) The following is an example:

         token_request_by_filedir = {"expire_time": 60 * 60, "file_dir": "/tmp/faas/file", file_check_rule": {"max_file_count": 5, "max_file_size": 50 * 1024 * 1024, "permission": "CR"}}

        
         Value of new_file_dir_token

         {"result": "new_file_dir_token"} can be decoded using Base64.

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.upload_file(file_token: str, path: str)

        
         Uploads files to the file service.

        
         file_token = token_rsp['result']

         result = FileInvoker.upload_file(file_token, tmp_file.name)

         file_token: indicates the value obtained from generate_file_token(token_request: dict).

         path: Path of the file to be uploaded. The value comes from the name of the Python file.

        
         True: Success; False: Failure

         {"result": True}

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.download_file(file_token: str, file_name: str, mod: str)

        
         Downloads files from the server.

        
         downloaded_file = FileInvoker.download_file(file_token, "tmp.txt", "r")

         file_token: indicates the value obtained from generate_file_token(token_request: dict).

         file_name: File name (excluding the path).

         mod: Read/write mode. For details, see the definition of Python File mode.

        
         File stream

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.download_file_get_path(file_token: str, file_name: str)

        
         Downloads a file from the file service and returns the absolute path of the file.

        
         file_path = FileInvoker.download_file_get_path(file_token, "tmp.txt")

         file_token: indicates the value obtained from generate_file_token(token_request: dict).

         file_name: name of the uploaded file (excluding the path)

        
         File path. Its value is of the string type.

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.download_files_get_paths(file_token: str)

         
           NOTE: 
          
           Old assets developed based on Python 3.8 can be used only after the engine is upgraded to Python 3.9 and the running language of the function service is changed to Python 3.9.

          

         

        
         Downloads all files under the same file token from the file service and returns the absolute path of the files.

        
         file_path = FileInvoker.download_files_get_paths(file_token)

         file_token: indicates the value obtained from generate_file_token(token_request: dict).

        
         File path set. Its value is of the list type.

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.delete_file(file_token: str, file_name: str)

        
         Deletes a file from the file service.

        
         result = FileInvoker.delete_file(file_token, "tmp.txt")

         file_token: indicates the value obtained from generate_file_token(token_request: dict).

         file_name: name of the uploaded file (excluding the path)

        
         True: Success; False: Failure

         {"result": True}

       

       
        
         FileInvoker.get_tmp_file_path()

        
         Obtains the temporary file directory used by Python code developers.

        
         temp_file_path=FileInvoker.get_tmp_file_path()

        
         Temporary file directory str

       

       
        
         LoggerInvoker

        
         LoggerInvoker.info(app_log_info: str)

        
         Records information-level logs.

        
         app_log_info = {

         "app_name": "app_name", //Mandatory

         "module_name": "module_name", //Mandatory

         "element_type": "element_type", //Mandatory. Example: service/function

         "element_name": "element_name", //Optional

         "operate_type": "operate_type", //Mandatory. Example: Create/Delete/Query/Update/Execute

         "operator": "operator", //Optional

         "time_cost": "time_cost", //Unit: ms

         "msg": "message" //Mandatory

         }

        
         true: Success; false: Failure

         {"result": true }

       

       
        
         LoggerInvoker.warn(app_log_info: str)

        
         Records warning-level logs.

        
         The parameter is the same as above.

        
         true: Success; false: Failure

         {"result": true }

       

       
        
         LoggerInvoker.error(app_log_info: str)

        
         Records error-level logs.

        
         The parameter is the same as above.

        
         true: Success; false: Failure

         {"result": true }

       

       
        
         os

        
         os.remove(file_path: str)

        
         Deletes the temporary file directory.

        
         file_path: directory of the temporary file to be deleted

        
         -

       

      
     
    

    
     
      
       Table 3 Parameter token_request
      
      
       
       
       
       
       
       
      
      
       
        
         Field

        
         Name

        
         Type

        
         Unit

        
         Value Range

        
         Default Value (When token_request Is Empty)

       

      
      
       
        
         expire_time

        
         Validity period

        
         int

        
         Second (s)

        
         [60, 24 * 60 * 60]

        
         60 * 60

title: URLs Configured for Other Endpoints Become Invalid When the Customized Process Variable _dynamicRoute Is Used
text:
URLs Configured for Other Endpoints Become Invalid When the Customized Process Variable _dynamicRoute Is Used
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    When there are multiple endpoints and the dynamic route is used at one endpoint, the URL of the endpoint is automatically imported by the customized process variable _dynamicRoute. As a result, the URLs of other endpoints become invalid.

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The _dynamicRoute parameter defined by the system is used as a global variable during data parsing in the runtime-state environment, affecting the URL configuration of subsequent endpoints.

   

   
    Solution

    _dynamicRoute is not recommended. You can use a customized variable. To customize variables, perform the following steps:

    
     Click the API to be configured.

     Click Process Variable in the upper right corner of the process orchestration page.
      
       Figure 1 Process Variable

name: Infinite Loop Is Displayed During Model Trigger Configuration
title: Infinite Loop Is Displayed During Model Trigger Configuration
text:
Infinite Loop Is Displayed During Model Trigger Configuration
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    When a rule (trigger) configuration is submitted or a rule is imported on the develop-state page, if the system detects that the trigger operates on its own model, no trigger condition is configured, and the operation type is the same as the model operation, an infinite loop is definitely triggered. This scenario is detected during rule metadata configuration. Therefore, rules cannot be updated or imported.

    

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    The following conditions are not allowed during trigger creation:

    
     Creation operation of model A is triggered with no trigger condition configured (executed under any condition) for the creation event of model A.

     Update operation of model A is triggered with no trigger condition configured (executed under any condition) for the update event of model A.

     Creation or update event of model A triggers the creation or update of model B. After several cycles, the creation or update of model A is triggered at last. No trigger condition is configured (executed under any condition).

    

   

   
    Solution

    Check whether the preceding scenario exists. If yes, modify the rules based on the check results and error information, and then submit or import the rules.

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Common Problems About Models

name: How Do I Retrieve Data Archive Files After Data Is Dumped to the File Server?
title: How Do I Retrieve Data Archive Files After Data Is Dumped to the File Server?
text:
How Do I Retrieve Data Archive Files After Data Is Dumped to the File Server?
 
 
  
  

  
   
    Symptom

    Data within the file retention period needs to be retrieved after Archiving Target on the model archiving configuration page is set to Dump File Server.

    

   

   
    Possible Causes

    If Archiving Target is set to Dump File Server, you need to have the permission on the platform file server to download files.

   

   
    Solution

    Contact the environment administrator and obtain files by performing the following steps:

    
     Connect to the default database of the tenant and query the file storage path. Run the following SQL statement to query the file path and file name of the file server:
      

      select file_path from t_rt_mod_archive_file where project_name = 'test' and model_name = 'test_model' and archive_data_start_time > '20250101000000' and archive_data_start_time < '202501010000000'
      The preceding SQL statement indicates that the file path of the model whose project name is test, model name is test_model, and archiving time is between 20250101 and 20250103 is queried. Modify the file path based on the model information and time to be queried.

      In most cases, the default path of the dump file server is adc-model-batch/{modelName}/{uuid}/{modelName}-{archive_data_start_time}-{archive_data_end_time}-01.zip.

      

     Connect to the file server to download files.
      

      Connect to the file server based on the file storage path found in 1 and download files.

      

    

   

  

  
   
    
     Parent topic: Common Problems About Models
